title: Find the Ferns
desc:
Unique Ferns are tasty and all,
but when people keep eating
them, there are no specimens
to research! That's why I need
you to go out and gather some
before they're all gone. Look for
them growing among flowers.

title: Due for Dragon Amber
desc:
Dragon Amber is incredibly
useful for research, but it's
also a pain in the neck to
get. Well, for these old bones
it is. Grab a few pickaxes and
get to mining me some from
the Jurassic Frontier!

title: Medicinal Moths
desc:
A friend of mine told me
that there's a medicine
that uses Immortal Moths!
I'd love to research it,
but...sadly I'm a real
entomophobe. Could you
catch some for me, please?

title: Horns o' Plenty
desc:
Eastern medicine believes
Kelbi Horns can help heal
injuries, so I'd like to
keep a stockpile in my
house. That means you get
to go carve three of them
for me! Don't dawdle now!

title: A Fungal Hunt
desc:
I've taken an interest in
Abyssal Mushrooms. You can
only find them deep inside
the Jurassic Frontier and
they have a very distinct
scent. I can't go, but if
you could, that'd be great.

title: Wipe Out!
desc:
You ever seen a Maccao?
You know: big tail, green,
bad attitude and totally rude?
Seems their alpha has
skedaddled off somewhere,
so now's a great time to
wipe out them pesky pests!

title: Another Pack Attack
desc:
In the Frontier there are
Felynes in trouble. Gather
your things and depart
on the double! Once you
have saved them from
certain defeat, come to see
me for a sweet little treat!

title: Harvest Tour: Jurassic Frontier
desc:
Interested in gathering?
Then look no further than
this Quest, brave Hunter.
Gather as much as you like,
then deliver a Paw Pass
Ticket from the Supply Box
to return at any time.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Dunes
desc:
Interested in gathering?
Then look no further than
this Quest, brave Hunter.
Gather as much as you like,
then deliver a Paw Pass
Ticket from the Supply Box
to return at any time.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Verdant Hills
desc:
Gatherin' is what sets a
livin' hunter apart from a
dead one. Without it, ya
can't survive! So take all
ya want! Just turn in the
Paw Pass Ticket from the
Supply Box when yer set!
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Arctic Ridge
desc:
Time to do some daytime
gathering up on the Arctic
Ridge! Just be sure to leave
some for the tourists, eh?
Once you're all set, just
deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
that's inside the Supply Box!
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Misty Peaks
desc:
You are keen to gather
materials from the Peaks.
The Guild will cover your
flight expenses, so gather
all you wish. Once finished,
you will deliver the Paw Pass
Ticket inside the Supply Box.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Vaulting Outlaw
desc:
We've had a request come
in from the Wycademy asking
you to hunt a Great Maccao.
The beast has been terrorizing
their research team. Take care
of it and you'll be able to take
on more difficult Quests.

title: Rambunctious Rhenoplos
desc:
The survey team's been having
a lot of trouble -- Rhenoplos
keep crashing into everything!
All the repairs are takin' a huge
chunk out of our budget. Those
things have got to go! Can you
help us out?

title: On the Rebound
desc:
Recently, there have been a
lot of Maccao attacks in
the Jurassic Frontier. It's
becoming a real problem to
anyone who ventures out there.
Could you put a stop to
those hopping hooligans?

title: A Berry Good Idea
desc:
My wife has her heart set
on eating some Ancient
Berries despite them being
really hard to get. I heard
Larinoths drop them if you
"interrupt" them while they
eat. Up for some "interrupting?"

title: A Fern is Forever
desc:
A Wycademy kiddo found
*hiccup* a boutique urn...
I mean a *hiccup* Unique Fern!
It's bitter, yet sweet, which
would go great with my nightly
tipple. *hiccup* Be a pal and
nab me some of them, won't ya?

title: Jurassic Frontier Accounting
desc:
Young Hunter, your hands
seem idle. Would you care
to busy yourself collecting
points for me in the Jurassic
Frontier? Any items are fine,
as long as you meet the
quota. Take care, now.

title: Gendrome Roadblock
desc:
I've been ferrying goods
for a big deal coming up,
only packs of Genprey keep
messing things up. I'd bet
there's an alpha behind it.
Take 'em out so my deal
won't fall through!

title: The Land Sharq
desc:
Argh, my wagon just got
marooned in the Dunes!
Now, I haven't seen anything
fishy out here -- yet -- but I
just know there's something
waiting to get at my stuff!
Find it and let 'em have it!

title: Slay the Genprey!
desc:
Th-thanks to the Genprey in
the Dunes *ouch* and their
Paralyzing attacks, I can't
move a *ouch* muscle! My
nose itches so bad. Avenge
me -- take out ten of them!

title: Hermit Grab
desc:
When me sandskiff up and
died on me, I buried all the
edible cargo in the sand to
preserve it, but some bloomin'
Hermitaurs went and sniffed
it out! Can someone hold them
off while I work on repairs?

title: Birthday Berries
desc:
It's nearly my mama's
birthday, and I wanna bake
her a berry shortcake! It's
her favorite. Can you
please help me get the
ingredients? Please?

title: Liver of Legend!
desc:
While doing some business
out in the Dunes, I heard
about a route where livers
go for a really high price.
I can't ignore the scent of
zenny to be made. Can you
sniff out five livers for me?

title: Dunes Accounting
desc:
Young Hunter, your hands
seem idle. Would you care
to busy yourself collecting
points for me in the Dunes?
Any items are fine, as
long as you meet the
quota. Take care, now.

title: Hunt Down the Velocidrome!
desc:
My lovely wife, bless her heart,
knows I love mushrooms, so
she went to the Verdant Hills to
pick some. On the way, a
Velocidrome attacked her! You've
got to make it safe so she can
go back! Help her, Hunter!

title: Slay the Velociprey!
desc:
Lately there's been a lot of
Velociprey creeping up
closer and closer to the
village. Lots of villagers
are worried. Can you calm
their fears by doin' in some
of those pesky critters?

title: Bullfango Tango
desc:
We might make a living out
in the forest, but even we
have a hard time when
monsters charge at us,
'specially Bullfango.
Make our lives easier and
take out 10, won't you?

title: Prime Premium Sashimi
desc:
The Village Chief loves
his Premium Sashimi so
much, he used to make
hunters go fish for their
"training." Are ya up for
a little refresher course?

title: Verdant Hills Accounting
desc:
Young Hunter, your hands
seem idle. Would you care
to busy yourself collecting
points for me in the Verdant
Hills? Any items are fine,
as long as you meet the
quota. Take care, now.

title: The Mountain Roughrider
desc:
Y'know, the more I think about
it, the more I wanna move to
the Arctic Ridge. But I
gotta find a way to stay
warm... I bet a coat made
from Bulldrome pelts would
be roasty-toasty! You game?

title: Slay the Giaprey!
desc:
You know what Giaprey are,
yeah? Those buggers went
after my Popo, and after I
drove them off, more and
more keep showin' up. Time
to put 'em on the endangered
list, if ya know what I mean.

title: A Pack of Blangos
desc:
I'd like you to slay some
Blangos running around in
the Arctic Ridge. Some
people have also spotted
Bulldrome around there
lately, so keep an eye out
so they don't ambush you.

title: Medicinal Mountain Herbs
desc:
My brother hurt himself. Now
he's laid up at home. I heard
these Mountain Herbs can
get him back on his feet, but
I ain't going anywhere near them
monster-infested mountains. How
'bouts you going in my stead?

title: Arctic Ridge Accounting
desc:
Young Hunter, your hands
seem idle. Would you care
to busy yourself collecting
points for me in the Arctic
Ridge? Any items are fine,
as long as you meet the
quota. Take care, now.

title: Arzuros the Azure Beast
desc:
The Arzuros is a creature
we're long used to seeing
near the village, but lately
it's wandering closer and
closer, which endangers the
kids. I hate to impose, but
I can't do much by myself.

title: Bye Bye Jaggia
desc:
Jaggi are awful, am I right?
Well, Jaggia are even
worse! And now a
gang of 'em are terrorizing
the Misty Peaks! Please,
put a stop to them before
they come ruin our crops!

title: Howling Harassment
desc:
I live on the edge of the
village, and late every night,
these blasted Jaggi come
down and raise hell! Have
they no respect for their
elders!? Please, make
my nights quiet again.

title: Fungal Fad
desc:
Oh my gosh! I'm just dying
for some Mushroom Juice!
All the girls are drinking it,
so I gotta get my hands on
some, like now! It'd be totally
rad if you got me 10 Unique
Mushrooms. Pleeeease!

title: Sunsnug Sprout Courier
desc:
The Felynes on Sunsnug Isle
are hoping to get their paws
on some Super Spouts. Deliver
us some and you'll be rewarded
with some tasty ingredients
for cooking. Sounds like a
great oppurrtunity, nya?

title: Misty Peaks Accounting
desc:
Young Hunter, your hands
seem idle. Would you care
to busy yourself collecting
points for me in the Misty
Peaks? Any items are fine,
as long as you meet the
quota. Take care, now.

title: Harvest Tour: Deserted Island
desc:
Interested in gathering?
Then look no further than
this Quest, brave Hunter.
Gather as much as you like,
then deliver a Paw Pass
Ticket from the Supply Box
to return at any time.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Marshlands
desc:
Interested in gathering?
Then look no further than
this Quest, brave Hunter.
Gather as much as you like,
then deliver a Paw Pass
Ticket from the Supply Box
to return at any time.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Tusked Tantrum
desc:
Thanks to the Tetsucabra
running loose within the
Jurassic Frontier, the
Wycademy's research of the
area has ground to a halt.
If you could, we'd like you
to rid us of it.

title: Stomping Grounds
desc:
How can I study the flora out
in the wilderness when the
fauna keeps stomping all over
it? Can you hunt the Yian
Kut-Ku that is driving me
cuckoo? In the name of
science, I beg you!

title: Chasing Tail
desc:
Truly a wonder of nature the
Great Maccao is. Even more
remarkable are their tails. I
wanted to take a closer look,
but I got a bit too close.
Now, two of them are hot on
MY tail! Help!

title: Jurassic Treasure: The Frog
desc:
Gettin' treasure trembles
fer this 'ere Tailed Frog
I picked up in the Jurassic
Frontier? Sorry to say, but
if ye want it, ye gotta go
work fer it! Capture me a
'uge ol' Tetsucabra!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Bit by the Fashion Bug
desc:
Did you know Bnahabra clothing
is the new in-thing? Cha-ching,
right? Except, I can't seem to
get 'em to hold still long
enough to sew 'em together!
Rude! So, can you make 'em stop
squirming, like, permanently?

title: Tumultuous Sprouts
desc:
I've run out of Abyssal
Mushrooms for my research.
Could you pick some for me?
There's been talk about odd,
blade-sharpening sounds
coming from deep in the forest,
but I'm sure you'll be fine!

title: Tumultuous Sprouts
desc:
I've run out of Abyssal
Mushrooms for my research.
Could you pick some for me?
There's been talk about odd,
blade-sharpening sounds
coming from deep in the forest,
but I'm sure you'll be fine!

title: Fishy Favor
desc:
The Meownster Hunters on
Sunsnug Island always so
kind to me. In return, I want
to treat them to some
Brocadefish. Could you fish
some out of the Jurassic
Frontier waters for me?

title: Crustacean Frustration
desc:
A buddy of mine went off to the
Dunes in search of materials
and got pounced on by a
Daimew, er, I mean Daimyo
Hermitaur! Now we're in a pinch
to get him back! Can you crush
that crustacean for us?

title: The Desert Gourmand
desc:
One minute I was rattlin' along
the Dunes in me barrel buggy,
mindin' me own. And then,
RAAARRR! Cart goes flyin'
-- and me with it! What
gives!? The barrel business is
s'pposed t'be safe, by gum!

title: Konchu Collector
desc:
The Konchu is a most
fascinating creature -- a
bug of many metamorphoses!
Attack it and watch it switch
into defensive mode for
evasive action. I need more
specimens for my research!

title: Cancer of the Dunes
desc:
Grrr! Enough is enough! Those
Hermitaurs act like they own
the Dunes just beclaws there's
more of them than there are of
us! Purrlease Hunter, rid the
Dunes of this cancer.
objective:
Slay 10 before time expires
or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
failure:
Reward hits 0, or time
expires before slaying 10

title: Deliver the Liver
desc:
Have you heard? It's been
discovered that Apceros
Livers can be used for a variety
of medicinal purposes! I'm keen
on getting in on the action
while demand is high. Mind
nabbing me a few?

title: Farming Frustrations
desc:
The Velociprey that live up
in them there Verdant Hills
are a real annoyance, going
after our livestock and just
being downright ornery. Put
a hurtin' on 20 fer me, will ya?
Just be careful of their boss!

title: Financial Focus on Fungus
desc:
Mushrooms from the Verdant
Hills are suddenly in high
demand. If you gather
me ten, I'll give you a cut
of the profits. Oh, I heard
that Velocidrome hang
around there, so stay sharp!

title: Local Threat
desc:
Yian Kut-Ku have been going
after people all over the place,
and during my patrol earlier,
I spotted one wandering close
to town. That curious bugger
must be after some Konchu.
Can you get rid of it?

title: Into the Wyvern's Den
desc:
I have a patient back in
my village afflicted with
a rare disease. It takes
two fresh Wyvern Eggs to
cure, so I'd like for you
to sneak into a Wyvern
nest and whisk some away.

title: Into the Wyvern's Den
desc:
I have a patient back in
my village afflicted with
a rare disease. It takes
two fresh Wyvern Eggs to
cure, so I'd like for you
to sneak into a Wyvern
nest and whisk some away.

title: Snow with Occasional Lagombi
desc:
[REPORT BEGINS] Lagombi
spotted in the Arctic
Ridge [STOP] Requesting
support from all qualified
hunters [STOP] We are
snowed in and cannot render
assistance [REPORT ENDS]

title: Anteka Anticipation
desc:
I've gotten my paws on all
kinds of monster meat before.
You name it, I've grilled it.
But I've never tried my paw
at grilling up some Anteka.
Help me out and we'll have a
barbeque for the ages!

title: The Shadow in the Mountains
desc:
We were up in the Arctic Ridge --
doing a little research -- when
all of a sudden, something really
creepy and gross plopped down
behind us. We managed to escape,
but we can't do any research
with that thing up there!

title: No Go on the Popo
desc:
Usually I can find Popo pretty
easily, but the few I spotted
today scampered up the mountain
like they were spooked by
something. I need some Popo
meat, but I'm not going up there!
Can you go and get me some?

title: No Go on the Popo
desc:
Usually I can find Popo pretty
easily, but the few I spotted
today scampered up the mountain
like they were spooked by
something. I need some Popo
meat, but I'm not going up there!
Can you go and get me some?

title: Bully the Bullfango
desc:
Ugh! My backside's seen better
days. Blame the Bullfango! My
mom sent me to the Misty Peaks
to dig up mushrooms, see, and all
of a sudden those beasts were
behind me! Long story short,
my bottom needs avenging!

title: For Whom the Egg Yolks
desc:
I want...I mean, this TOWN
could do with some Gargwa
Eggs. They are a hot commodity
right meow that people are
willing to trade fur. Could you
sneak me...er, US, definitely
US, three Gargwa Eggs?

title: Royal Spit Take
desc:
Ick! I got splattered with
weird gunk that sapped my
Stamina, so I couldn't
even run! Luckily, a Felyne
came by and saved me,
but now whenever I see
anything yellow...urgh!

title: A Forest Fracas
desc:
Something's afoot, er, ahoof in
the forest, Hunter. A Bulldrome
suddenly showed up and leveled
our crops. Strange happenings
'round here. Can you check it
out and take care of that
Bulldrome while you're at it?

title: A Forest Fracas
desc:
Something's afoot, er, ahoof in
the forest, Hunter. A Bulldrome
suddenly showed up and leveled
our crops. Strange happenings
'round here. Can you check it
out and take care of that
Bulldrome while you're at it?

title: Royal Honey Hunt
desc:
The name "Royal Honey"
makes it sound like a divine
treat that has to be tasted to
be believed! I have to know
how I can get my bees to
make this "nectar of the
gods."

title: Current Events
desc:
What a twist! People on land
suddenly soaked to the bone!
The soggy victims insist they
saw something yellow before
their drenching. What could it
have been? Hunter, please,
help me solve this riddle!

title: The Crabbiest Catch
desc:
You know, Hunter, Moga Mussels
found on the Deserted Island are
a world famous delicacy, but
a Daimyo Hermitaur keeps
messin' with their breedin'
grounds. Could you capture
that crabby critter for me?
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Pack Woes
desc:
Oh, dear me! I heard about
a pack of Jaggi roaming closer
and closer to the village
lately. I'm worried my son might
get mauled out there! Put my
fears to rest and make sure
it's safe for my son to play.
objective:
Slay a total of 20
Jaggi or Jaggia

title: The Fungus Among Us
desc:
I've got a real mushroom
problem, Hunter! I need to get
my hands on some Ripened
Mushrooms for a cookout, but
I'm not going anywhere near
those creepy Altaroth! Could
you get some for me? Pleeease!?

title: Moofah Must-haves
desc:
We need to make warm
clothing for our babies, but
to make them, I need some
Moofah wool from the Moofah
on the Deserted Island. If
you've got a Cutting-type
weapon, it should be easy!

title: Deserted Island Accounting
desc:
Young Hunter, your hands
seem idle. Would you care
to busy yourself collecting
points for me on the Deserted
Island? Any items are fine,
as long as you meet the
quota. Take care, now.

title: Sunsnug Isle Rescue!
desc:
Oh, it's a catastrophe! The
Sunsnug Isle Meownster
Hunters were in the Marshlands
when an Iodrome kitty
cornered them! Purrlease
rescue them, Hunter!

title: Robbed Blind
desc:
I hear that Gypceros take a
real shine to shiny objects.
They've been known to
swipe stuff from people! If
we can hunt one down, I bet
we'll get our hands on some
serious booty! Cha-ching!

title: Pest Control
desc:
Work is tough enough as it
is, but I can't even get a wink
of sleep with all these bugs
buzzing around! And now
my boss is angry because
my work is behind schedule!
Make these bugs buzz off!
objective:
Slay a total of 20
Vespoid or Hornetaur

title: Travelers in Trouble
desc:
Some travelers came all the
way from Dundorma to visit
Bherna, but on their way home
they got attacked by Ioprey!
This is terrible! They'll probably
give us terrible scores on the
questionnaire!

title: Royal Rhinos Gone Wild
desc:
I've had enough of being on
the losing side of the Royal
Rhino Royale! That's all going
to change this year, and that's
where you come in! Go out
and get me ten. If I win, we
can split the prize.

title: Marshlands Accounting
desc:
Young Hunter, your hands
seem idle. Would you care
to busy yourself collecting
points for me in the Marsh-
lands? Any items are fine,
as long as you meet the
quota. Take care, now.

title: Harvest Tour: Volcano
desc:
Interested in gathering?
Then look no further than
this Quest, brave Hunter.
Gather as much as you like,
then deliver a Paw Pass
Ticket from the Supply Box
to return at any time.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: The Nocturnal Enchanter
desc:
The survey team ran into
a Malfestio in the Jurassic
Frontier. Before they knew
it, everyone had either passed
out or gotten so confused
they don't remember a thing.
Be on your guard, Hunter!

title: Wyvern of the Wind
desc:
The Nargacuga out on the
Jurassic Frontier is scarily
fast. Blink and you'll miss
it. But, Hunter, it's gotta
go! There's nothing more
important right now than
hunting it, so get to it!

title: Jurassic Treasure: The Bug
desc:
Gettin' treasure trembles
fer this Blossom Cricket
I picked up in the Jurassic
Frontier? Sorry to say, but
if ye want it, ye gotta go
work fer it! Earn it by
'untin' me a Volvidon!

title: Unlock the Secret to...
desc:
The Eternal Fossil is a super
rare type of fossil said to be the
key to unlocking... Yes, blah
blah blah...I know. You don't
care. But I do! I need to know
if what they say is true! My
research depends on it!

title: A Unique Cuppa
desc:
Hi hi, Hunter-person! Have
you ever heard of Bherna's
Fern Tea? It's a tried and
true recipe, but I think I can
improve it with some Unique
Ferns! That's sure to make
it a hit!
objective:
Deliver 10 Unique Ferns
or a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Hunt-a-thon: Gendrome
desc:
A merchant friend of mine got
jumped by a bunch of Gendrome
lurkin' out in the desert. She's
not too worse for wear, but
if y'ask me, we should make
sure this sort of happenin' is
a one-time-only happenin'.
objective:
Hunt 2 before time expires
or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
failure:
Reward hits 0, or time expires
before hunting 2 Gendrome

title: Mining: The Final Frontier
desc:
Ore that falls from the sky
is really rare. While we don't
know how to refine it yet,
it's still a valuable resource.
As a forger, I'm keen to learn
all that I can. Think you're
able to get some for me?

title: Wrath of the Rathian
desc:
Dang Rathian! Ambushed my
caravan and tore my business
a new one! But I ain't the
gettin' mad type, I'm the
gettin' even type! Time for
some ice cold revenge, and
I want you to dish it out!

title: Noise Violation
desc:
The Najarala around the
village is making some
pawful sounds! Does it
think it's some kind of
mewsician? Hunter,
make it shut up before
it drives me up the wall!

title: Hunt-a-thon: Yian Kut-Ku
desc:
Ugh, will those Yian Kut-Ku
ever shut up!? They're running
around screaming all day,
with those stupid faces and
those big ears... Someone
please hunt them down so
I can finally get some sleep!
objective:
Hunt 2 before time expires
or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
failure:
Reward hits 0, or time expires
before hunting 2 Yian Kut-Ku

title: Hunt-a-thon: Velocidrome
desc:
Nyaaargh! My pointy little
ears hurt from the yowling
of those Velocidrome! I
pounced on one, but more just
followed! I dunno how many
there are, but save me from
their apawling screeches!
objective:
Hunt 2 before time expires
or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
failure:
Reward hits 0, or time expires
before hunting 2 Velocidrome

title: The New Tenant
desc:
A Blangonga has taken up
residence in the Arctic
Ridge, which spells
trouble for us being able
to gather firewood. Hurry
and take that ugly ape out
before we freeze to death!

title: Lagombi Lair
desc:
I'm reporting live from the
Arctic Ridge where two Lagombi
are making their way across the
frozen landscape. I could stand
here and watch these graceful
creatures all day! ...Wait, are
they coming this way!? RUN!

title: Hungry Eyes
desc:
Night fishing is pure bliss, I
tell ya. It's cool...quiet. You
can see the stars reflected in
the water. Last night, I saw
two red shooting stars streak
overhead. Next thing I know,
I'm bruised and battered.

title: Royal Pains
desc:
You came at just the right
time, Hunter! I've got two
Royal Ludroth I'd love to
see gone from the Misty
Peaks. Can't look for Super
Sprouts with those spongy
varmints sprayin' me down!

title: Peddling Practice
desc:
Heya, Hunter! Can we play
merchant for a bit!? Um,
let's thee... I want you to
dee-liver... Yeah! Deliver
some Balm-thtone Pie-thes to
me! If you do, I'll give ya
thomethin' cool I found!

title: Island Menace
desc:
Some kids came up to me and
said they spotted something
real odd-like on the Deserted
Island. Could be one of those
Malfestio. If that's the case,
capture that hootin' hooligan
before it hurts someone.
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Deviled Legs
desc:
I've heard stories of frog legs
bein' an in-demand delicacy
overseas. Imagine the feast
we could cook up with those
two Tetsucabras over on the
Deserted Island. Spring to it
Hunter, our beast feast awaits!

title: Hunt-a-thon: Daimyo Hermitaur
desc:
Goodness gravy! Whitescruff,
bless his heart, has set off
to drive away some Daimyo
Hermitaurs that have
popped up lately. I'm really
worried about him. Be a doll
and help him drive them away.
objective:
Hunt 2 before time expires
or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
failure:
Reward hits 0, or time expires
before hunting 2 D.Hermitaurs

title: Marshlands Mission
desc:
New orders, priority one:
Protect the villagers and
increase our deployment
options. We can't do either
until you hunt that Shogun
Ceanataur. This mission is
classified, understood?

title: Serpentine Samba
desc:
My huntin' is near as bad as
my dancin', but my little
sis? Best moves in the
tribe! I wanna make her a
costume of serpent scales
for the big festival. Could
ya help me bag a big snake!?

title: Lurkin' in the Murk
desc:
True horror lurks within the
murky Marshlands... Two
airborne wyverns, pallid
hides gleaming in the dark
skies, bodies sparking with
electricity. Beware!
They're right behind you!

title: Crustacean Infestation
desc:
I was just mindin' my own
business, mining for some
goodies, when a Ceanataur
pops out of nowhere and
breaks my Pickaxe! I would've
yanked it out of its shell,
but more of 'em showed up!

title: Tumbling Troublemaker
desc:
Holy moly! Have you seen one
of those things before? I
thought it was a giant boulder
tumbling down the mountain,
but no, it was a monster comin'
to eat me! I'm not going back
there until you get rid of it!

title: Crustacean Infatuation
desc:
I love Shogun Ceanataurs,
don't you!? Their carapaces
have so many fine details,
their claws are so long and
beautiful... *ahem* I want
to, er, study one up close,
so could you capture one?
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Rocking the Uroktor
desc:
These Uroktor are fascinatin'
creatures! They burrow right
through volcanic rock. How is
that even possible? I wanna find
out more about 'em, but they
keep spittin' gobs of fire at me.
Help me unlock their mysteries!

title: Great Ore Discovery
desc:
Great news! A new Coal bed
has been discovered in the
Volcano, and as much as I'd
like to get in on that action,
that place is Shogun Ceanataur
turf. Care to go mining for me,
Hunter?

title: Volcano Accounting
desc:
Young Hunter, your hands
seem idle. Would you care
to busy yourself collecting
points for me in the Volcano?
Any items are fine, as
long as you meet the
quota. Take care, now.

title: The Dark Age
desc:
Recently, a Yian Garuga has
appeared in the Jurassic
Frontier. Research in that
area can't continue until
the threat has been dealt
with. Good luck, Hunter.

title: Trifecta of Terror
desc:
A trio of Nibelsnarf have
been spotted in the Dunes.
There's no telling what kind
of trouble this triad is up to.
One thing is for sure: You
need to tackle those three
overgrown tadpoles!

title: Garuga of the Hills
desc:
I'll let you in on a secret
of mine: I managed to track
down where a Yian Garuga
is hanging out. Don't let
anyone else know, but it's
in the Verdant Hills as we
speak!

title: The Thunderclaw Wyvern
desc:
Listen here, kid! Things are
lookin' grim out in the
Verdant Hills. There's a
mean, green, electrocutin'
machine out there messin'
things up. I need you to get
out there and mess IT up!

title: Fungus Fetch
desc:
Thanks to you, business
is soaring! So much, in fact,
that I can't keep up with
demand! Hurry back to the
Hills and gather me some
more. But be careful, I heard
there's a Rathian about!
objective:
Deliver 10 Unique Mushrooms
or a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Two Roars in the Snow
desc:
It all happened so fast...
These two Blangongas showed
up and just wrecked all I had!
I wanna rebuild my life, but
there's no way I'm going up
there with those things!
Help me get my life back!

title: Hunt-a-thon: Khezu
desc:
You look like you could go
for a little adrenaline in
your day! Well, you're in
luck! There's heaps of
monsters with electrifying
personalities up in the
Arctic Ridge! Have at it!
objective:
Hunt 2 before time expires
or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
failure:
Reward hits 0, or time expires
before hunting 2 Khezu

title: The Unwavering Colossus
desc:
If we can tame the Gammoth,
we'll have an attraction to
make us more famous than
Bherna and Yukumo com-
bined! You can't tame
monsters? Bah! Well, at
least give it a try!

title: Lagiacrus Fuss
desc:
You came at just the right
time, Hunter. See, I was on
my way back from explorin'
the Misty Peaks when I ran
into a dagnabbed Lagiacrus!
Here's hopin' you make quick
work of that varmint.

title: The Entrancing Water Dancer
desc:
Heed my words, Hunter:
It is said that there is a
Mizutsune in the Misty
Peaks. You will help rid
Yukumo of this slippery
devil, and your journey
will be a safe one.

title: The Fisherman's Fiend
desc:
Yikes, this is horrible!
We've just heard from our
fishermen out in the sea
that a Lagiacrus is
here in this region! We
need you to stop it before
it does any serious damage!

title: Island Heat
desc:
How's it hangin', Hunter dude?
The Yukumo Gal hooked me up
with a Quest request for you
to house that Lame-o-los that's
lurkin' on the Deserted Island.
I'm just gonna chill here and
think about these fluffy clouds.

title: Double Vision
desc:
Here's an idea: What would
happen if you ate the
scales of two Malfestio?
Would your brain go extra
on the fritz or would the
second batch cancel the first?
Inquiring minds want to know!

title: Hunt-a-thon: Gypceros
desc:
My trade colleagues are
in a bit of a jam after some
Gypceros showed up on
their route! Get rid of a
few of them for me, and
I'll reward you with some
grade-A Yukumo Riceflour!
objective:
Hunt 2 before time expires
or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
failure:
Reward hits 0, or time expires
before hunting 2 Gypceros

title: Behind Closed Ores
desc:
Psst! Hunter! I need you to
take care of something for me.
My best mining spot is infested
with Bullfango. I need you to
un-fest it, if you know what I
mean. Thing is, the place is a
trade secret, so be discreet!
objective:
Slay 10 before time expires
or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
failure:
Reward hits 0, or time
expires before slaying 10

title: A King, Robed in Smoke
desc:
I fear the end times are upon
us. A blood-colored demon
has ascended from the depths
to plague the land. I beg of
thee, save the shrine that
protects the Volcano and send
that beast back to the abyss.

title: Fight or Uragaan!
desc:
Don't bother readin' any
further unless you're a true
hunter -- the type who loves
that quiver in your guts when
you're livin' on the razor's
edge. Still with me? Go to the
Volcano. Somethin's waitin'.

title: Great Knuckleballs o' Fire!
desc:
I'm reporting live from the
Volcano, where we're observing
two majestic Volvidons. If you
look closely, you can see...
you can see... them coming
this way! Run for your lives!

title: Hunt-a-thon: Iodrome
desc:
Some Iodrome are fighting
for position as alpha, but
their fighting's going to
leave the entire ecosystem
poisoned! Please take out
a couple to help mitigate
the damage!
objective:
Hunt 2 before time expires
or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
failure:
Reward hits 0, or time expires
before hunting 2 Iodrome

title: Envoy to Disaster
desc:
I sense an ill omen that
could spell disaster for
the Volcano, should it be
left unchecked. Slay ten
of the serpents to quell the
danger before it's too late!

title: A Late Jurassic Excursion
desc:
I train the only way a warrior
can -- with full abandon!
Yet whenever I perform my kata,
monsters gather around me.
Honorable hunter! Winnow the
beasts from this place so that
I may hone my body properly!

title: A Sandy Battle Royale
desc:
My ship was cruising over
the sand when we suddenly
ran aground, our cargo
spilling hither and yon. Now,
the local monsters are really
keen on taking it, so I need
you to dissuade them!

title: Scientific Method
desc:
This island is, like, sooo
amazing, don'tcha think?
It's got unique evolutionary
patterns you can't find
aaanywhere else! Sweet, huh?
So, like, be a pal and hunt
me a monster! For science!

title: The Scorching Blade
desc:
That bedeviled Glavenus has
reappeared in the Jurassic
Frontier, and the Wycademy
search team's outmatched.
There is no time to waste.
It has to be brought down.
I'm counting on you!

title: Dark Wings, Dark Work
desc:
Beneath the azure skies of
the Jurassic Frontier lurks a
mysterious monster cloaked
in black. Writhing in pain,
it glares from unseen eyes.
The hunter or the hunted:
Which will you be?

title: Tuff Turf
desc:
I was training my tail off
in the Jurassic Frontier
when, uh, I guess I kinda
sorta riled up a Zinogre. My
bad! No way I can handle
that beast. Somebody
beat it up for me!

title: From Beyond the Sands
desc:
I was roaming the Dunes
when I happened to see
a Glavenus blocking one
of the major trade routes!
Normally I keep to myself,
but I can't live without
my delivery of Moga curry!

title: Tigrex by the Tail
desc:
I've got a distress signal
from a hunter in the
Dunes who's run into a
Tigrex! Anyone who finds
this message is requested
to head there and take it
down ASAP!

title: A Thousand Scales of Dread
desc:
Breaking news from the
Elder Hall: A Seregios has
shown up in the Dunes!
Any and all skilled hunters
are asked to help hunt
it as soon as possible.
Beware its blades!

title: The Perilous Pair
desc:
Luggage left with Neko still
no make it here. Maybe that
because there is Rathalos
and Rathian in the Verdant
Hills? Iya... All this give me
bad yokan. "Yokan" means
feeling!
objective:
Hunt a Rathalos
and a Rathian

title: The Hero's Journey
desc:
The Arctic Ridge has
materials I need to remake
the Hero's Blade, but right
now it's home to a nasty
Tigrex. Be a dear and clear
it out for me so I can go
about my work, won't you?

title: The Bellowing Zinogre
desc:
Eeek, that Zinogre's at it
again, howling away! I get
so scared hearing it, I
can't move, even when I
have customers to serve!
Someone, anyone, make it
stop so I can do my job!

title: Brachydios Mio!
desc:
We recently came across
a monster with a dangerous
slime on its forelimbs... If
any gets on you, it explodes.
We've been holding out okay
so far, but we could really
do with more hands on deck.

title: Under the Gaze of Heaven
desc:
My granddad let it slip that
he was gonna go watch a
"battle of shoguns." He
has no place being there,
but he won't listen! Look,
I'll help, too. I just
don't wanna do it alone!

title: Break the Brachydios
desc:
There's still much to learn
about Brachydios, especially
given that it's only just been
recently discovered. I simply
must know more, so I'd love
it if you captured me a
specimen to examine!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Night Terrors
desc:
Some eerie cries have
been getting closer to the
village every night. It's
freaking out the villagers
here, so would you mind
going out hunting for
whatever's behind it?

title: Bristly Fanged Beasts
desc:
There're three diff'rent
Fanged Beasts out where
I'm stayin'. Right now it
ain't too big a worry, but
even the tiniest spark can
cause a big fire, so you'd
best put it out soon.

title: Drawing the Waterline
desc:
It's a catastrophe! Terrible
things came splashing up
from the river, and now
everything's soaked! Trenya,
bring your big-nosed hunter
lackey and come punish the
purrpetrators right away!

title: The Cankerous Quagmire
desc:
I can't believe it -- two Iodrome
in the same place? What do
they want? What if they fight
the local Najarala!? This is bad!
If you don't act fast, the
Marshlands'll be a miasma of
Poison and Paralysis!

title: Volcano Triple Play
desc:
I was practicing out by the
Volcano when I saw some
cool monsters bouncing and
leaping around! If you show
me how to hit something
like that, it'll help me be
the world's best slugger!

title: It's Electric
desc:
Unexplained natural events
have been occurring deep
within the Jurassic Frontier.
Intriguing, don't you think?
I believe it's a sign of mythic
beasts, but you should go
see it with your own eyes.

title: The White Brute
desc:
My friends and I sought out
a phantom beast. When we
came upon it, we had but a
moment before it smote us
with thunder, casting us
asunder. Please help us,
Hunter.

title: Stop the Wheel
desc:
I've only known the gods
from their legends -- never
did I expect to see one in
my lifetime. Dare you
attempt to halt the cycle
of death and etch your own
name into legend, Hunter?

title: The Fated Four
desc:
O brave, wise, courageous
hunter, only you can rise
to the challenge that I
have set forth. It shall
take both all your mind
and body to overcome, but
I ask you to venture forth.

title: Advanced: Fungus Fetchin'
desc:
We're prepurring a new menu
at the Tanzinya Grill, and we
think a Dish with mushrooms
in it would be the cat's meow.
Purrhaps you could pick some
up for us, Hunter?

title: Advanced: Jurassic Treasure
desc:
Gettin' treasure trembles
fer this 'ere Kingmeat
I picked up in the Jurassic
Frontier? Sorry to say, but
if ye want it, ye gotta go
work fer it! 'Unt me a
Glavenus -- then we'll talk!

title: Advanced: Sly Swooper
desc:
I was out peddling a little
while ago when I saw a Yian
Garuga swoop down! I'm
scared what'll happen to my
friends and everyone else
if we leave it alone. Can
you make it go away?

title: Advanced: Invoking Rath
desc:
You look like you're in the
mood to bump against some
tough monsters! There's a
Rathalos and a Rathian on the
loose in the Verdant Hills.
Knowing you, I'm sure
you can handle 'em!
objective:
Hunt a Rathalos
and a Rathian

title: Advanced: Seismic Scares
desc:
Hunter, I must implore you
to take arms for me once
again. Your target this
time is a pair of Tigrex.
Steel yourself, and be
careful.

title: Advanced: Twinkle Toes
desc:
I'm no hunter, but the way I
see it, yer only as good as
the hardest blow ya can take.
An' the hardest of all are the
ones Duramboros can deal!
Take one down in the Misty
Peaks, an' prove your worth!

title: Advanced: Seltas Queen
desc:
Hey, there's a Seltas Queen
that's giving all the other
hunters around here a run
for their money. Could you
step up and give it a shot?
Think of it as a real test
of strength! Feh heh!

title: Advanced: The Goliaths
desc:
A Wycademy search team's
been attacked by some large
monsters, and now they're
stranded. What's more,
some villagers were with
them! I'd breathe easier
if you'd hunt those beasts.

title: Advanced: Barrage of Blue
desc:
Hunter, it looks like the Guild
wants you at the Arena. A
trio of blue monsters have
shown up and is causing
a fuss, but I'm sure you can
handle it! At any rate, I won't
take no for an answer!

title: Advanced: Seeing Red
desc:
Looks like another request
from the Guild... They want
some red monsters hunted
down. You'll do it for me and
save these hands from
getting dirty, of course?
Wonderful. Good luck, now!

title: Advanced: Nothing is Sacred
desc:
Got word a Shagaru Magala's
turned up at the Sanctuary
near Cathar. A thing like
that'll make short work of
anythin' in its path. Ain't many
that could face it, but I know
you're the one to get it done!

title: Advanced: Snowtal Recall
desc:
The Kushala Daora strikes
again up in the Arctic
Ridge, eh? Now that's
a foe I'm all too familiar
with: Ol' Stormbringer.
It's gonna be cold there,
so down some Hot Drinks!
objective:
Slay a Kushala Daora
or repel it

title: Advanced: Invisible Thief
desc:
Urgent wire! "Chameleos
approaching village [STOP]
All available hunters report
ASAP [END MESSAGE]"
Please hurry, and mind it
doesn't steal your supplies
with that blasted tongue!
objective: Slay a Chameleos or repel it

title: Advanced: Teostra's Return
desc:
A Teostra has appeared in the
Volcano! Not only are folks
in the area in danger, but
dragons prowling willy-nilly
means I can't grow my world-
famous Prismatic Dandelions!
Ward it off, would you?
objective:
Slay a Teostra
or repel it

title: Advanced: Might is Right
desc:
When you have it all, the
Arena is the only thing
that can excite you. But
lately, it's just been a
bunch of weaklings! I need
a real hunter to come in
and show us how it's done!

title: Advanced: State in Flux
desc:
Today's cast of monsters
oughta keep you right
busy! That's because they
come packed with attacks
that'll inflict all sorts of
Abnormal Statuses! Hope
you're up for a wild ride!

title: Advanced: The Field's a Stage
desc:
Calling all actors for the
role of a lifetime! Everyone's
dreamed of standing in the
limelight, and the Arena's
the limest light of all! Are you
the star we need to bring the
house down at the finale?

title: Advanced: Wrath of Rath
desc:
You've become a fine hunter,
so how 'bout a bigger
challenge? Picture this: you,
versus a Rathalos AND a
Rathian! Whaddaya say? Think
you can get the wyvern
royalty to bow down to you?
objective:
Hunt a Silver Rathalos
and a Gold Rathian

title: Advanced: The Golden Pair
desc:
I've got something special
whipped up for today: two
Rajang sporting shiny gold
coats! Hope you're ready to
give them all you've got,
'cause they don't know how
to go easy on anybody!

title: Advanced: Out of the Fry Pan
desc:
You must be the hunter that
nobody can shut up about!
To hear them tell it, there
ain't no one better. But
I'll only believe it when I
see it myself, so show me
proof you're hot stuff!

title: Harvest Tour: Ruined Pinnacle
desc:
I see you're interested in doing
some gathering up at the Ruined
Pinnacle. This Quest will let you
gather to your heart's content.
Just don't forget to deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket when you're done!
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Desert
desc:
I can't help notice you've
taken an interest in gathering.
Well, the Desert's a fine place
for it! Go on -- get stuck right in
there! Just remember to deliver
a Paw Pass Ticket once you've
finished playing in the sand!
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Ancestral Steppe
desc:
So you're interested in what you can
find on the Ancestral Steppe, eh?
Then have I got a Quest for you!
Collect as much as you like, then
deliver the Paw Pass Ticket from the
Supply Box when you want to return.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Primal Forest
desc:
I see that steely glint in your eye. You
want to see if you can find something
primal in the Primal Forest, don't you?
Then have I got a Quest for you!
Collect as much as you like, then
deliver the Paw Pass Ticket from the
Supply Box when you want to return.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Jurassic Frontier
desc:
I've always thought the Jurassic
Frontier must be a haven for gathering.
Haven't you? Hey, you should take this
Quest! Collect as much as you like,
and just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
from the Supply Box when you want
to return.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Dunes
desc:
I can see you're interested in stuff that
can be gathered in the Dunes. I've got
just the Quest for this eventuality! Go!
And gather to your heart's content!
Just deliver a Paw Pass Ticket when
you're done, and back you'll come.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Verdant Hills
desc:
You've got that wanting-to-gather-
-stuff-in-the-Verdant-Hills look about
you, if I ever saw it. Well, here's a
Quest tailor-made for you! Go and
gather till you drop. When you're done
just deliver a Paw Pass Ticket to return!
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Arctic Ridge
desc:
Oh, I can see you're hankering to go
a-gathering at the Arctic Ridge! Here's
a Quest you'll love! Gather till your
arms o'erflow, and when you can't
carry anymore, deliver a Paw Pass
Ticket.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Misty Peaks
desc:
I have a Quest right here that will allow
you to fulfill your long-cherished desire
to gather on Misty Peaks. I know, you
don't have to tell me! Who wouldn't
want to gather in the Misty Peaks?
Once you've had your fill of gathering,
just deliver a Paw Pass Ticket.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Defiant Maccao
desc:
Um, excuse me, there's a Great
Maccao up at Ruined Pinnacle, causing
havoc. Came flying at me, so I fled.
Beat me black and blue. Isn't it your job
to keep the wildlife in line? Would you
mind doing something about it? I mean
seriously, I can't work like this.

title: Azure Azure Can Be
desc:
For some weird reason, my little
sister thinks monsters are cute.
So when she heard about an Arzuros
at the Ruined Pinnacle, she was
desperate to go see it, but no way
am I putting her in harm's way.
Could you get rid of it for me?

title: Kut-Ku Misunderstood
desc:
So, uh, I heard a Yian Kut-Ku showed
up at the Ruined Pinnacle. I'm sure it's
totally, absolutely 100% fine, but
let's say -- hypothetically speaking --
that it actually turns out to be some
terrifying mutant deathbird...you
could handle it, couldn't you?

title: Research Team's First Rodeo
desc:
As the name implies, the Ruined
Pinnacle is way up high and covered
in ruins. Now we have the Soaratorium,
we can launch a proper expedition!
...But first, we'll need to help the
advance team, as they've been
beset by a Congalala!

title: Ruined Pinnacle, RUINED
desc:
Th-This is terrible! Because of the
intense methane buildup from all the
Congas, the Ruined Pinnacle stinks!
They just won't stop farting! How are
we supposed to do any research
under these conditions!? Can you
thin their numbers a bit? ...Puaah!

title: Brave New Ore
desc:
We discovered special ore at
the Ruined Pinnacle that we can't
get anywhere else! We still have
much to learn about this place,
but maybe if you collect some, we
could analyze it and see where
that takes us. Can you help us?

title: Husk Hunter
desc:
You know, when comets stain the sky
red, there are comet fragments to be
had on the ground beneath! The
Wycademy calls these Burned Husks,
and they're important subjects for
study. Do you think you can find us
some at the Ruined Pinnacle?

title: Wyvern Egg Delivery: Breakfast
desc:
Ah, a nice Wyvern Egg would be just
the thing for a royal breakfast. In fact,
I'll probably be for the chop if I don't
manage to lay my hands on one. If you
could source a couple for me, I'll be
sure to make it worth your while!

title: Fashion Victim
desc:
I just can't keep my line of
Crab Couture accessories in
stock! Their wild success has
caused an unforeseen issue:
a lack of materials. Hunt
a Daimyo Hermitaur for me,
and for the sake of fashion!

title: A Friend in Need
desc:
One of the top staff at the Wycademy
is under attack from a Barroth on the
road to the village. He's more than
just an official -- he's my dear friend.
I've known him for most my life.
Please, Hunter, save him.

title: March of the Genprey
desc:
Pesky Genprey attacks are
obstructing my research into the
Desert's ecosystem. Could you hunt
12 of them? Hahaha, what are you
talking about? I'm an expert, I'm fairly
sure Genprey aren't necessary to the
ecosystem!

title: On Burrowed Time
desc:
Ughhh! How's anybody supposed
to cross the Desert with those
darn Cephalos burrowing about the
place!? Now every step I take I'm
scared something's gonna jump out
and get me! Go take care of five of
'em, will you?

title: A Berry Dubious Idea
desc:
Hunter, Hunter! Are you familiar with
the Tropical Berries that grow in the
Desert? I just came up with a way to
make them really tasty! They're going
to be HUGE! I think I smell money...
I'll split the profits with you if you
collect some for me. 70-30?

title: Bug Appétit Encore
desc:
Legends tell of a faraway land
where the people make bugs
into burgers. You've cooked me
up a Seltas once before, but I
just can't get enough of that
crunchy insect goodness!
Oh, could you? Would you?

title: Enough Monkeying Around
desc:
Oof... That mischievous monkey
in the Ancestral Steppe really got
me good. It's starting to stretch my
patience. In fact, I've a good mind
to put this boot up its... *ahem*
Please, teach it a lesson before
I do something incredibly rash...

title: Poisoned for Action
desc:
An old pal of mine says the
rubbery hide of a Gypceros is
great for shipbuilding, thanks to
its water-resistant properties!
I hear one of 'em's roaming the
Primal Forest right now. Could
you haul it in for me?

title: Spit It Out
desc:
Grrrr! I am reawy, reawy upset!
A big, nasty Tetsucabwa in the
Juwassic Fwontier ate my pwecious
dowwy wowwy in one big guwp!
My worthwess butwer cawwied
me away befowe I could save it...
Somebody, avenge my dowwy!

title: Eau de Congalala
desc:
Keep your distance! I got
hit with a stink that could
peel paint! A Congalala got
me good when I went to the
Jurassic Frontier. Seize the
beast that dealt what I smelt,
Hunter! I gotta get payback!

title: Bag a Barroth!
desc:
I've found the most fascinating
specimen in the Dunes that I want you
to trap! Even from far away I was able
to spot some weird and wonderful
behavioral patterns, so imagine what
I can find up close! Oh, and naturally
I'll let it go when I'm done.
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Dune the Honors
desc:
My liege lord certainly has a lot of
possessions... All of them necessary,
I'm sure, but they do slow things down
a tad. Not to mention the Hermitaurs
and Barroths that plague the Dunes!
Could I prevail upon you to clear
the way for us a smidgen?
objective:
Hunt a Daimyo Hermitaur
and a Barroth

title: Verdant Hills Horror
desc:
So I was...ulp...after a Yian Kut-Ku
in the Verdant Hills, then this...urk...
Gypceros flew through the air.
First a weird big-eared bird, then a
weird poisonous bird... I can't take it!
Somebody take 'em out so I can get
back to normal... Ulp.
objective:
Hunt a Yian Kut-Ku
and a Gypceros

title: Investment Flanking
desc:
Grrr, stupid varmints! There I was
mindin' me own business, tryin' ta
lug my wares over yonder ridge,
'til those confounded Giaprey come
out some hidey-hole an' trash all my
stuff! They had a leader, too -- a
Giadrome! Take 'er out, I beg ya!

title: The Killer Rabbit of Arctic Ridge
desc:
Don't tell my brother, but I snuck
up the mountain to see the bunny.
It looked so darn...ANGRY!
Where is my cute fluffybuns!?
I can't sleep at night like this!
Put that abomination somewhere
I can't see him, ever!

title: Taking Royal Liberties
desc:
The Misty Peaks near our village are
currently undergoing some hardship
in the form of a Royal Ludroth. It has
taken a liking to the trees, attacking
our lumberjacks when they need to
work. You will humbly protect our
wonderful peaks by slaying the fiend.

title: Season's Eatings
desc:
Right. There are some seasonal
ingredients in the Misty Peaks which
are ripe for the taking. Naturally,
two brutish Arzuros have to turn up
and ruin everything. I need to grab
the ingredients while they're fresh,
so you need to fell those beasts.

title: Harvest Tour: Jungle
desc:
Looks like you're interested in the
wonderful bounty of materials you can
get in the Jungle. Well then, have I got
just the Quest for you! Gather as
much as you like, then deliver a Paw
Pass Ticket from the Supply Box
to return at any time.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Frozen Seaway
desc:
I can see that you're interested in what
you can harvest from the Frozen
Seaway. Am I right? Then take this
Quest! Gather to your heart's content,
then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the
Supply Box when you're ready to return
and start sifting through your data!
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Volcanic Hollow
desc:
Have you ever wondered what you
can gather from the Volcanic Hollow?
Me too! Lucky for you, here's the
perfect Quest. Gather to your heart's
content, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
from the Supply Box when you're ready
to return and see what you found!
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Deserted Island
desc:
Aren't deserted islands great? All that
data just lying around! Hey, if you're
in the mood to gather stuff, take this
Quest! Gather to your heart's content,
then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the
Supply Box when you're ready to return
and start sifting through your data!
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Marshlands
desc:
Do you know what's awesome?
Fieldwork! You agree, right? Of course!
We're best friends! You should take this
Quest! Gather to your heart's content,
then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the
Supply Box when you're ready to return
and start sifting through your data!
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Volcano
desc:
Oh, you're just itching to go gathering
at the Volcano, aren't you? I can tell
from the look in your eyes. Well, you're
in luck with this Quest! Gather as much
as you like, then deliver a Paw Pass
Ticket when you're done!
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Dazed and Confused
desc:
Malfestio's weird mojo got us all
befuddled and we lost our way.
We were lucky that we ran
aground on the Ruined Pinnacle,
to be honest. Could you hunt the
Malfestio and make sure nobody
else falls foul of it?

title: Grapes of Rathian
desc:
Oh, please hear me out! I was doing
research at the Ruined Pinnacle, when I
was set upon by a Rathian. If I can't
finish my work, I won't be able to submit
my report to my client before the
deadline... Hunter, could you take care
of that rotten Rathian for me?

title: Airship Upgrade: Plesioth
desc:
The Plesioth's ability to move quickly
through the water could be used to
enhance the Soaratorium. Rumor has it
that there's one flitting about at the
Ruined Pinnacle. Hunter, can you do
the honors? Just take it down and
we'll harvest the materials.

title: Naked Aggression
desc:
There was a hunter in town walking
about in only his drawers! Naturally
I had to protect the townspeople,
so I questioned him. He claims a
Ceanataur ripped up his clothes!
I need you to verify his claims, and
eliminate the monster. If there is one.

title: Mushroom for Improvement
desc:
We're doing some pretty important
research here! Namely, how to make
every mealtime delicious! That's why
we need some Tall Mushrooms from
the Ruined Pinnacle. The Wycademy's
future depends on it! I admit, it's an
acquired taste...

title: I See It Rollin'...
desc:
That stupid overgrown fanged
tumbleweed! This dumb Volvidon just
won't stop trundling around after me.
If only there was some brave, strong
hunter who could teach it a lesson
once and for all... Oh...? You'll take
care of it? Seriously? How sweet!

title: It's Gonna Eat Me!
desc:
Hey, somethin' pretty bad's going
down! I was out fishin' in the Desert,
when some Nibelsnarf jerk shot out of
the ground at me! Can't fish with one of
those goofs hanging round. Take care
of it for me, will ya? I'll see you right if
you do!

title: Airship Upgrade: Nargacuga
desc:
The tough yet light scales of a
Nargacuga are perfect for reinforcing
the main and auxiliary engines!
I've got reports of one tearing up
the Jungle, so could you hunt it down?
We'll take care of recovering what
we need.

title: Wrong Bird, Idiots...
desc:
I've been under orders from the
Guild to train up some youngsters.
I thought it was high time they take
on a Yian Kut-Ku, so I put out the request
and what do I find? They went for a
Yian Garuga instead. They're idiots, but
I can't leave 'em be. Help out, eh?

title: A Trace of Light
desc:
My father used to travel the world,
but ever since he went missing all I've
had are the notes of all the adventures
he used to have... But there's one note
about glowing insects... I think he means
Great Thunderbugs, and they might be
a clue to finding him!

title: Shell Game
desc:
Hunter, Hunter! Are you familiar with
the Beautiful Shells you can find in
the Jungle? How brilliantly shiny they
are! Get me some and I'll bash 'em into
round shapes, pass 'em off as pearls
and watch the moolah roll in!
...Ahem, pretend you didn't hear that.

title: Wyvern Egg Delivery: Lunch
desc:
Oh bother, I need to find some Wyvern
Eggs before the royal luncheon! My
position as Royal Cook is at steak!
I mean stake! I mean-- look, can you
just throw me a bone here? Preferably
in egg form?

title: My New Life as a Maccao
desc:
On the way to the Ancestral Steppe,
I got noticed by a Kecha Wacha and
a Great Maccao! Yikes! Luckily, I
thought quickly and started jumping
around pretending I was a monster
too. I think it's working, but my legs
are getting tired... Help me!
objective:
Hunt a Kecha Wacha
and a Great Maccao

title: Primal Forest Arachnids
desc:
I'm gonna do what I can as Pokke
Chief to strengthen the Soaratorium
and help mine ore! Thing is, the ore's
hard to get, thanks to a little Nerscylla
infestation in the Primal Forest. Sounds
like a job for you, Hunter!

title: Much Ado about Najarala
desc:
O Hunter strong in arm and weapon
skill: Seek thou the Primal Forest's
cunning serpent; And heed ye well the
danger of his coils; That ye may
capture this fell beast alive. And in the
taking of thy monstrous prize, return
thee here to sate my curious eyes.
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Bloof!
desc:
Ahhh, I want to see one so badly. What?
A Zamtrios, of course! What else would
I want to see? One second it's spiky
and mean, the next...BLOOF!
Completely round! Hunt one down and
I'll, er, just watch from the sidelines.

title: A Seaway Just for You
desc:
My acquaintance says that hunters
freeze up with happiness when
they encounter their target.
Naturally, I was inclined to discover
whether there was any truth to this.
Would you mind going to the Frozen
Seaway to demonstrate for me?

title: A Cure for Laziness
desc:
I don't wanna get outta bed... Mom
yelled at me and the world sucks and
no one understands how hard it is.
But you know, if someone hunted an
Uragaan in the Volcanic Hollow, I might
be inspired to get outta bed.
(Hehe, maybe if I'm not napping.)

title: The Furtilizer That Time Furgot
desc:
The trick to purrlantin' the best
veggies, youngster, is not to skimp on
the furtilizer! And do you know where
the best furtilizer comes from? That's
right: the Jurassic Frontier! Immortal
moths, 'bout ten should do it. Watch
out fur the Nargacuga though!

title: Just Deserts
desc:
Well, I say! I was crossing the Dunes
when I was accosted by a Nibelsnarf
and a Cephadrome! Not only was it
jolly scary but now I'm simply COVERED
in sand! I can't be seen in public like
this! I say, are you in the revenge biz?
Fancy slaying some monsters?
objective:
Hunt a Nibelsnarf
and a Cephadrome

title: The Perils of Commerce
desc:
A Felyne helping my sister out has
got himself in a bit of a pickle! At the
Verdant Hills he gathered up some
goods for her to sell, but stumbled
into a Najarala's neighborhood!
I don't like to press you, but could
you come to the Felyne's rescue?

title: Khezu Deserve It
desc:
Oooof. Me shoulders are givin' me
trouble again. You know what I need?
One of them electric shock sacs. Yes,
a nice electric massage should do
the trick. Could you hunt me a Khezu
at the Arctic Ridge?

title: Whiteout
desc:
Hey, Hunter! I got a message from a
noble from my country, who's hemmed
in by a Blangonga, and out of food and
fuel. I need you to go and take care of
that monstrosity. Can you help me,
Hunter?

title: Fishing's Lure
desc:
Nothin' beats fishing. It's just like being
a kid again! You should take a load off
and catch some Goldenfish. You'll find
a glimmer of the good ol' days in the
glitter of water in the Misty Peaks!

title: A Royal Rumble
desc:
Pardon my discretion, my good hunter,
but my liege lord -- who shall remain
nameless -- desires a live queen of his
own. I fear I am not up to the task, but I
cannot refuse his request.
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: The Way of the Nargacuga
desc:
I've just had a flash of inspurration
for a new technique! But I'll need to
take a look at the movements of a
Nargacuga... Could you hunt one fur
me? I'll watch you fight and that should
give me all the refurence I need!

title: Deserted Island Missive
desc:
This is my last hope. Been attacked
by a Malfestio and Tetsucabra on
Deserted Island. Am hiding in the
forest. Have given this note to a
friendly Moofah in the vain hope it'll
end up in the right hands. Please help.
And feed the Moofah, he's a good boy.
objective:
Hunt a Malfestio
and a Tetsucabra

title: Perfectly Normal Rock
desc:
Bloomin' 'eck I got a right old surprise!
I heard there was a big rock needin'
movin' out in the Marshlands, but when
I went to move it wi' my prodigious
strength, turned out ter be a Basarios...
I think this might be a job fer you!

title: Marshlands Horror Story
desc:
I was walking in the Marshlands when
I smelled something really weird. I ran
to a cave, but inside there was this
strange dry rustling nearby and getting
closer. And once it was directly above
me, the sound stopped...
-- Here the record ends --
objective:
Hunt a Shogun Ceanataur
and a Congalala

title: Airship Upgrade: Lavasioth
desc:
Lavasioth live in molten rock, so their
shells are just the thing for insulating
the outer parts of the Soaratorium.
You're sure to find some up at the
Volcano. If you take care of the hunting,
we'll take care of the gathering!

title: It's Not Uragaan's, It's Mine!
desc:
Hiya Hunter! We got a bit of a problem
here. It's volcano season, which is
better than it sounds, because all the
good ore comes out! Yay! Sadly, an
Uragaan has come out too, and it's
kinda terrorizing the miners! Can you
help keep them safe?

title: Volcanic Vexations
desc:
Don't you just hate it when two
monsters pop up at once and throw
you off your game? I mean, which
one do you hunt first!? Anyway,
I hate being decisive, so I'm gonna
give YOU the chance to get decisive
on them...permanently.
objective:
Hunt a Basarios
and an Iodrome

title: Rathalos Topping
desc:
Calling all elite hunters! I'd like
for you to hunt a Rathalos at the
recently discovered location we
call the Ruined Pinnacle. If it's not
too much trouble, that is. And you
don't have to be particularly elite
either...

title: Taming of the Zinogre
desc:
O Hunter sharp in mind and weapon
true; Atop the Ruined Pinnacle it lies;
A thund'rous beast with claws as sharp
as steel, so proud and golden in its
regal stride. Take it captive, Hunter,
like my heart, and let its bloody
splendor here impart.
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Ore d'Oeuvres
desc:
Our team crash-landed on the
Ruined Pinnacle, no thanks to a
Gravios. Then it started eating
our research samples because
its primary food source is ore!
Could you help us out here?
It's actually embarrassing...

title: Ruined and Tarnished
desc:
The Wycademy research team that
went to the Ruined Pinnacle bumped
into a Gore Magala! They're safe
for now, but there's no telling for
how long! Please, Hunter, you have
to do something, for their sake!

title: Desert Death Duel
desc:
We set out in pursuit of new land
to reclaim, when all of a sudden,
THWAM! A Glavenus hit us out of
nowhere. But come wind or city-
leveling monster, we're not giving
up our dream! Come, fellow settlers!
Today, we make history!

title: Fearful Symmetry
desc:
Guah ha ha! We figured you might
be interested in picking up some of
our slack. It's a Tigrex hunt in the
Desert. How about it, Scrawn? We'd
go, but our bowels are moving in the
opposite direction if ya know what
I mean! Bah ha-- hurgh...

title: The Fly in the Ointment
desc:
We were investigating whether rumors
of giant cooperative insects are true,
and our specimens got away. They
flew towards the Jungle. Rumors are
true! Great day for science! Terrible
day for scientists! HELP!

title: Lagiacrus x Width x Height
desc:
EUREKA! I have it! The volume
of any object, no matter how
large, can be gauged by how
much water it displaces! Yes,
even a Lagiacrus! Don't believe
me? Then hunt me one and I'll
prove it to you!

title: Whatdunnit
desc:
A series of assaults on peddlers
in the Jungle, each occurring on a
cloudless day? With multiple reports
of thunderous roaring and an eerie
glow? The culprit you are looking
for...is a Zinogre! And I shall prove it
by having you hunt it!

title: Soap Opera
desc:
Hunter, I ask this on behalf of all
the chiefs in this region: Please
hunt the Mizutsune blocking our
trade routes. I hope the reward is
of interest to you. (Ugh, the stress.
Once the market's back, I'm going
on the BIGGEST shopping spree...)

title: Mt. Duramboros
desc:
I live to hike. To date, I've climbed to
every mountain there is in the known
world. But then my friend told me that
the Duramboros is basically a moving
mountain. She's right, of course. Now,
I can't move mountains...but I believe
you can, Hunter!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: A Jungle Just for You
desc:
My acquaintance says that hunters
become awfully flustered when
fighting two monsters at once.
Naturally, I was inclined to discover
whether there was any truth to this.
So, how about you jaunt along to
the Jungle to demonstrate for me?
objective:
Hunt a Yian Garuga
and a Plesioth

title: Flappy Pest
desc:
Why does this keep happening!?
Now there's a big flappy Astalos in
the way of the ship! Just...argh! Well,
good thing we can outmaneuver it.
Quick, to the Ancestral Steppe! And
steppe on it!

title: Pheromone Moans
desc:
Now, I was lookin' ta inspect me some
bug pheromones so I could make my
bees down at the apiary happy, but I
need 'em fresh. Real fresh. I'm talkin'
straight from the Seltas Queen. So
I'd be real grateful if ya could rustle
her up from the Primal Forest.
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Primal Panic
desc:
Urgently requesting help in
Primal Forest. Gore Magala
identified near area frequented
by villagers. Some injuries
sustained. Immediate hunter
action required.

title: Distress Signal
desc:
Mayday! Mayday! Anyone who
can hear my voice, send help
to the Primal Forest at once!
A pair of Nerscylla have me
in their web. Cripes, they're
looking right at me! I'm in
a sticky situation here!

title: Airship Upgrade: Barioth
desc:
Barioth maintain high levels
of energy even in the coldest
of environments. If we used the
materials from a Barioth to
reinforce our ship's hull, it should
be able to withstand the extreme
altitudes of the Ruined Pinnacle!

title: Snow Joke
desc:
I got in a fight recently, and I kinda
lost. But I heard that if you eat the
snow off a Gammoth, you get super
strong! I wanna be able to stomp
around and make earthquakes too!
Can you catch me a Gammoth, Hunter-
person? Can you can you can you?
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Ruler of the Frozen Seaway
desc:
What I saw... It was like
terror incarnate -- jaws
wide open, lunging at a
poor Popo. Just thinking
about it stiffens my
whiskers. Someone put an
end to this nightmare!

title: An Ice Surprise
desc:
I was tearing up the tundra on my sled
in the Frozen Seaway when these two
Zamtrios leaped right through the ice.
KRACK! I purractically jumped out of
my fur! Can some brave hunter skate
in to help?

title: You're under a Rath
desc:
Nyahoo! That's my stage name,
dont'cha know! I had a spangly
costume to go with it, but it got
stolen. It'll be in Rathalos territory
now... But it's okay -- my "totally
platonic friend" is getting it back!
So, can you hunt us the Rathalos?

title: Capture the Agnaktor
desc:
To understand the Agnaktor, you must
understand the volcano. The two are
inseparable. You must also understand
the havoc it wreaks, and our duty to
prevent it from reaching our homes.
Yes, we suspect you're really going to
need your wits about you for this one!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Great, Glavenus Again
desc:
Well, Valstrax's coming promised
despair and destruction and we're not
being disappointed. Another Glavenus
is back and terrorizing the Wycademy!
We have no one else to rely on,
I'm afraid, but we need to get this
menace away from my village!

title: Desert Double Act
desc:
The Tigrex roars.
   The Volvidon rolls.
Two girls implore:
   Please save our souls!
Two Dune-bound hunts.
   Two monsters slain.
We know you can. So end their reign!
objective:
Hunt a Tigrex
and a Volvidon

title: Alas, Astalos Again
desc:
Kokoto has a problem -- we got an
Astalos on the asta-loose, and I need
it to get asta-lost. I don't know if this
is to do with those creepy ancient
writings you guys found, but I do know
you're the only Wycademy hunter
around who can take care of it.

title: Interruption: Eggstra Delivery
desc:
Oh what? She's charging off on another
Quest and neglecting her Guild Gal
duties? Well, I can't say it's a huge
surprise. Can you please yank her
out of trouble again? She's delivering
Wyvern Eggs because she's insane.
Sorry to ask this of you again...

title: Once upon a Barioth
desc:
I heard a legend when I was a kid of
a ghostly wyvern, and I've been
following that ghost all these years.
My sleuthing tells me that it must live
somewhere in a land of ice and snow...
What I need you for is to capture it.
I'll take care of the songwriting duties.
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Groan, Gammoth Again
desc:
I had a bad feeling ever since that
Valstrax monster showed up. And now
here we are, with a rampaging
Gammoth back to finish the job he
started earlier... Hunter, I don't like my
people being in danger. Can you hunt
this Gammoth for me and Pokke?

title: Snowball Skirmish
desc:
Mi-hao, Hunter! I'm betting with the
Wyverian merchant man about which is
tougher: a snowball thrown by a
Blangonga or one thrown by a Lagombi.
Can you go to the Arctic Ridge and
hunt them both, maybe take a few
snowballs for the team? Miao!
objective:
Hunt a Blangonga
and a Lagombi

title: Man, Mizutsune Again?
desc:
Our prayers do not seem to have
repelled these comets' dark designs.
Once more, a Mizutsune threat has
descended upon our village...
You will not hesitate to remove
this monster from our vicinity.

title: Sky Tribe: Rice to the Occasion
desc:
Ahoy! I'm thinking of treating the
Soaratorium crew to our special
Hunting Fleet Fisherman's Rice, and
the stuff I need's on the Deserted
Island. O' course, a Lagiacrus is lurking
there too, so you'll need to take care
of that. Cheers, pally!

title: Wish upon a...Gravios?
desc:
Well, our able hands went off to
look for this fallen star for you
Wycademy folk, but it looks like
we wound up aggravatin' a Gravios
instead! Could ya lend 'em a hand?
I'd help ya, kiddo, but I'm busy
battling the lumbago myself!

title: Earn Your Gear
desc:
If you want new equipment...you have
to prove...prove that you're strong
enough...
Duramboros...in the Marshlands...
If you're not strong enough...
you'll fail.

title: You Had One Job
desc:
Turns out those newbie hunters of mine
have the worst luck I've ever seen.
Sent them to hunt a Lavasioth and they
end up aggravating an Agnaktor as
well. I mean, they don't look even
remotely the same, right? Is it just me?
Anyway, can you help them out again?
objective:
Hunt an Agnaktor
and a Lavasioth

title: Disaster on the Steppes
desc:
I wandered into a Seltas nest while out
looking for Herbs... I chased off an
insect blocking my way, which angered
a hungry Kecha Wacha... THEN I saw
smoke far off and thought I was saved,
but it was just Gore Magala scales!
Help me, I'll do anything! Heeelp!

title: Jurassic Frontier Fracas
desc:
Seriously, what is up with the Jurassic
Frontier these days? Monsters tearing
about here, rolling all over there...
How am I supposed to gather fresh
ingredients for medicine with all this
going on!? Do you reckon you could
thin the numbers a little bit?

title: Just a Mirage...?
desc:
You gotta come quick! I spotted a
Gendrome in the Dunes, then a Barroth
came out of a sandstorm, then I heard
a roar and a Tigrex showed up!
We don't have enough people to
defend the settlement if they attack!

title: Trouble Comes in Threes
desc:
We've got three very much unwanted
visitors at our mine, in the form of an
Iodrome, a Basarios and a Gravios!
They started going crazy the moment
they arrived, I feel like I'm watching
a volcano erupting! Can you hotfoot
it over here and help?

title: Impossible Standards
desc:
One night, as I left the ballroom,
I saw through the mist a silvery
creature... And how majestic it was!
No dress could hope to match its
beauty! Please, somebody hunt that
wondrous beast and let me look
upon its effulgent radiance again!

title: My Kirin for a Horse
desc:
My meowster is a tad...deluded.
He thinks he's this famous knight,
you see. Just earlier he spied a Kirin,
said, "that seems like a suitable mount"
and tried to drag it off! Could you
just slay it so he'll give up already?

title: Beware the Comet of Disaster
desc:
Friend, it's time to settle things with
Valstrax! Each and every one of us
will keep a close eye on you from
the Soaratorium. Please...win this
thing and come back alive!

title: Beware the Comet of Disaster
desc:
Friend, it's time to finally settle things
with Valstrax! Each and every one of
us will keep a close eye on you from
the Soaratorium. Please...win this
thing and come back alive!
objective: Slay a Valstrax or repel it

title: The Baleful Comet
desc:
"A baleful comet, crimson-bright:
   the terrible Valstrax!
   The hunter gathers all his might,
   And seeks the monster's tracks-"
Well? What are you waiting for? You
heard the song! I can't finish it unless
the hunter (that's you) actually goes!
objective: Slay a Valstrax or repel it

title: Turn That Frown Upside Down
desc:
I heard that a comet landed in the
Frozen Seaway and thought it might
finally be a bit of good news for me.
But just my luck -- it turned out to be
a merciless dragon from an ancient
age. Great. Could you maybe...take
care of it for me?
objective: Slay a Valstrax or repel it

title: An Almost-Certainly-Fine Comet
desc:
Oh jeez, a comet fell in the Jurassic
Frontier. I'll bet that's the omen of
doom everyone's been talking about.
I'm sure it's fine, but just in case it's
some kind of ancient, vicious dragon,
would you mind going to check up
on it for me?
objective: Slay a Valstrax or repel it

title: Deviljho Dispossession
desc:
The other merchants and I have been
discussing how to source the stone
from the Ruined Pinnacle. One of the
*ahem* biggest barriers is a Deviljho
roaming about. We just can't get near!
Commerce demands you hunt the
beast so we can get at the stone!

title: Thousand-Blade Brouhaha
desc:
E-erm... I'm just a novice, but I was
in the Desert earlier trying to gather
stuff... But there was this big Seregios
flapping about and...well, let's just say
it was a close call. I think maybe
someone with a bit more skill should
take care of it?

title: Duel With the Devil
desc:
Diablos regularly attack the border
wall, but this time the Border Captain
was injured! With the chain of command
broken we had no choice but to
withdraw. Somebody needs to deal
with that Diablos!

title: Roar of the Rajang
desc:
Memo to research team.
Rajang sighted in the Desert. Subject
previously considered too dangerous
to apprehend, but research team now
requested to proceed to Desert and
engage with maximum available force.

title: Wyvern Egg Delivery: Dinner
desc:
I have an urgent request!
If I do not serve Herbivore Eggs
at the upcoming banquet, I'll
be fired -- as in literally set on
fire! Save me from becoming
the main course and you'll be
amply rewarded!

title: Red Dragon, Green Dragon
desc:
My mom's sick, and there's some
herbs in the Ancestral Steppe that'll
make her better! But I can't go
'cause a Rathalos and Rathian couple
just built their nest there! Mom's
gonna get worse if we don't do
something! Please!
objective:
Hunt a Rathalos
and a Rathian

title: Primal Panic
desc:
Urgently requesting help in
Primal Forest. Rajang identified
inflicting destruction on plants and
animals alike. Whole ecosystem
could be in danger. Immediate
hunter action required.

title: A Cure for Idleness
desc:
Dad's been flipping out at me, but
I just can't put my mind to studying.
I don't think I can concentrate until
someone hunts down a Seregios
at the Volcanic Hollow for me...
(Ha! I'll never have to study now!)
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Bad Hair Day: Brachydios
desc:
Oh baby, I've found it: the
burning inspiration I've
been longing for! Let me
give you a clue: It has an
EXPLOSIVE pompadour. That's
right, the Brachydios! Now go
do that voodoo that you do!

title: Bring Me My Sword
desc:
Ah, nary a soul who undertook this
Quest has returned in success. It's truly
tragic that none are up to the task in
this day and age. What's the world
coming to! Surely, there must be one
who will step up to the challenge?

title: Horned and Dangerous
desc:
We've confirmed a sighting of the
winged, twin-horned Diablos from
the watchtower. A caravan will be
passing by there soon, too, and it'll
be a real mess if they encounter that
beast. Can you capture it and make
the Dunes safe for commerce?
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Deviljho Food Cake
desc:
Please, someone help! A Deviljho's
taken a liking to our family home and
it won't stop eating things! If we can't
get it away it'll swallow up the whole
house, and my family's in there!
I need it to bite the dust before it
takes a big bite out of my house!

title: Barioth's Blizzard
desc:
Indeed, it was a strange thing. A pair
of white devils at the Arctic Ridge...
A pair, can you believe! We sent out
a party to take care of them, but only
one made it back. Someone else can
take this job. I don't get paid enough
for this...

title: Bag a Brachydios
desc:
We've been researching the Brachydios
for some time now, but it's still a
creature draped in mystery. However,
one thing of which we can be certain,
is that it's a totally unique beast. Could
you capture one for us so that we can
press closer to its enigma?
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Wheel of Time
desc:
There's a song in my village
of a traveler who traversed
time itself. That traveler,
it would seem, is an elder
dragon. And it's homecoming
time. Protect my home and my
people, I beg of you.

title: Coalition of Chaos
desc:
Hunter, I ask this on behalf of all the
chiefs in this region: Please rid us of
the scourges destroying our fields.
Our foes number three. A Gypceros,
a Rathian, and a Yian Garuga. (Ugh, the
stress. Once this is over I'm going to
take a nice stroll through the fields.)

title: Verdant Hills Just for You
desc:
My acquaintance says hunters cry
with happiness whenever they find
new prey. Naturally, I was inclined to
discover whether there was any truth
to this. Would you mind going to the
Verdant Hills to demonstrate for me?

title: Misty Peaks Missive
desc:
Expedition ruined. Attacked by Royal
Ludroth and Plesioth, blown by
Duramboros tail into the heart of the
Misty Peaks. Have entrusted this note
to a friendly Gargwa in the vain hope
that it falls into friendly hands.
Worst expedition.

title: Deserted Islands Horror
desc:
One day as I was on my way to the
Deserted Island I heard thunder from
a cloudless sky. An unsettling blue light
leached color from the forest... What
was that sound? ...So sleepy...
