-- Here the record ends --

title: The Marshlands Morass
desc:
While researching in the Marshlands
I was attacked by a Congalala, so I ran
for it! I felt a tug on my foot and knew
I was done for. I find myself caught
up in a shadowy spider web. And then
I hear slithering all around me. Well, out
of the frying pan, into the fire...

title: Grave Peril
desc:
Memo to the research team.
Nakarkos sighted at Wyvern's End.
All available hunters have been
mobilized, but to no avail. Research
team is requested to proceed to
Wyvern's End and eliminate the threat.

title: King of Hellfire
desc:
Memo to research team.
Researchers investigating Ingle Isle
under threat from wild Akantor. Threat
level extremely high. Research team
requested to proceed to Ingle Isle
with alacrity and eliminate the Akantor.

title: The Seat of a God
desc:
Memo to research team.
Large-scale collapse of iceberg
reported in Polar Field. Dragonwatch
reports collapse due to nesting
Ukanlos. Research team requested
to remove Ukanlos using all force at
their disposal.

title: Stormlord
desc:
Memo to research team.
Amatsu sighted at Sacred Pinnacle.
Reports of it already causing
widespread storm damage in the
area. Research team requested to
proceed to Sacred Pinnacle and
eliminate the threat.

title: Blazing Black of a Dark God
desc:
Memo to research team.
Unforeseen disaster occurred,
total destruction of area imminent
without Wycademy intervention.
Proceed to Ingle Isle immediately
to render aid.

title: Advanced: Ranging Rathalos
desc:
Been gettin' word of a Rathalos
circling the Verdant Hills, and this
one's way stronger than your
average Rathalos... Eventually it's
gonna approach the village, so I want
you to take it out before it causes any
damage. Got it?

title: Advanced: Roaring in the Ridge
desc:
I've got a report that says a Tigrex
was spotted at the summit of the
Arctic Ridge, and this one's much
stronger than your average specimen.
Everybody in the village still has all
their body parts, but that doesn't mean
we're not still in danger.

title: Advanced: Moonlight Zinogre
desc:
There is a Zinogre in the Misty Peaks
whose power, I'm told, is much greater
than that of a regular specimen. It may
be most dangerous, but you would be
honored to eliminate it and keep
the villagers safe from harm.

title: Advanced: Wrong One Silver
desc:
One of my little hunter newbies has
gone off alone to hunt a Rathian. Well,
he was totally ready for it. What he
wasn't ready for was the Silver
Rathalos that showed up instead. Were
new hunters always this unlucky!?
Please, pull him out of the fire!

title: Advanced: Heart of Gold
desc:
Okay, this is embarrassing, but I took
this hunt to take care of a troublesome
Gold Rathian. Thing is, when I found
myself in front of her I was consumed
by how beautiful her golden scales
were and I couldn't do anything!
Please, hide my shame! Hunt it for me!

title: Advanced: Trial at the Pinnacle
desc:
Hoi, youngster! I can tell you about a
place nobody else knows. There the
golden sun and silver moon are always
shining day and night, and visitors
encounter a trial the likes of which
they've never seen before! So, wanna
give it a shot? Hehehehe...
objective:
Hunt a Silver Rathalos
and a Gold Rathian

title: Advanced: Steel Yourself
desc:
Hey, have you heard anything about
this steel dragon doohickey in the
Jungle? I need it. I need to make a
sword out of a dragon. I've never
needed anything more in my life. I
also need you to take care of it while
I pick up the materials, okay?
objective:
Slay a Kushala Daora
or repel it

title: Advanced: Karma Chameleos
desc:
You might think it's impossible to fight
an enemy you can't see, youngster,
but I'm here to tell you that's not the
case! You gotta connect with your life
force. Use the eyes in your heart...
And then...SMASH IT WITH EVERYTHING
YOU'VE GOT! SMASH SMASH SMASH!
objective: Slay a Chameleos or repel it

title: Advanced: Empire of the Sun
desc:
Some of our hunters haven't shown up
at their meeting point after finishing a
hunt in the Desert. We've found traces
of an explosion nearby, and fear the
worst: Teostra. We need an
experienced hunter to support the
search efforts.
objective:
Slay a Teostra
or repel it

title: Advanced: Jurassic Pair
desc:
A Glavenus has been sighted at the
Jurassic Frontier. According to the
observatory, the frontier's been seeing
many more formidable monsters than
usual. There are also reports of a Yian
Garuga up there. A tough pair, no
doubt... But if anyone can do it, you can!

title: Advanced: Quarrel Quelling
desc:
Are you kidding!? I finally found all the
paperwork and they're telling me the
trading route into the village has been
buried in an avalanche? Now I can't get
that delivery of wood to fix the broken
roofs! Stop those pesky monsters from
fighting and causing avalanches!

title: Advanced: Monster Hunter!
desc:
'Tis truly a wondrous thing to encounter
one of such might again. Upon
completion of this final hunt, you
may find your eyes opened to the
true meaning of being a hunter.

title: Advanced: Proof of a Champion
desc:
Once upon a time, there was a hunter
who sought to be honored as a
champion above all others. Do you
have the mettle to follow in their
footsteps and prove that the spirit
of the champion is alive today? Of
course you do!

title: Advanced: Wycademy Challenge
desc:
This is the culmination of decades of
work picking through ancient tomes
and tablets and translating forgotten
languages. There is a mystery at the
heart of this world, Hunter, and we
finally know where the key to it lies!
Proceed there with haste!

title: Advanced: Guild's Greatest Hit
desc:
I honestly never thought anybody
could make it this far...but a hunter's
journey never ends, and the trial I'm
about to give you is just another bump
in the road. There's nothing to fear;
get to it and show me you have what
it takes to succeed!

title: Advanced: Ultimate Generation
desc:
When suitable challengers have
appeared, the gate will be opened.
The ones you will face are
overwhelmingly powerful and fierce.
It will be a true test of strength.
Take heart, and with weapon in hand,
step forth, Hunter. Onwards!

title: Harvest Tour: Jurassic Frontier
desc:
Interested in gathering in
the Jurassic Frontier, young
Hunter? Take this Quest and
you can gather as much as
you like! Just deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket when you're
ready to come back.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Dunes
desc:
Interested in gathering in
the Dunes, young Hunter?
Take this Quest and you
can gather as much as you
like! Just deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket when you're
ready to come back.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Verdant Hills
desc:
Interested in gathering in
the Verdant Hills, young
Hunter? Take this Quest and
you can gather as much as
you like! Just deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket when you're
ready to come back.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Arctic Ridge
desc:
Interested in gathering in
the Arctic Ridge, young
Hunter? Take this Quest and
you can gather as much as
you like! Just deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket when you're
ready to come back.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Misty Peaks
desc:
Interested in gathering in
the Misty Peaks, young
Hunter? Take this Quest and
you can gather as much as
you like! Just deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket when you're
ready to come back.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Boot to the Head
desc:
Ever taken a jump kick from
a Great Maccao? I have!
It nailed me, but I got up
and wrecked it hard! You
jelly? If you think you can
do the same, then let me
see what you got!

title: Tackling the Tetsucabra
desc:
Rock hard! That just about
sums up what it's like to
fight that thing and see
your attacks bounce off
those boulders it digs up...
I give up! How about you,
though? Up for a challenge?

title: Lost in the Jurassic Frontier
desc:
My luck is so bad lately.
First a Gypceros swipes my
Book of Combos, and then a
Melynx runs off with my BBQ
Spit! At this rate, I'm gonna
have to quit hunting! Can
you help me out here!?

title: Red-Faced Ruffians
desc:
I was taking a walk when a
herd of Maccao surrounded
me! Those blood-red faces...
I was left catatonic for days!
I'm too afraid to go out on
walks now. Could you
purrlease help me, Hunter?

title: A Fern is Forever
desc:
A Wycademy kiddo found
*hiccup* a boutique urn...
I mean a *hiccup* Unique Fern!
It's bitter, yet sweet, which
would go great with my nightly
tipple. *hiccup* Be a pal and
nab me some of them, won't ya?

title: Gendrome Roadblock
desc:
I've been ferrying goods
for a big deal coming up,
only packs of Genprey keep
messing things up. I'd bet
there's an alpha behind it.
Take 'em out so my deal
won't fall through!

title: In Pursuit of the Sand Wyvern
desc:
When a Cephadrome shows
up somewhere, a bunch of
Cephalos follow suit and
wreak havoc on our trade
routes! If you take out the
Cephadrome, that should
get rid of the lot of 'em!

title: Shells of Steel
desc:
I hate to ask hunters for
help, but there's a huge
Hermitaur out in the Dunes
that just won't go down
nicely. No matter what I
do, I can't hurt it. I need
you to go after it for me.

title: Hermitaur Party
desc:
Hermitaurs are getting
to be a real pain... They
wait in the sand to ambush
us traders, and we can't get
anything done! Help us out!
Careful, though: A Daimyo
Hermitaur's been sighted, too!

title: Ingredient Hunter
desc:
I can see the desire in your
eyes... The desire for new
ingredients, miao! If you
purrcure some Tropical
Berries for me, I'll paw over
some of my special
ingredients!

title: Hunt Down the Velocidrome!
desc:
My wife was in the Verdant
Hills, picking some of my
favorite mushrooms, when
she was almost attacked
by some wyverns! Please,
make the woods safe
for her again!

title: Local Threat
desc:
Yian Kut-Ku have been going
after people all over the place,
and during my patrol earlier,
I spotted one wandering close
to town. That curious bugger
must be after some Konchu.
Can you get rid of it?

title: Financial Focus on Fungus
desc:
Mushrooms from the Verdant
Hills are suddenly in high
demand. If you gather me
20, I'll give you a cut of
the profits. Oh, I heard
that Gypceros hang around
there, so stay sharp!

title: Farming Frustrations
desc:
The Velociprey that live up
in them there Verdant Hills
are a real annoyance, going
after our livestock and just
being downright ornery. Put
a hurtin' on 20 fer me, will ya?
Just be careful of their boss!

title: Snow with Occasional Lagombi
desc:
[REPORT BEGINS] Lagombi
spotted in the Arctic
Ridge [STOP] Requesting
support from all qualified
hunters [STOP] We are
snowed in and cannot render
assistance [REPORT ENDS]

title: Preying on Giaprey
desc:
I've got bad news: A pack
of Giaprey is going after
our villagers and they
need to be stopped! If
some kind hunter is up
for taking out 20 of the
beasts, that'd be great!

title: Special Home Brew
desc:
My artisanal home brews
steeped in Mountain Herbs
are the epitome of liquid
refreshment! I want to make
more, but I've run out of
herbs! I need a refill stat,
so go pick me 20, okay?

title: Bulldrome of the Peaks
desc:
Gah! I was on my way back
from some nice hot springs
when BAM! I'm surrounded
by Bulldrome -- angry ones!
Visiting the inside of a gullet
wasn't on my itinerary! Help
get me outta here!

title: The Ingredient of Legend
desc:
I have tracked down a legendary
ingredient in ze Misty Peaks!
Keep ze Arzuros busy, and I
will purrcure ze ingredient!
Then we will be un paw de plus
to a legendary dish!

title: Royal Spit Take
desc:
Ick! I got splattered with
weird gunk that sapped my
Stamina, so I couldn't
even run! Luckily, a Felyne
came by and saved me,
but now whenever I see
anything yellow...urgh!

title: A Mother's Woes
desc:
My son can't stop wetting
the bed! I figure I can at
least stop having to dry
his sheets every day if I
can make a cover out of
absorbent Ludroth parts...
Please get some for me!

title: Jaggi Junket
desc:
Are you going to the Misty
Peaks? How about we
make it interesting, and
see how many Jaggi you
can slay? I like to make all
my retainers compete that
way. Come on, it'll be fun!

title: The Next Best Thing
desc:
My sweetheart just adores
flowers, so it came to me:
Why not give him a Balm-
stone? The scent of flowers
in your pocket! You must
find me one! But, I suppose
pieces would do just as well.

title: Harvest Tour: Deserted Island
desc:
Interested in gathering at
the Deserted Island? Take
this Quest and you can
gather as much as you
like! Just deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket when you're
ready to come home.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Marshlands
desc:
Interested in gathering in
the Marshlands, young
Hunter? Take this Quest and
you can gather as much as
you like! Just deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket when you're
ready to come back.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Insomnia? Meet Hypnotism
desc:
My husband's got insomnia.
Over the years, I've tried
knocking him out to get him
to sleep, but it turned out
that's not a great idea...
So I want you to capture a
Malfestio to hypnotize him!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Walk 'n Roll
desc:
At times a ball of crimson,
at times a lumbering, four-
legged beast -- one of the
Frontier's many terrors:
Volvidon! Go now, young
hunter. You know what
to do!

title: Rocking Rhenoplos
desc:
The people here are gettin'
rammed by Rhenoplos
whenever they leave the
village. They told me to
take care of them, but
you look strong enough.
Go hunt some for me!
objective:
Slay 10 before time expires
or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
failure:
Reward hits 0, or time
expires before slaying 10

title: The Desert Gourmand
desc:
One minute I was rattlin' along
the Dunes in me barrel buggy,
mindin' me own. And then,
RAAARRR! Cart goes flyin'
-- and me with it! What
gives!? The barrel business is
s'pposed t'be safe, by gum!

title: Tongue-Tied
desc:
Yo, Hunter! Long tongues
are weird, y'know what I'm
sayin'? Especially Volvidon
ones! But, y'know, it'd be
interesting to see just how
long they can get... I know!
Go capture me one!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: The Poison-fanged Duo
desc:
Two new alphas joined the
Genprey in the Dunes, and
now the whole pack of 'em
are acting up, and people
are gettin' attacked! Time
to downsize these bosses
-- go wipe the pair out!

title: Konchu Collector
desc:
The Konchu is a most
fascinating creature -- a
bug of many metamorphoses!
Attack it and watch it switch
into defensive mode for
evasive action. I need more
specimens for my research!

title: Liver of Legend!
desc:
While doing some business
out in the Dunes, I heard
about a route where livers
go for a really high price.
I can't ignore the scent of
zenny to be made, so hurry
and get me eight livers.

title: Noise Violation
desc:
The Najarala around the
village is making some
pawful sounds! Does it
think it's some kind of
mewsician? Hunter,
make it shut up before
it drives me up the wall!

title: In Search of the Yian Garuga
desc:
In researching the mysteries
of the Garuga King, I've come
to the theory that the Yian
Garuga is the key to solving
it all. Hunt me one, and your
name will go down in history!
Under mine, of course.

title: Finishing the Job
desc:
My appurrentice in Pokke
Village is in fur a world of
trouble! Can't even beat a
Velociprey, and she agreed
to hunt Velocidrome -- two!
To avoid catastrophe, can
you go hunt them instead?

title: Fresh is Best
desc:
I need you to procure some
groceries for me. To be
specific, I want meat, and
you can get plenty off some
Bullfango. Think you can
go to the Verdant Hills
and hunt me 20 of them?

title: The Shadow in the Mountains
desc:
We were up in the Arctic Ridge --
doing a little research -- when
all of a sudden, something really
creepy and gross plopped down
behind us. We managed to escape,
but we can't do any research
with that thing up there!

title: The New Tenant
desc:
A Blangonga has taken up
residence in the Arctic
Ridge, which spells
trouble for us being able
to gather firewood. Hurry
and take that ugly ape out
before we freeze to death!

title: Blango Slaying Tactics
desc:
Blango Pelts have so many
great uses. In particular,
their insulation properties
keep you toasty in snow!
So could you hunt me 20
Blangos? Thanks! Oh, and
watch out for Bulldrome!

title: Operation: Secure Specimen
desc:
My boss from hell is making
me write up a report on
Nargacuga eating habits!
No way can I do that on my
own! Can you go capture
one for me, Hunter? I'll...
I'll get the cage ready!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Royal Assassination
desc:
The Misty Peaks aren't safe
for normal travelers now
that a Rathian's built her
nest there. Can you do
something about her so
people like me can pass
through there in peace!?

title: Ahoy! Royal Ludroth!
desc:
Shimpai... I worried because
no hear word from Felyne
carrying Neko's luggage!
If it met Royal Ludroth,
all that water would...
Taihen! Please shuryo them!
"Shuryo" means hunt!

title: Bye Bye Jaggia
desc:
Jaggi are awful, am I right?
Well, Jaggia are even
worse! And now a
gang of 'em are terrorizing
the Misty Peaks! Please,
put a stop to them before
they come ruin our crops!

title: Malfestio Festival
desc:
selacs s'oitseflaM !gnizamA
lortnoc esol uoy ekam yllaer
tsum ylpmis I !ydob ruoy fo
,esaelP !selpmas erom evah
!em rof emos hctef
...Though the effects seem
to be short-lived. *sigh*

title: Wyvern of the Wind
desc:
The Nargacuga out on the
Deserted Island is scarily
fast. Blink and you'll miss
it. But, Hunter, it's gotta
go! There's nothing more
important right now than
hunting it, so get to it!

title: Tetsucabra Bounty
desc:
Oh, the horror! Oh, the
zenny! Apparently, a
Tetsucabra is making a mess
of some newly developed
land. Big reward on its
head, I hear. Help me and
we'll split it fifty-fifty!

title: Deserted Island Dustup
desc:
I'm reporting live from the
Deserted Island, where two
Arzuros have decided to
discuss their differences like
civilized monsters. Oh, who
am I kidding? Run for your lives!
Women and reporters first!

title: Bnahabra Bloodbath
desc:
What, you expect me to wear
some old sad sack to the
big soiree tonight? I wanna
feel pretty! I need Bnahabra
material to make that happen.
So... Uh, hello? Help me
make that happen already!

title: Poisonous Pest
desc:
Ioprey storming our village,
we can handle. But their
poison ruining our crops!?
That's our livelihood! Take
out the big ugly one, and
the rest of them should
get the hint and leave!

title: Pincer through the Sky
desc:
A Shogun Ceanataur's moved
into the Marshlands recently
and it's attacking people and
livestock alike. We're at our
wit's end here! We need you
to go hunt it down!

title: Serpentine Samba
desc:
My huntin' is near as bad as
my dancin', but my little
sis? Best moves in the
tribe! I wanna make her a
costume of serpent scales
for the big festival. Could
ya help me bag a big snake!?

title: Ioprey Hunting
desc:
Got a second? I was out
working in the Marshlands
when a bunch of Ioprey
popped up out of nowhere!
If you could hunt 20 of them
for me, I could get back to
work!

title: Attack of the Giant Bugs!
desc:
My village is being plagued
by giant bugs. If you could
squash 50 of them, that'd
help us a lot. But keep
your guard up! Those bugs
are tough in groups and
a Najarala's nearby, too!

title: Collect to Combine
desc:
Passion is important, but a
true combiner knows that
the key to quality combining
is having fresh materials! So
how 'bout you pick me, say,
20 Unique Mushrooms from
the Marshlands? Sound good?

title: Harvest Tour: Volcano
desc:
Interested in gathering in
the Volcano, young Hunter?
Take this Quest and you
can gather as much as you
like! Just deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket when you're
ready to come back.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Flames of Glavenus Passion
desc:
People only care about the
Glavenus's tail, but me?
I'm way more into that
lava it breathes! How does
its body make that stuff!?
I want you to hunt it and
find that out for me!

title: Tigrex by the Tail
desc:
I've got a distress signal
from a hunter in the Jurassic
Frontier who's run into a
Tigrex! Anyone who finds
this message is requested
to head there and take it
down ASAP!

title: Dark Wings, Dark Work
desc:
Beneath the azure skies of
the Jurassic Frontier lurks a
mysterious monster cloaked
in black. Writhing in pain,
it glares from unseen eyes.
The hunter or the hunted:
Which will you be?

title: Fossilized Memories
desc:
Could you help me gather
some Eternal Fossils for a
fellow merchant in the
Jurassic Frontier? If you
do, I'll hook you up with
a soft toy that can help
you fall asleep!

title: A Thousand Scales of Dread
desc:
Breaking news from the
Elder Hall: A Seregios has
shown up in the Dunes!
Any and all skilled hunters
are asked to help hunt
it as soon as possible.
Beware its blades!

title: A Shocking Scoundrel
desc:
Sounds like an Astalos
showed up in the Verdant
Hills. It may be pretty for
a monster, but don't be
fooled: its attacks are
lethal, and it won't hold
back. Go prepared.

title: The King's Domain
desc:
You hear that, Hunter? It's
the roar of a Rathalos, a
wyvern that puts fear into
even our fearless mercs.
We need that thing gone,
and it looks like you're
the best one for the job!

title: Fury Run Afoul
desc:
A shortage of food has got
a Gammoth goin' crazy up
on the ridge. No one can
sleep at night, fearin' it'll
come a-chargin' through
the walls! I beg ya, put it
down so we can rest easy!

title: Lagiacrus Lethargy
desc:
The Lagiacrus may be king
of the seas, but it's just
as scary on land. It was
all I could do to distract
the beast and hightail it
out of there... Think you
can fare any better?

title: Moonlit Bubble Bath
desc:
What a beautiful creature
that Mizutsune is. And the
way it uses bubbles to
catch its prey... You gotta
put a stop to it! What if
people slip on those bubbles
in the dark? Safety first!

title: Topple the Monarch
desc:
Many a poor soul has tried
to hunt a Zinogre, only to
end up being the one hunted
instead. It's truly worthy of
its title, "The Hunter." Isn't
there anyone who can defy it?

title: Lagiacrushed
desc:
The mighty Lagiacrus is
feared even by the most
hardened men of the sea,
and one has shown up where
our villagers fish and work!
Please, for their safety,
hunt the Lagiacrus!

title: Tuff Turf
desc:
I was training my tail off
on the Deserted Island
when, uh, I guess I kinda
sorta riled up a Zinogre.
My bad! No way I can
handle that beast. Somebody
beat it up for me!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Isle About that Bass
desc:
This time, I have a Quest for
you. You hear that rumbling
sound out of the Deserted
Island? I want to know what's
causing it. If it seems to be
something dangerous, then
I want you to eliminate it!

title: Heaven and Earth
desc:
A Rathalos and a Rathian
appeared on the Deserted
Island. Do you know just
how deadly they are when
they're together? And
during mating season, it's
suicide! Still up for the hunt?
objective:
Hunt a Rathalos
and a Rathian

title: Fro Shizzle
desc:
Oh baby, I just had the
grooviest idea: using an
Astalos's lightning to
style the ultimate 'fro!
That's right, so hit the
Marshlands and do your
thang for me, baby!

title: Bladed Glavenus
desc:
I hear there are wyverns
in this land that can wield
katanas... Where I'm from,
no such creatures exist.
How do they do it? I'd
really like to see one up
close. Capture it for me.
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Fight or Uragaan!
desc:
Don't bother readin' any
further unless you're a true
hunter -- the type who loves
that quiver in your guts when
you're livin' on the razor's
edge. Still with me? Go to the
Volcano. Somethin's waitin'.

title: The Shogun's Encampment
desc:
Did you hear that two giant
Carapaceon appeared at the
Volcano!? This is where you
hunters leap into action, yeah?
If you really are a hunter,
then you'll be first in line
to take out those beasts!

title: Crustacean Infestation
desc:
I was just minding my own
business mining stuff when
all of a sudden a Ceanataur
shows up and bends my Iron
Pickaxe clean in half!
Rude! Go defeat 20 of them
so I can resume my craft!

title: Scavengers United
desc:
I was attacked by some
monsters, but I played
dead and fooled 'em all! All
of 'em...except Uroktor
and Remobras! Please,
go out and slay them!
My pride is at stake!
objective:
Slay a total of 20
Remobra or Uroktor

title: More Coal Please
desc:
The giant lance that protects
our fortress runs on Coal,
and I hear there's plenty
at the Volcano! Can you
get some for us? If you
break all your Pickaxes, you
can always combine more!

title: An Early Jurassic Excursion
desc:
Every time I try to focus
my mind during training,
some monster or other
always attacks me. Noble
Hunter! Clear these beasts
from the Jurassic Frontier
that I may meditate in peace!

title: Wyvern Sand Runners
desc:
On hunts, your footwork must
be light, yet sturdy. That's
why I always train on the
sand! I also look to bird
wyverns and Seregios for
inspiration. Fight a few so
I can study their movements!

title: Zinogre, Bearly Fazed
desc:
Did you see that!? An
Arzuros totally just picked
a fight with that Zinogre!
Pretty reckless, I have to
say... But whatever, now
you should have the chance
to get the jump on 'em both!

title: Making it Safe for Swine
desc:
Our studies show that the
number of Mosswine in the
Marshlands has declined
due to large monsters in
the area! Please, hunt down
these beasts and protect
the noble Mosswine!

title: Rumble in the Volcano
desc:
I saw a Volvidon attacked
by a Brachydios at the
Volcano! It got away, and
now it's roaming dangerously
close to my village! Can you
hunt it for us? Keep an eye
out for the Brachydios, too!

title: It's Electric
desc:
Unexplained natural events
have been occurring deep
within the Jurassic Frontier.
Intriguing, don't you think?
I believe it's a sign of mythic
beasts, but you should go
see it with your own eyes.

title: The White Brute
desc:
My friends and I sought out
a phantom beast. When we
came upon it, we had but a
moment before it smote us
with thunder, casting us
asunder. Please help us,
Hunter.

title: The Frozen Dictator
desc:
I saw it! I know I did! A
pair of black wings among
a flurry of snow... Then a
gust of wind nearly blew
me off the mountain! Take
my advice and don't even
go near that thing!
objective:
Slay a Kushala Daora
or repel it

title: The Elder Dragon of Mist
desc:
I sensed a strong presence
and turned around, but there
was nobody there. There's
no way anything could have
sneaked up on us from our
vantage point, but still...
Keep your guard up, Hunter!
objective: Slay a Chameleos or repel it

title: Emperor of Flame
desc:
I beg of you, help me in
carrying out my last task.
I've chased a Teostra to the
Volcano. Beware its flames,
for they may roast you
alive if you are careless.
Godspeed, Hunter!
objective:
Slay a Teostra
or repel it

title: Stop the Wheel
desc:
I've only known the gods
from their legends -- never
did I expect to see one in
my lifetime. Dare you
attempt to halt the cycle
of death and etch your own
name into legend, Hunter?

title: Two-headed Carcass
desc:
Attention all hunters.
Repelling Nakarkos is now
the Wycademy's top priority.
Combine your efforts and
bring this task to fruition.
May luck be with you.

title: Harvest Tour: A. Steppe
desc:
Interested in gathering in
the Ancestral Steppe, young
Hunter? Take this Quest and
you can gather as much as
you like! Just deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket when you're
ready to come back.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

desc:

you like! Just deliver the Paw

ready to come back.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Swing into Action
desc:
That danged dirty primate,
swinging all over the place,
knocking over my cart,
hocking up mucus everywhere!
I'll be looking for a new
line of work if this keeps
up. Help me out, Hunter!

title: Ruining the Ruins
desc:
Just when I was starting
to suspect that something
was off about the Steppe, a
Yian Kut-Ku sprang from
the shadows! Help me
secure the area, Hunter,
so I can continue my work.

title: Bag the Bounding Bandit
desc:
My training is complete,
but now, monsters refuse
to draw near. My mind
and body yearn to test
their strength! Honorable
Hunter, bring me a Great
Maccao that I may challenge!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Jaggi of the Steppe
desc:
We saved up and bought
our dream plot of land near
the Ancestral Steppe, but
it's been overrun by Jaggi!
Please drive them off, or
I'll never be able to make
my dream garden!
objective:
Slay a total of 20
Jaggia or Jaggi

title: Ancestral Steppe Fungus Run
desc:
Mushroom diets are so hot
right now, and I have a lot
to lose! Be a dear and bring
me some Unique Mushrooms
from the Ancestral Steppe.
I'll be ready for swimsuit
season in no time! Tee hee!

title: Bug Appétit
desc:
Legends tell of a faraway
land where the people make
bugs into burgers. I must
partake in this culinary
adventure! Someone saw a
Seltas in the Primal
Forest. Go for it!

title: Gendrome Roadblock
desc:
I've been ferrying goods
for a big deal coming up,
only packs of Genprey keep
messing things up. I'd bet
there's an alpha behind it.
Take 'em out so my deal
won't fall through!

title: Lost in the Primal Forest
desc:
My luck is so bad lately.
First a Gypceros swipes my
Book of Combos, and then a
Melynx runs off with my BBQ
Spit! At this rate, I'm gonna
have to quit hunting! Can
you help me out here!?

title: Hunt Down the Velocidrome!
desc:
My wife, bless her heart,
went to the Primal Forest
to pick me some of my favorite
mushrooms, but was almost
attacked by wyverns! Please,
make the forest safe for her
again!

title: Poison Paralysis Pinch
desc:
Research is my life! I'm
currently studying the
differences between Poison
and Paralysis agents. Ioprey
and Genprey are perfect for
comparative analysis. Slay me
a combined total of twenty!
objective:
Slay a total of 20
Ioprey or Genprey

title: Crystal Bone Collector
desc:
Crystal Bones are a source of
crucial data about ancient
organisms and even modern
biological phenomena! Please
find me some to further my
research, but don't forget to
take a Pickaxe!

title: Hair of the Dog
desc:
Dad was supposed to play
outside with me today, but
he said his head hurts! He
said that some Slagtoth Oil
could cure his "hanged dover"
quick! Can you find us
some? I wanna go play!

title: Tackling the Tetsucabra
desc:
Rock hard! That just about
sums up what it's like to
fight that thing and see
your attacks bounce off
those boulders it digs up...
I give up! How about you,
though? Up for a challenge?

title: So Notable: Great Maccao
desc:
You've seen Great Maccao
hopping around on their tails
and throwing punches, right?
My notebook hasn't! At least,
not until you go hunt two of
them for me so I can make
an accurate sketch!

title: The Land Sharq
desc:
Argh, my wagon just got
marooned in the Dunes!
Now, I haven't seen anything
fishy out here -- yet -- but I
just know there's something
waiting to get at my stuff!
Find it and let 'em have it!

title: Shells of Steel
desc:
I hate to ask hunters for
help, but there's a huge
Hermitaur out in the Dunes
that just won't go down
nicely. No matter what I
do, I can't hurt it. I need
you to go after it for me.

title: Birds of a Feather
desc:
The Verdant Hills are littered
with fiery goo and poison. The
culprits are obvious, but we
can't let them roam around
freely. Forgive us, Hunter,
but we ask you to please
eliminate these two threats.
objective:
Hunt a Yian Kut-Ku
and a Gypceros

title: Bullfango Brigade
desc:
What's that? A pack of
Bullfango in the Verdant
Hills!? That would mean
no one can approach the
area for fear of their lives!
Hunter, you're up!

title: Delicious White Livers
desc:
There's nothing like sharing
a drink with good friends...
Only, I forgot to bring food
to pair it with! Can you bring
me some White Livers? Just
remember not to bruise them
with bluntified weapons!

title: The Bulldrome Charges
desc:
My son wants to be a hunter
when he grows up. He tried
taking on a Bulldrome, but he
lost, of course. As his parent,
it's tough seeing him sad like
this. Can you hunt this beast
roaming the Arctic Ridge?

title: Enter the Giadrome
desc:
Giaprey are clever carnivores.
Super-fast on their feet, too. And
you know what else? They've got
a big, bad boss, called a Giadrome!
Can you show me some badass
moves that'll teach it a lesson and
send 'em all packing?

title: Snow with Occasional Lagombi
desc:
[REPORT BEGINS] Lagombi
spotted in the Arctic
Ridge [STOP] Requesting
support from all qualified
hunters [STOP] We are
snowed in and cannot render
assistance [REPORT ENDS]

title: Arzuros Encroaches
desc:
I have a field up in the
Misty Peaks. Nice and
safe... That is, until an
Arzuros showed up! Now
I'm too scared to harvest
my crops! Go beat it up
so I can get back to work!

title: Royal Spit Take
desc:
Ick! I got splattered with
weird gunk that sapped my
Stamina, so I couldn't
even run! Luckily, a Felyne
came by and saved me,
but now whenever I see
anything yellow...urgh!

title: Netting Neopterons
desc:
It's not easy for my son,
being the center of the
universe and all. The other
children are too jealous to
join him in his new hobby:
bug collecting! You there,
help my boy catch some bugs!

title: Clash of Rivals
desc:
The Arena overflow with
Bullfango and Rhenoplos.
Too much for little Cha-
Cha! And if they breaka-lake
the place, Cha-Cha be in
more of a pickle! Hunt-hunt
them for me... Please?
objective:
Slay a total of 30
Bullfango or Rhenoplos

title: A Powerful Team
desc:
W-What should I do? There
are so many monsters runnin'
about in the Arena! Is it 'cause
I blew my Field Horn? I mean,
I've never even seen this many
monsters in the same place
before! Help!

title: Harvest Tour: Frozen Seaway
desc:
Interested in gathering in
the Frozen Seaway, young
Hunter? Take this Quest and
you can gather as much as
you like! Just deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket when you're
ready to come back.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Volcanic Hollow
desc:
Interested in gathering in
the Volcanic Hollow, young
Hunter? Take this Quest and
you can gather as much as
you like! Just deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket when you're
ready to come back.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Deserted Island
desc:
Interested in gathering at
the Deserted Island? Take
this Quest and you can
gather as much as you
like! Just deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket when you're
ready to come home.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Marshlands
desc:
Interested in gathering in
the Marshlands, young
Hunter? Take this Quest and
you can gather as much as

objective:

desc:
Interested in gathering in
the Volcano, young Hunter?
Take this Quest and you
can gather as much as you
like! Just deliver the Paw
Pass Ticket when you're
ready to come back.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: So Notable: Kecha Wacha
desc:
When two Kecha Wacha meet,
do they just carry on as usual,
or do they break into the
craziest dance the world has
never seen? My notebook and
I need to know! I'll be waiting
for a full report!

title: Ancestral Steppe Accounting
desc:
Young Hunter, your hands
seem idle. Would you care
to busy yourself collecting
points for me in the Ancestral
Steppe? Any items are fine,
as long as you meet the
quota. Take care, now.

title: Pink Stink
desc:
Whaddaya know about the
Congas with the pink fur
in the Primal Forest? That
Congalala ringleader of
theirs just trashed 'n'
gassed my entire shop. Go
clear the air, will ya?

title: Dragon Lady
desc:
Gah! Again my cargo is kaput.
What use is guard if he guard
nothing? Always, I hire guard!
Always, I hear same story:
monster too strong! But not
immortal, yes? So, you hunt him?
I reward. We understand?

title: The Ioprey Leader
desc:
A pack of Ioprey ain't
nothin' I can't handle, but
this was a giant horde. We
would've been goners if we
didn't call off the hunt.
Take 'em down, will ya? Oh,
and mind their poison.

title: The Intelligent Malfestio
desc:
What a clever creature,
confusing its prey before it
sinks in its claws... Just
like me! A quill pen made of
one of its feathers would be
the perfect symbol of my
intelligence and class!

title: Serpentine Samba
desc:
My huntin' is near as bad as
my dancin', but my little
sis? Best moves in the
tribe! I wanna make her a
costume of serpent scales
for the big festival. Could
ya help me bag a big snake!?

title: Spotted Beauty
desc:
Beasts with lovely spots
roam the Primal Forest.
The patterns of Gendrome...
Simply breathtaking. Hunt
a few so I can see them
up close, and I'll reward
you with this Rainbow Ore.

title: Primal Forest Accounting
desc:
Young Hunter, your hands
seem idle. Would you care
to busy yourself collecting
points for me in the Primal
Forest? Any items are fine,
as long as you meet the
quota. Take care, now.

title: Fin Finder
desc:
The uneducated masses call
it a "monster Sharq." What
nonsense! It's a most
magnificent creature, able
to shift into so many
forms... I must have a
specimen for my research!

title: The Walls Have Eyes
desc:
I was in the Frozen Seaway,
I was, and that's when I felt
it -- like me blood turned ta
ice. Somethin' was a-spyin'
on me. Cross me heart and
hope ta die. Mind sussin'
out the creepy peeper?

title: Must Love Lagombi
desc:
The Frozen Seaway sounds
cold. I hate the cold! But, I
am curious about the rabbit-
like creatures that live there.
Could you hunt some for
me? No fewer than two,
please! Ta-ta, now!

title: Zamite Fight
desc:
I was out scouring the Frozen
Seaway for harvest supplies
when I was blindsided by
these big, spiky beasts! I
managed to get away, but it
haunts me still... Someone
dispatch the sneaky savages!

title: Stone-cold Stones
desc:
The Frozen Seaway beats any
tropical paradise for a
geologist like me. Every day
brings a new discovery! Did
you know it's the only place
you can find Bloodstones? I
gotta get me some of that.

title: Liver and Let Die
desc:
Lightly grilled over charcoal,
stir-fried with spicy and
sweet sauce, or boiled to
the perfect texture... Mmm...
I'm hungry just thinking about
it! Please, bring me some
delicious Monster Guts!

title: Fight or Uragaan!
desc:
Don't bother readin' any
further unless you're a true
hunter -- the type who loves
that quiver in your guts when
you're livin' on the razor's
edge. Still with me? Go to the
Volcano. Somethin's waitin'.

title: Worst. Trip. Ever!
desc:
Ugh... I think I was a little too
ambitious to try climbing the
Volcanic Hollow. I forgot my
Cool Drinks and ran out of
Stamina. Worst of all, I was
attacked by a Yian Garuga.
Somebody help me, please!

title: Tetsucabra Bounty
desc:
Oh, the horror! Oh, the
zenny! Apparently, a
Tetsucabra is making a mess
of some newly developed
land. Big reward on its
head, I hear. Help me and
we'll split it fifty-fifty!

title: Close Coal
desc:
If I don't have Coal to
roast tonight's feast, my
goose is cooked! Actually,
it won't be cooked, but I'll
still end up in hot water.
Er, not literally. Oh, just
help me, will you!?

title: Nargacuga Throwdown
desc:
This is the kind of Quest that
the G Rank hunters that used to
come to Pokke would finish
in their SLEEP! You look like
you're at least half-awake,
so it should be no sweat
for you! Good luck!

title: Insomnia? Meet Hypnotism x 2
desc:
My wife gave me a Malfestio
to help me deal with insomnia,
but one doesn't seem to be
enough. I'm also afraid that
using two at once may have
some ill side effects. Could
you test it out for me?

title: Brute of the Sands
desc:
My weapon...bounced off its
hide like a toy. That thing
moved...so fast. Before I
knew it...I was knocked cold.
The Medicine Man says it's...
just a scratch, but the pain!
Avenge my flesh wound!

title: The Desert Gourmand
desc:
One minute I was rattlin' along
the Dunes in me barrel buggy,
mindin' me own. And then,
RAAARRR! Cart goes flyin'
-- and me with it! What
gives!? The barrel business is
s'pposed t'be safe, by gum!

title: Line in the Sand
desc:
Sandboarding! It's the latest
craze! ...Or it will be, as
soon as I finish inventing it.
But I can't do anything with
these darned Cephadrome in
the way. Get rid of 'em and
I'll give you some Rainbow Ore!

title: Wrath of the Rathian
desc:
Dang Rathian! Ambushed my
caravan and tore my business
a new one! But I ain't the
gettin' mad type, I'm the
gettin' even type! Time for
some ice cold revenge, and
I want you to dish it out!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Twin Velocidrome
desc:
A pair of Velocidrome is
leading around a menacing
pack of Velociprey. If you
can take them out and help
restore peace to the
Hills, I'll give you
this Rainbow Ore!

title: The New Tenant
desc:
A Blangonga is wreaking
havoc on one of my trade
routes. Think you can take
care of it for me? Once you
do, I can give you gigantic
ladybugs that you can use
as materials for equipment!

title: A Plesioth in the Misty Peaks
desc:
A Plesioth! In the Misty
Peaks! And I would have
had it, too, if not for its
water breath and hiding in
the river all the time...
I didn't have my bathing suit!
I'll let you deal with it!

title: Awful Guest
desc:
The Loc Lac Tourism Board
will not sit idly by as this
Plesioth eats into our tourism
revenues. We would like you
to deal with this nuisance
and help our other guests
return home safely.

title: Web Sighting
desc:
I got webbed up, chewed on,
smacked around, and tossed
away like garbage! That
Nerscylla really put me
through the wringer. Someone
needs to return the favor to
that creepy cave menace!

title: Poisonous Pair
desc:
Ioprey ain't nothin' I can't
handle, but this pack had
two bosses. I couldn't pin
'em down and they got
away, but if you can take
'em down for me, I'll give
you some Rainbow Ore.

title: Attack of the Giant Bugs!
desc:
My village has a huge bug
problem. We're talkin' like
Bugtopia here! If you can
help us out by squashing
about 50 of them, that'd
help us a lot. Just watch
out for any big monsters!

title: Disruptive Eruption
desc:
What? Why, that's a... There's a
Basarios after me!? I didn't sign
up for this, you know. There's
much to be said for staying
indoors! You take care of the
Basarios, Hunter. I'll deal with
the, er... Mosswine!

title: You Caught This? I Caught This
desc:
So my brother thinks he's
the best fisher in our castle.
We'll see about that! Catch
me a Lavasioth and I can
prove him wrong! I'm a
genius! Now, off you go.
Don't keep me waiting!

title: Tumbling Troublemaker
desc:
Holy moly! Have you seen one
of those things before? I
thought it was a giant boulder
tumbling down the mountain,
but no, it was a monster comin'
to eat me! I'm not going back
there until you get rid of it!

title: Shogun in the Flames
desc:
Hours of walking through a
sweltering cave, only to find
ourselves in the Volcano,
swooped down upon by a
giant Ceanataur! We may
make weapons, but we're
still merchants. Help!

title: The Most Dangerous Game
desc:
Would you fancy a game of
Konchu dodgeball? What a
marvelous way to pass the
time... For me, of course!
There may be a red ball
tossed in there, too, but
pay it no heed, Hunter!

title: Status: Effected
desc:
For a year I researched safe
hunting practices: Antidotes,
anti-Paralysis, you name it.
The results of my research?
The safest hunt...is one
you've pushed off onto
someone else! Good luck!

title: Desert Brawlers
desc:
The Dunes are crawling with
big ol' monsters that won't
even let me NEAR the
materials I need to make
my weapons! Think you
can head out and whip
'em for me?

title: The Hunter Games
desc:
I've gathered only the most
unique monsters to display the
best tournament ever hosted.
Shockers, rollers, slicers...
Expect no shortage of
mayhem. Just try not to
embarrass yourself out there!

title: Hunt, Sweat, and Tears
desc:
I simply love the sight of
brave hunters only barely
escaping death! And this
lineup of five awful beasties
is sure to grant me just
that. Now, be a dear and
give me a good show!

title: The Lightning Crown
desc:
The Astalos's head is so
cool! Its crest looks like
some kind of crown. Man,
I'd love to see it up close!
Then I could do some really
great research... Can you
please hunt one for me?

title: What a Girl Wants
desc:
My lil' sis got mad at me
for forgetting her birthday.
Now the only way she'll
forgive me is if I hunt her
a Tigrex for a late birthday
present! Please, Hunter,
you gotta help me!

title: Rathalos Run
desc:
That Rathalos flying near
the Ancestral Steppe? Yeah,
I let him get away. Figured
he deserved a break. Now
he's too far away for me to
bother with. Someone else
tackle him for me.

title: Watch Your Steppe
desc:
We received reports that
a Gore Magala has shown
itself in the Steppe. I'd like
for you to investigate, and
hunt the beast. Do so,
and you'll have ensured
the safety of many.

title: Bug Buffet
desc:
Legend tells of a faraway
land where they boil up
bugs and swallow them down.
Say, I hear a Seltas Queen
was spotted nearby. Sounds
yummy! Hmm? How was the last
bug I ate? ...No comment.

title: A Bewitching Dance
desc:
A Mizutsune has laid claim
to the Primal Forest. But
the forest is not for it alone.
You must go and reclaim
what is all of ours. Beware
its peculiar bubbles, Hunter.

title: Dread Locked
desc:
Gore Magala... Its name
sends grown men running for
their mothers. Don't expect
a cheery hunt with this
one -- its black mist
swallows all. Can you drive
away this relentless evil?

title: Barioth Hunt
desc:
*sigh* Can NOTHING save me
from the depths of my boredom?
I got it! I want the so-called
"white demon," the Barioth!
Such a cold-hearted creature
might ALMOST amuse me,
so hop to it, peasant!

title: The Unshakable Mountain God
desc:
The beast known as the God
of the Mountain is quite a
challenge, indeed, but it's
certainly nothing that a
Wycademy Hunter can't
handle! Go, Hunter, and
bring honor to our name.

title: Topple the Monarch
desc:
I suppose I'm being too harsh on
myself. I'm far from the only
hunter who has challenged the
Zinogre in the Frozen Seaway
only to become the hunted.
Why else would the monster be
known as "The Hunter"? Still...

title: Bedevil a Deviljho
desc:
A terrifying beast has
appeared in the Frozen
Seaway! It's a vicious thing,
crueler than anything I've
ever seen... Be sure to
write up a will before
you go out there!

title: Frozen Seaway Accounting
desc:
Young Hunter, your hands
seem idle. Would you care
to busy yourself collecting
points for me in the Frozen
Seaway? Any items are fine,
as long as you meet the
quota. Take care, now.

title: A Cure for Cowardice
desc:
Hmph, the Chief might get angry with
me, but there's no way I'm apologizing...
Yeah, well, if someone ever managed
to hunt down a Gravios in the Volcanic
Hollow, maybe then I'd have a change
of heart and be nice to my sis!
(Ha, fat chance of that!)

title: Master of the Molten Deep
desc:
For the past few years, my
people have lived in ever-
mounting fear of the wrath
of the volcano, and the
great wyvern who sleeps
in its flames. Please,
save my people!

title: Duel in the Volcanic Hollow
desc:
I fought a Glavenus in a
duel, but I was soundly
defeated. To think that
such a master of sword-
play could exist... You
would do well to see
it for yourself.

title: Volcanic Hollow Accounting
desc:
Young Hunter, your hands
seem idle. Would you care
to busy yourself collecting
points for me in the Volcanic
Hollow? Any items are fine,
as long as you meet the
quota. Take care, now.

title: Bug Bite
desc:
Legends tell of a faraway
land where the people turn
insects into hors d'oeuvres.
For my final request, hunt
me a Seltas Queen so I can
try a taste. This is the
last time I'll ask, promise!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Heaven and Earth
desc:
A Rathalos and a Rathian
appeared in the Jurassic
Frontier. Do you know just
how deadly they are when
they're together? And
during mating season, it's
suicide! Still up for the hunt?
objective:
Hunt a Rathalos
and a Rathian

title: From Beyond the Sands
desc:
I was roaming the Dunes
when I happened to see
a Glavenus blocking one
of the major trade routes!
Normally I keep to myself,
but I can't live without
my delivery of Moga curry!

title: Legend of the Monkey King
desc:
A legendary priest once
embarked on a journey of
discovery with three disciples.
I tried to copy him, but failed
miserably. My disciple turned
on me, and is now rampaging
in the Dunes. Please help!

title: Astalos Territory
desc:
Our caravan wandered into
an Astalos's territory, and
it didn't seem to like us. I
barely escaped with my life,
but my friends are still in the
Verdant Hills. Please hunt
it down and save my friends!

title: Lord of the Skies
desc:
A message for all brave
hunters. A Rathalos has
been seen in our land,
and for the safety of my
people, we need your
help to eliminate it. Your
help will be aptly rewarded.

title: The Rajang in the Snow
desc:
A crazy monster with two
horns and mouth lasers
showed up in the Arctic
Ridge! What the heck are
we supposed to do against
something like that!?
Help us out, here!

title: Fury Run Afoul
desc:
A shortage of food has got
a Gammoth goin' crazy up
on the ridge. No one can
sleep at night, fearin' it'll
come a-chargin' through
the walls! I beg ya, put it
down so we can rest easy!

title: Bl-Bl-Blangongas!
desc:
It's bad enough that we've
got a gig out in the middle
of nowhere for a bunch of
lushes, but now we're
liable to get stranded in
the mountains because of
these Blangongas! Help!

title: Surrounded by Bubbles
desc:
Covering yourself in
Mizutsune bubbles gives
you tremendous sliding
ability... Fascinating! Hunt
one for me so I can study
the chemical makeup of
its bubbles... For science!

title: The Moving Mountain
desc:
That little moss-covered hill
at the Misty Peaks was just
begging to be painted. But the
second I pulled out my easel
and brush, it was gone! How
can I be a landscape artist if
the landscape won't cooperate?
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: The Fisherman's Fiend
desc:
Yikes, this is horrible!
We've just heard from our
fishermen out in the sea
that a Lagiacrus is
here in this region! We
need you to stop it before
it does any serious damage!

title: Open Season for Jaggia
desc:
This isn't good at all!
There's been an unusually
high number of Jaggia
recently, and at this rate,
I don't think the village'll
survive the winter! Could you
help us thin out the herd?

title: For Whom the Gong Tolls
desc:
A friend of mine who rings
gongs for a living says she'd
like to model her movements
after those of a Duramboros.
Could you hunt one for her?
Then maybe she'll finally
get back to work!

title: Quartz Rivalry
desc:
I need something classy
for the big soirée... Oh, I
know! A Quartz Ore brooch!
You can help me with that,
can't you, Hunter? Ooh, I
can already see everyone's
faces, green with envy!

title: We Can Dig It
desc:
I've been fascinated by
how the Agnaktor can
easily break through solid
rock. As a fellow digger, I
have nothing but respect.
I'd like to see it up close.
Can you capture one for me?
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Coal Hearted
desc:
Me and Grampaw Maple
got somethin' amazin' in
the works, but we need
some Coal! Gather about
ten for us, would ya? Use
the Paw Pass Ticket
to come back once ya do!
objective:
Deliver 10 pieces of Coal
or a Paw Pass Ticket

title: River of Fire
desc:
Two Lavasioth are ambushing
workers near the mine! As if
our job wasn't hard enough
without these brutes
popping out and scaring
us half to death. Please,
take care of them for us!

title: Dances with Wyverns
desc:
Wyverns attacked my airship
the other day! Just WHAM,
right out of the sky with
their claws and fire and...
*sigh* My trip was ruined,
but you can save others
by hunting those beasts!

title: Bugging Out
desc:
I heard the Primal Forest
had some big bugs, so I
went to check it out, but
something put me to sleep
and I woke up covered in
bubbles! Could you go
look for the bugs instead?
objective:
Hunt all large monsters,
not including Seltas

title: A Three Hour Tour
desc:
This was supposed to be
a nice trip to see the aurora,
but all we saw here were
monsters! Nothing is so
beautiful it's worth risking
our lives for! Hunt them so
we can finish our trip!

title: A Hollow Defense
desc:
Just our luck that we go
digging for ore, only to dig
up a shortcut to a bunch
of monsters! We threw
up a makeshift barrier,
but we can't hold them
off anymore... Help!

title: Wild Gunman
desc:
I'm a bullet researcher by
trade. Yes, we exist. By
studying the unique ranged
attacks of monsters, I can
craft better tools to fight
them. By helping me, you'll
be doing yourself a favor.

title: Marshlands Rag
desc:
Can you hear that...? The
perfect melody of wildlife
in the Marshlands! Bulldrome
footsteps, Najarala rustles
through the treetops, and
the bass-like drumming of
a Duramboros! Bravo! Bravo!

title: Firefight to the Finish!
desc:
I heard some monsters were
making a mess at the Volcano,
so I'm like BAM! Let me at
'em! But then they were like
BAM! No way, bro! I can't
let them burn me like that,
man! Please, avenge me!

title: At the Slayground
desc:
We thought we'd found the
perfect place to train, but
it's been overrun by both
a Kecha Wacha and a
Rathalos! And now a
Rajang is on its way, too!
Help us newbies out!

title: It's Electric
desc:
Unexplained natural events
have been occurring deep
within the Jurassic Frontier.
Intriguing, don't you think?
I believe it's a sign of mythic
beasts, but you should go
see it with your own eyes.

title: The White Brute
desc:
My friends and I sought out
a phantom beast. When we
came upon it, we had but a
moment before it smote us
with thunder, casting us
asunder. Please help us,
Hunter.

title: A Scenic Locale
desc:
They say that somewhere
in the world, monsters from
ancient times roam free. I
wanted to find this place,
and risked life and limb to
do so. Now, I'll show you
how to get there too.

title: Miasma Attack
desc:
I saw a Gypceros emitting
some sort of odd glow...
And it made me want to
break its face in! So I hit
it with all my Hunter Arts,
but it got away. Still, I
had my fun. You finish it off!

title: Stop the Wacha!
desc:
The Kecha Wacha around
here's been acting pawfully
strange. It's always been
a trickster, but now it's
glowing and its tricks are
getting purrtty unsafe!
Purrlease hunt it for us!

title: We Are Not Amused
desc:
Mirror, mirror, in my hand,
who is the greatest queen in
the land? ...What? Who
does this "Queen of the
Land" think she is!? You,
Hunter! Hunt down this
abomination at once!

title: Zamtrios Fight!
desc:
Y'know, I think Hyper
Zamtrios might be the
coolest out of all the Hyper
ones. That dark, red smoke,
on top of its wicked ice
armor... I bet you're just
dying to see it for yourself!

title: The Frog of War
desc:
I received a request to hunt
a Tetsucabra in the Volcanic
Hollow. I'd never seen a
beast with such a powerful
aura. You'll understand when
you see it yourself.

title: Triple Toady Terror
desc:
I hate to ask for even more
help, Hunter, but could you
take care of a Tetsucabra
for us? It's one of 'em Hyper
beasties, but if you take it
out, we should be able to
make some great gear!

title: The Coal Still Burns
desc:
My pop seems pretty set
on creating the perfect set
of armor, but I just want him
to get some bed rest! Can
you please get him some
Coal so he doesn't overexert
himself!? Pretty please!?

title: Woe Malfestio
desc:
A merchant looking for a
Malfestio came to me, and
I accidentally pointed her
to a Hyper one. Oops! She
has a bodyguard, but he's
no hunter. Please take out
that Hyper Malfestio!

title: Born of Darkness
desc:
All we saw were two
bright, flashing red eyes
and suddenly my friends
were unconscious at my
feet. Please, help me avenge
my friends and find a way
to defeat this dark beast!

title: Nibeling on Apples
desc:
I've discovered the ultimate
apple! If only that Hyper
Nibelsnarf weren't keeping
me from harvesting more...
But, the world must know
of its deliciousness! Help
me, Hunter!

title: Warning: Hyper Yian Garuga!
desc:
Yian Garuga are known for
their ill temperaments, and
the Hyper anomaly only
seems to exacerbate this.
One such specimen is
loose in the Hills. Not good.
Hunter, you know what to do.

title: Hyper for Holes
desc:
I was out on the Ridge looking
for the perfect place to do
some high-quality digging
when a Hyper Blangonga
attacked me and broke my
favorite pickaxe! Argh! Dish
out justice for me, Hunter!

title: The Plesioth Adventure
desc:
I was walking in the Misty
Peaks when I came across
a Plesioth all riled up. And
you know what? I think
that sucker would be
perfect practice for you!
Now, go get 'em, sport!

title: Daimyo of the Deserted Island
desc:
I set out for the Deserted
Island to reflect on my life
and find ways I might better
myself. But before I could
get far, a Hyper Daimyo
Hermitaur attacked me! Help me,
so I can resume my meditation.

title: Where the Wild Manes Are
desc:
Royal Ludroth have such
lovely, fluffy necks! And I
hear that recently, one with
an exceptionally fluffy one
is up and about! I wonder
how soft it is... Please!
You must help me find out!

title: Hyper Investigation
desc:
We've been receiving reports
of fierce monsters in the area
that give off a dark red glow.
Verify this information, and
also take care of the Yian
Kut-Kut spotted in the same
area. Good luck.

title: The Khezu and the Shadow
desc:
I saw a Khezu when I was out
fishing. There was something
odd about it though. It had
some black haze on its face,
making it look even creepier
than usual. Please, get rid
of it for us!

title: Bring On the Shogun
desc:
I'm looking for somebody to
hunt a Hyper Ceanataur! Its
Hyper state makes its
pincers dangerously sharp...
But they'd be perfect for
sharpening my weapons!

title: Unnerving Najarala
desc:
I snuck into the Marshlands
to check out some of the
scary monsters there, and
I saw a Najarala giving off
some weird black smoke!
Honest! Just don't tell
my mom I was there!

title: Eruption Embodied
desc:
There's a Hyper Uragaan
near our village, spewing out
so much smoke and molten
rocks that I really thought
the Volcano was erupting!
Our village is in real
trouble. You've gotta help!

title: The Magma's Rage
desc:
A certain...someone...needs
you to complete this highly
classified Quest. Even I am
not sure why. Your target:
a Hyper Lavasioth. I'm sure
this goes without saying,
but be careful.

title: Minion Audition Imposition
desc:
If you really want to be
Cha-Cha's minion, you must
prove yourself-self! In the
Marshlands, Hyper Yian
Kut-Ku and Shogun Ceanataur
need hunting! Cha-Cha will
be watcha-latching you!

title: Stop the Wheel
desc:
I've only known the gods
from their legends -- never
did I expect to see one in
my lifetime. Dare you
attempt to halt the cycle
of death and etch your own
name into legend, Hunter?

title: A Gathering of Wyverns
desc:
You'll never guess what I
saw! An Astalos trying to
pick up a Rathian! Clearly,
this is a case of forbidden
love... Or it is in my book!
This is simply too scandalous!
Please do something!
objective:
Hunt an Astalos and
a Rathian

title: A Song of White and Lapis
desc:
I had a dream where I was
covered in white bubbles and
surrounded by lapis-colored
feathers. When I woke up,
I saw a Mizutsune and a
Malfestio fighting. Please
drive them off so I can sleep!
objective:
Hunt a Mizutsune and
a Malfestio

title: A Cold Set of Armor
desc:
I've heard that monsters in
the Frozen Seaway have armor
of ice and snow. If I knew their
secrets, I could make some
truly splendid armor. I'm not
a fighter, so could you do
some research on my behalf?
objective:
Hunt a Gammoth
and a Zamtrios

title: Rocked and Rolled
desc:
Ever take a knockout punch?
I know a monster who packs
a wallop. And don't get me
started on its sticky goop.
Good thing it came off
before I went down for the
count. You up for a round?

title: So Notable: Seregios
desc:
I need your help ASAP!
I've got a fresh notebook
page just screaming to be
filled with facts, and I know
just what will do the trick:
a freshly captured Seregios!
Good luck!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Hammer vs. Blade
desc:
I found two monsters in
the Volcanic Hollow, both
wielding finely honed
weapons: a sharp sword and
a crushing hammer.
Dangerous weapons like
those must be apprehended.
objective:
Hunt a Glavenus and
an Uragaan

title: A Roar to the Heavens
desc:
I ran into a Tigrex in the
Frontier, and then a Zinogre
jumped out, too! Just when I
thought I was done for, the
Tigrex charged the Zinogre,
and I made a break for it! I
can't take much more of this!
objective:
Hunt a Zinogre
and a Tigrex

title: The Hapless Bodyguard
desc:
If I'm gonna follow this plan
to a T, I'm going to need
all the materials I can get!
And I can't get them with a
bunch of Rajang hanging on
my back. That's where you
come in!

title: Seer of Swords
desc:
Seregios, or the "Wyvern of
One Thousand Blades," has
made an appearance. Razor-
sharp scales and strength
that may even surpass that
of Rathalos. Keep your wits
about you, young Hunter.

title: Legendary Skills?
desc:
Are you ready to prove yourself to
me, darling? A Diablos is attacking
the neighboring settlements from
its lair in the Dunes. Beware its
two-horned charge, and watch for
when it bursts from the ground too.
It knows no mercy!

title: The Yukumo Gal Special
desc:
That Quest the Yukumo Gal
recommended to me was
ridiculous! Did she really
expect me to take on a pair
of Zinogres by myself!?
Be a pal and take this
Quest off my hands!

title: Repaying the Favor
desc:
My apprentice in Bherna
got into some trouble.
I want to repay the kind
purrson who bailed him out
with Brachydios materials,
but my paws are tied with
work! Could you go instead?

title: You Bet Your Life
desc:
"Nobody can handle a Rajang
and a Deviljho," they said.
"Impossible," they said. So
I made an impulse bet with
my life savings. Now I have
gambler's remorse. Mind
evening the odds for me?
objective:
Hunt a Deviljho
and a Rajang

title: Wyvern's Way
desc:
I hear there's a foreign sport
where participants compete to
see who can most elegantly
dodge a charging beast. I'd
like to see it for myself, so
I've prepared the beasts.
Now, give me a good show!
objective:
Hunt a Yian Garuga
and a Tigrex

title: Bewitching Heat
desc:
There are two mighty beasts
at the Forlorn Arena. One
harbors extreme heat as it
cuts opponents to ribbons,
while the other bewitches
its opponents with its spry
movements. Stay alert!
objective:
Hunt a Glavenus and
a Mizutsune

title: The Mountain God's Lightning
desc:
There are two mighty beasts
at the Forlorn Arena. One
attacks by freezing its foes
to their very core, while the
other fires electric blasts to
stun its prey. Steel yourself
for the battle ahead.
objective:
Hunt an Astalos and
a Gammoth

title: A Man's Arena is His Castle
desc:
I walk away for five minutes
and the place is crawling with
monsters! Lagombi, Blangonga,
Zamtrios, and a Gammoth!
Someone's gotta teach 'em
their proper place! Hm?
You're saying that's my job?

title: The Hunter Games
desc:
We've got an intense lineup
for everyone today! Foxes,
beasts, fish, and even bugs!
This gauntlet's sure to have
challengers quaking in their
booties. Hahaha! Well, have
fun out there!
objective:
Hunt all large monsters,
not including Seltas

title: The Flames of War
desc:
The Arena is blazing with
action today! Why, you ask?
Because it's stoked with lava,
exploding rocks, flaming
breath, and red-hot blades!
Got what it takes to burn
through the competition?

title: A Shocking Revelation!
desc:
Every time I walk around,
I get zapped with static!
Mom says it's 'cause there's
so many Thunder monsters
around. I dunno about that,
but I do know that these
shocks hurt! Please help!

title: The Gathering Storm
desc:
Wyverns have gathered in
the Sanctuary, casting
dark shadows over it as
they split the earth and rip
through flesh. Will you be
the one to face these foul
beasts?

title: Hellfire Star
desc:
Attention all hunters.
Slaying Nakarkos is now
the Wycademy's top priority.
Combine your efforts and
bring this task to fruition.
May luck be with you.

title: Putting the Gore in Magala
desc:
We've received word that
a Hyper Gore Magala is in
the Ancestral Steppe. I'd like
for you to head out there right
away. A Hyper specimen of
Gore Magala is a deadly foe.
Be careful out there.

title: Steppe in the Right Direction
desc:
On my travels across the Ancestral
Steppe, I stumbled upon a fearsome
Deviljho! I ran as fast as I could, but
now my legs have given out. I entrust
this message to a Kelbi I befriended
on the way -- even though it didn't
seem too keen on the idea at first!

title: Tigrex, Tigrex, Burning Bright
desc:
A certain...someone...needs
you to complete this highly
classified Quest. Even I am
not sure why. Your target:
a Hyper Tigrex. I'm sure this
goes without saying, but
be careful.

title: A Thousand Blades of Wrath
desc:
S-Somebody help us! A
H-Hyper Seregios showed
up and... Ahhh! Wh-What
should we d-do!? S-Somebody
get rid of that thing!

title: A Fiery Temper
desc:
Help! A Hyper Rathalos is
in the Volcanic Hollow! I told
the Kokoto Gal that if we
didn't act now, we'd all be
done for, but she just laughed!
I can't be the only one who
thinks we're in big trouble!

title: The Unassailable Seltas Queen
desc:
I was asked to hunt a Seltas
Queen, but my hunting skills
were insufficient for the task.
It isn't like regular Seltas
Queens, but I-I must train
harder. Please fulfill the
task in my stead, Hunter.

title: Rajang's Black Spirit
desc:
It was all so sudden. It just came
rushing out of the undergrowth.
Mane flowing, wrapped in some
dark aura... Wouldn't want to head
back in there for fear of meeting
that again. We'll have to wait for
the Guild to take care of it.

title: Savage Sword of the Desert
desc:
It was so hot, the air itself
hissed as if burned. That was
no ordinary blade, but one
expertly forged for battle.
If I face it again, I fear it
will shatter my trusted blade.
I must leave the rest to you.

title: Wyvernlit Evening
desc:
That intimidating crest and
its sharp gaze cutting through
that menacing dark glow...
These things are terrifying!
What could they be planning?
No! I-It can't be! It's coming
toward us! P-Please, help!

title: Wyverns All Around Us
desc:
You look ready to rumble
with some tough monsters!
Lucky for you, a pair of
Hyper wyverns are tearin'
through the Verdant Hills.
Dangerous, sure, but I'm
sure you can handle 'em!
objective:
Hunt a Rathalos
and a Rathian

title: Wild Gods, Calm Rangers
desc:
The god of the mountains,
Gammoth, is threatening
a nearby village. Is there
anyone who can stop its
footsteps that rupture the
earth, its breath that com-
mands the fury of winter?

title: Into the Maelstrom
desc:
De wa, to prove how effective
is your training, I propose
little test! This Lagiacrus is
more abunai than average.
Extra danger! The sea
breeze says you'll need
to give it your all!

title: The Lithe and Unbreaking
desc:
The Mizutsune moves with
power and fluidity, strength
and beauty. And the aura
this one gives off is almost
ethereal. Do you think
you even have a chance
of defeating it?

title: The Peril of the Land
desc:
A Hyper Duramboros is
running amok, ripping out
trees and threatening to
reduce our mountains to
ruins... Please! Defeat
this beast and save our
beautiful land!

title: The Wolf and the Footbath
desc:
Our footbath has been
flourishing! The only thing
is, the equipment hasn't
held up. If you could take
care of the Hyper Zinogre
roaming about, we could
get materials to fix it up!

title: The Thieving Gypceros
desc:
That hammer... I poured my
heart and soul into it, only
for those Gypceros in the
Marshlands to swipe it from
me! Get rid of 'em for me,
and I'll get it back once
the coast is clear!

title: Steam and Smoke
desc:
To purrvide our patrons
with a more soothing
footbath experience, we
need some Volcanic Ore.
Unfortunately, an especially
fierce Brachydios is in the
way. Please help, Hunter!

title: The Glowing Embers
desc:
As if its lava coating weren't
enough, that Agnaktor had
some glowing crud all over
it! And when those parts
hit me, I might as well have
been wearing paper armor!
Please, finish it off for me!

title: Primal Forest Defense
desc:
Some good friends of ours
are in trouble after a buncha
Hyper Monsters showed
up in the Primal Forest!
I got a feelin' yer the only
one who can help. You're
the one to get it done!
objective:
Hunt all large monsters,
not including Seltas

title: The End of the Trials
desc:
I've got a big favor to ask.
I need you to hunt down a
Tigrex and a Seregios.
They're both Hyper, so I
know that ordinary hunters
wouldn't stand a chance. But
you're no ordinary hunter!

title: The Descending Fog
desc:
I have a request for the
famed Wycademy Hunter.
A group of Hyper Monsters
has descended upon the
Verdant Hills. You may
be our only hope. Our
trust is in you!

title: Searching for Secret Baths
desc:
We found the purrfect
purrlace to build a fabulous
mew hot spring. The
purroblem is, it's overrun
with Hypurr Meownsters.
Could you make them
vacate the purremises?

title: Show Me Your Shaka-Strength
desc:
Cha-Cha hear voice, and it
tell Cha-Cha that if can
defeat a red wyvern, turquoise
wolf, and blue leviathan,
then all be made clear!
You no laka-look busy.
Help Cha-Cha out!

title: The Marshlands Nightmare
desc:
Aha! Perfect timing! I've got
just the Quest for a hunter
of your *hic* talents! How
d'ya feel about some Hyper
monsters? Thass the ticket!
Now, go and ssshow me
what yer made of! *hic*

title: The Birds of Prey
desc:
Beware the beaks that bite,
the claws that catch! The
shrieking Yian Kut-Ku; the
colorful Malfestio; and the
war machine, Yian Garuga!
Slay these beasts and
bring safety to the skies!

title: The Fanged Beasts
desc:
Beware the beasts that
pierce with tusk and fang.
The giant Gammoth; the
erratic Kecha Wacha;
and the wily Blangonga!
Can you avoid the skewer
of these sharp challengers?

title: The Winged Wyverns
desc:
Beware the skies and those
that rule it! The new rival,
Astalos; the divebombing
Rathalos; and the flesh-
tearing Seregios. Do you
have what it takes to
reclaim the skies?

title: The Foes of the Deep
desc:
Beware the creatures of the
deep! The bewitching bubble
fox, Mizutsune; the torrential
blasts of Plesioth; the all-
devouring Nibelsnarf; and the
thunderous Lagiacrus! Will
you sink or swim?

title: The Beasts of Brawn
desc:
Beware the beasts of strength
and savagery! The massive
Uragaan; the whirling might
of Duramboros; the brute
strength of Brachydios; and
the razor-bladed Glavenus.
Who will reign king?

title: Ring of the Silver Sol
desc:
I saw it with my own eyes!
Two suns blazing up in the
sky, except one was all
silvery. I couldn't make
this stuff up if I tried!
It's up to you to get to
the bottom of this!

title: Ring of the Golden Lune
desc:
*Sigh* Life as king is just
one council meeting after
another. I long to see the
wonders of the world, like
the golden wyvern from my
minstrel's ballads. Bring it
to me, Hunter!

title: Usurpers of the Throne
desc:
The king robed in silver, and
the queen wrapped in gold.
Those who defeat them can
truly claim to have usurped
the throne of Hunterdom. I
await with a toast to your
success, Hunter.
objective:
Hunt a Silver Rathalos
and a Gold Rathian

title: Following the Fallen
desc:
I first met my husband in the Jurassic
Frontier when he rescued me from
a Silver Rathalos. So if I can find a
Rathalos, maybe I could meet him
again... If anyone reads this, please
don't come looking for me. I won't
give up on him. I can't...
subquest: Wound Silver Rathalos's head and wings

title: Fool's Gold
desc:
Urgently requesting help in Misty
Peaks. Reports of rare Rathian
breed attacking patrols from nearby
villages. Hunters gone to help now
missing. Bad situation we're in.
Send help to deal with Rathian!
subquest: Wound Gold Rathian's head and wings

title: Shining Examples
desc:
A Gold Rathian and a Silver Rathalos...
How fierce, how exciting, how
beautiful! I can't take my eyes off
them... And what better chance to
see them again than in the Arena!
Don't be shy, get in there!
objective:
Hunt a Silver Rathalos
and a Gold Rathian

title: Child of Destruction
desc:
The Rajang has shown its
true colors at last. Left un-
checked, it will visit utter
destruction upon us. I must
entrust you with its defeat,
as I have another task, and
dear ones awaiting my return.

title: A Shock in the Dark
desc:
The moon is especially
beautiful here. Nature is
at its best when untouched
by mankind... However,
you must beware, as this
very nature may visit its
wrath upon the unsuspecting.

title: Triumphant Rage
desc:
Even within the Loc Lac
Guild, there is one monster
that keeps us all on our
toes...the Deviljho! You
are perhaps the only hunter
capable of taking it on!
Defeat this foul beast!

title: The Frozen Dictator
desc:
I saw it! I know I did! A
pair of black wings among
a flurry of snow... Then a
gust of wind nearly blew
me off the mountain! Take
my advice and don't even
go near that thing!
objective:
Slay a Kushala Daora
or repel it

title: Kushala Daora Strikes
desc:
Blizzards have been striking
with increasing frequency.
We've managed to identify a
Kushala Daora as the cause.
The storms are growing...and
may consume us all. Please,
Hunter, you must help us.
objective:
Slay a Kushala Daora
or repel it

title: The Elder Dragon of Mist
desc:
I sensed a strong presence
and turned around, but there
was nobody there. There's
no way anything could have
sneaked up on us from our
vantage point, but still...
Keep your guard up, Hunter!
objective: Slay a Chameleos or repel it

title: Beyond the Silence
desc:
A mysterious elder dragon
has appeared, but no one
has set eyes upon it. Of
course, seeing it may be
the last thing you do...
We need you to eliminate
it, but please be careful!
objective: Slay a Chameleos or repel it

title: Emperor of Flame
desc:
I beg of you, help me in
carrying out my last task.
I've chased a Teostra to the
Volcano. Beware its flames,
for they may roast you
alive if you are careless.
Godspeed, Hunter!
objective:
Slay a Teostra
or repel it

title: The Fires of Devastation
desc:
When I was a child, a
Teostra attacked our
village. Now, that foul
beast has come again
to rain destruction down
upon us. Please! Put an
end to this evil presence!
objective:
Slay a Teostra
or repel it

title: Grim Tidings
desc:
Uh-oh. Our observers over
at the Volcano have gone
silent. Their last message
mentioned something about
a "black god." That can't be
good. We need someone
to investigate.

title: Absolute Zero
desc:
An Ukanlos appeared in
the Polar Field and is
headed towards this village.
But we've got one hope, and
that's you. Everyone here
believes in you. Please,
save our village!

title: The Looming Calamity
desc:
We have met many times,
and you have never failed to
impress me with your courage
in the face of adversity.
Now, with Amatsu threatening
our village, we need your
bravery more than ever.

title: The Brilliant Darkness
desc:
"None can foresee disaster.
In darkness, it comes; among
despair, it departs. Now is
such a time, when all may
struggle...and in the end,
perish." Catchy, eh? My aide
wrote it. Anyway, save us!

title: Harvest Tour: Ruined Pinnacle
desc:
Oh, hello, darling. My intuition tells me
that you'd love to go gathering up at
the Ruined Pinnacle. Am I wrong? Well,
I have just the Quest for you. Go and
satisfy your gathering urges, and just
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket when you're
done. It's as easy as that.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Desert
desc:
Hello, darling. I can sense that you're
yearning for a taste of the Desert's
rich bounty. Don't try and hide it! Go,
take this Quest, and scratch that itch.
Deliver a Paw Pass Ticket when you're
satisfied. That's all.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Ancestral Steppe
desc:
Interested in gathering at the
Ruined Pinnacle, are we?
I know just the Quest. Gather
away, darling, gather away.
Just remember to be a dear
and deliver the Paw Pass
Ticket when you're done.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Primal Forest
desc:
So you're looking to gather
at the Primal Forest, are you?
This Quest should be perfect
for you, then, darling. Deliver
the Paw Pass Ticket when
you're done and we'll gladly
pick you up.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Jurassic Frontier
desc:
Gathering in the Jurassic
Frontier certainly has its
appeal. I'll pull up a Quest
for you. Don't be out too
late, though, darling -- you'll
need to deliver the Paw Pass
Ticket when you're done.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Dunes
desc:
The Dunes hold all sorts of
curiosities, don't they? Well now,
I've got just the Quest to sate
your foraging appetite. We will,
of course, pick you up as soon as
you deliver your Paw Pass Ticket.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Verdant Hills
desc:
Gathering in the Verdant Hills?
That brings back memories...
Let me fetch a Quest for you,
darling. Enjoy your gathering,
and remember to deliver
the Paw Pass Ticket when
you're done.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Arctic Ridge
desc:
Gathering at the Arctic Ridge,
are we? Well, I hope you'll wrap
up warm. Here's your Quest.
Enjoy! Oh, and let me remind
you that we'll come and pick
you up when you deliver your
Paw Pass Ticket.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Misty Peaks
desc:
The Misty Peaks? Gorgeous
place for gathering. I'll find a
Quest for you right away, darling.
You go ahead and enjoy yourself.
Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket
when you're ready to come home.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Pecking Order
desc:
Oh, geez, this is really... I mean, this
bird thing was just poking at me with its
beak... It didn't really hurt, but it was
just like... I can't really describe it.
I think it would be best all round if you
just went and got rid of it for me.

title: After That Bird!
desc:
A precious Felyne friend with whom
I am extremely close, has today
become the victim of a wicked
Gypceros! It pilfered such a precious
gift; it's given him such grief! But
now all that is going to change --
Hunter, go smite that thief!

title: Sweetheart's Pick: Lofty Ludroth
desc:
Thanks for accepting this Quest, Hunter!
This time you'll be fighting a Royal
Ludroth at the Ruined Pinnacle. It's a bit
similar to the crazy one my apprentice,
the Yukumo Gal, was thinking of. Just,
you know, made a bit more sane.
I really appreciate your help!

title: Fangs for the Bath
desc:
Mrowwwww! The worst has happened!
Two infurnal Arzuros at the Ruined
Pinnacle in a furrenzy! We hid in a cave
but we got soaked to the skin! We look
like something the cat dragged in!
