Someone, blow them out of the water!

title: Ruined Pinnacle, RUINED
desc:
Th-This is terrible! Because of the
intense methane buildup from all the
Congas, the Ruined Pinnacle stinks!
They just won't stop farting! How are
we supposed to do any research
under these conditions!? Can you
thin their numbers a bit? ...Puaah!

title: Just Five Morel Minutes...
desc:
We're doing some pretty important
research here! Namely, how to shed
the human need for sleep using the
power of mushrooms! So we need
some Tall Mushrooms from the Ruined
Pinnacle. Wake us when you're back.
We're just resting our eyes.

title: Daimyo Hermitaur Flambé
desc:
I am determined to teach ma langue
divine to tolerate ze heat! Zere is but
one purroblème. Fur ze heat, I must
be in ze Desert. But in ze Desert, zere
are ze meownsters... I love ze crab
cakes, but zis Daimyo Hermitaur is too
much for me to handle...!

title: A Berry Dubious Idea
desc:
Hunter, Hunter! Are you familiar with
the Tropical Berries that grow in the
Desert? I just came up with a way to
make them really tasty! They're going
to be HUGE! I think I smell money...
I'll split the profits with you if you
collect some for me. 70-30?

title: Lost, But Not for Long
desc:
Waaaah! This is just *sob* terrible!
My *sniff* my super important survey
report... I was out on the Ancestral
Steppe when this *hic* Gypceros
stole it! My academic career will
be OVER!!! You gotta get my report
back, *sob* pleeeease!

title: Face Two Face
desc:
What a conundrum! I was
minding my own business on
the Ancestral Steppe when I
spotted two monsters with
the exact same face! This
must be some Kecha Wacha
voodoo -- I'm sure of it!

title: Enough Monkeying Around
desc:
Well I never! That vile primate
thing came at me in the Primal
Forest. I've had it up here with its
pranks and tomfoolery! Hunter,
could you please take care of it
before I do something I regret?

title: Pleasantly Sozzled
desc:
I've obtained infurmation through
completely lawful means on some
ingredients in the Jurassic Furrontier
which I need for my plan. Unfurtunately
a Tetsucabra is in the way... Could you
lend me a paw by hunting the monster
while I swipe the goods? Nya!

title: Antony and Tetsucabra
desc:
O Hunter, keen of brain and stout of
heart; Frontiers Jurassic shall not throw
your search, Nor leaping beasties dash
you on the rocks (Though lesser hunters,
mewling, would flee home.) But catch
this toxic monster, let me see; How
hunting frogs may yet the hunted be.
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: A Brush with Bugs
desc:
Waaa! I can't... Eww! I need a shower...
I was at the Jurassic Frontier, and this
absolutely enormous vile insect came
flying at me! And then another one,
even worse, to top it off! Get out
there and squish them! Please! Oh no,
is one of them on me!?

title: Surprise!
desc:
Okay, just breathe, just breathe...
Is this place trying to kill me!? I'm just
out traipsing through the sand when
a Cephadrome AND Daimyo Hermitaur
pop out! I'm not sure how much more
I can take... Hunter, can you sort this
out before I have an arrest?
objective:
Hunt a Cephadrome and
a Daimyo Hermitaur

title: The Bird Who Wood Be King
desc:
...Well, I'm in a pickle and no mistake.
Went down to the Verdant Hills to
gather wood, and got myself chased
off by a Yian Kut-Ku. If I can't get wood,
then I can't keep a roof over my head.
Can somebody fix this birdbrain's
wagon for me?

title: The Killer Rabbit of Arctic Ridge
desc:
Don't tell my brother, but I snuck up
the mountain to see the bunny.
It looked so darn...ANGRY!
All my hopes and dreams, dashed
in an instant! Where is my cute
fluffybun!? Put that abomination
somewhere I can't see it, ever!

title: Survival of the Biggest
desc:
A Giadrome and Bulldrome have
turned up at the Arctic Ridge and
they're beefing over territory. It's
getting in the way of my observation
activities, so do you think you could
snuff them out for me? But be careful...
They're pretty beastly.
objective:
Hunt a Giadrome
and a Bulldrome

title: Riverside Rumble
desc:
Hey, have you got a sec? I wanted to
check out the fish from that pretty river
they've got in Yukumo, but there was
one of those Arzuros things going wild
at the Misty Peaks. I can't concentrate
on fish with one of those things about.
Can you go and whack it for me?

title: Water Fight
desc:
Oh my gosh, two Royal Ludroth
have been seen in the Misty Peaks!
I have never ever seen two of them
in the same place before. EVER!
They're so territorial...this can't end
well! Get in there and put them down
before all hell breaks loose!

title: Harvest Tour: Jungle
desc:
Ah, hello, darling. If you're interested
in gathering in the Jungle, I have
a Quest that you simply must try.
Just deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
when you've had enough and want
out. Bye for now!
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Frozen Seaway
desc:
I can see you're determined
to go gathering at the Frozen
Seaway. Well, watch you don't
catch a death of cold, darling!
I'll let you go, but only if you
promise me to deliver your Paw
Pass Ticket when you're finished.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Deserted Island
desc:
So you'd like to do some gathering
on the Deserted Island, would you?
Let me just get your Quest ready.
When you find enough things worth
your while, just deliver the Paw Pass
Ticket and we'll gladly pick you up.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Marshlands
desc:
Gathering in the Marshlands? Well,
watch where you step, darling.
All right, I've got your Quest here.
Deliver your Paw Pass Ticket
whenever you feel you're done
and we'll pick you up.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Harvest Tour: Volcano
desc:
Gathering at the Volcano, are we?
I'll give you the Quest, darling, but
you're not to stay in there too long.
We've had enough hunters coming
back with heat stroke already.
Deliver your Paw Pass Ticket as
soon as you're done, do you hear?
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: The Legend of King Apple
desc:
Ever since I heard about 'em, I've
been questin' my butt off lookin' for
those legendary apples. And now,
at last, I found 'em! Hangin' from
some trees at the Ruined Pinnacle.
All I need now is for you to shift the
darn Volvidon blockin' 'em!

title: Treasure Pinnacle: Rice
desc:
I can tell you got the treasure trembles!
And yer want a bit of my extra-good
Chomoran Rice, don't yer? No? Well,
then don't go up to the Ruined Pinnacle
and hunt a Malfestio. Simple enough.
Don't do it if you don't want it, but don't
not do it if you do want it.

title: Queen of the Ruined Pinnacle
desc:
I got lost, and after wandering for
ages I found myself in a strange
fantasy land. Or so I thought. Actually,
it was the Ruined Pinnacle, and I'd
stumbled into Rathian territory. Me
and another lost traveler are hiding
from it now. Help!

title: Naked Aggression
desc:
There was a hunter in town walking
about in only his drawers! Naturally
I had to protect the townspeople,
so I questioned him. He claims a
Ceanataur ripped up his clothes!
I need you to verify his claims, and
eliminate the monster. If there is one.

title: Smithy Business
desc:
Every waking moment I spend
working on equipment, forging slowly
ahead. Every day, it's head down,
nose to the grindstone, hammering
away. The anvil is my life. I've no time
to be fetching Comet Rocks from the
Ruined Pinnacle! You can do that!

title: I See It Rollin'...
desc:
That stupid overgrown fanged
tumbleweed! This dumb Volvidon just
won't stop trundling around after me.
If only there was some brave, strong
hunter who could teach it a lesson
once and for all... Oh...? You'll take
care of it? Seriously? How sweet!

title: Dirty Deals
desc:
Here's a job from one of my regulars.
Apparently a Barroth is causing a
ruckus in the Desert, and the trade
routes are in complete disarray.
Go get that muddy scoundrel, and
watch out, okay? They move a lot
quicker than you'd expect!

title: Share the Load (and the Reward)
desc:
You gotta help me with a Quest
the Master of Style gave me!
What I need you to do is hunt
a Nibelsnarf in the Desert, while
I take care of the other monster!
This is gonna be Radalos!

title: Shadows in the Desert Lake
desc:
I was fishing in the Desert, like you
do, when I caught a Plesioth. Wouldn't
you know it, he wasn't too pleased?
Now he's gone a little bit crazy and
our caravan's in a tizzy. Any more of
this and we won't have anywhere to
go back to. Can you help out?

title: Not Mushroom to Swing a Congalala
desc:
You can get real good mushrooms in
the Jungle. But lately, them Conga-
whatsits have been hogging all the
good ones. And that's not the half of
it. The Congadoodahs stink so much
that you can barely sniff out the
mushrooms! You know what to do.

title: Sky Tribe: Savior of the Skyway
desc:
Oh, Hunter, we're in trouble! A big
dumb Rathian has staked out its
territory right in the path of the
Soaratorium. Can you go to the Jungle
and fix it so it, uh, doesn't have any
more birthdays?

title: Face-off in the Jungle
desc:
This time we'd like you to hunt a
Nargacuga in the Jungle. You should
be able to pick up a few things you'll
need for some new Hunter Arts, but
we'll save that for when you come
back victorious. Just keep an open
mind and you'll learn a lot.

title: Hit the Lights
desc:
My eyes! My eyeeees! Those blasted
Great Thunderbugs are so bright,
I think they've blinded me! There's a
great swarm of them here in the
Jungle. Please, make them go away
before they leave me with permanent
retinal damage!

title: Shelling Out for Fashion
desc:
Shell-based accessories are, like,
the trendiest things right now in the
city. I'm an urban gal at heart, so this
is pretty much a life and death matter
for me! So, uh, can you get me the
materials I need from the Jungle?

title: Royal Assassination
desc:
What are we travelers to do
now that a Rathian's taken up
occupancy at the Ancestral
Steppe? Health and Safety are
sure to have something to say
about this! Unless of course, you'd
like to deal with the matter?

title: Feeding Time
desc:
I went to feed the Nerscylla, and it
started getting a bit bitey. I made
haste, but unfortunately, I dropped my
notes. Could you take care of the
beast so I can retrieve them? Just
remember, it's more scared of you
than you are of it.

title: Poisoned Primal Forest
desc:
Oh dear... A pack a Ioprey in the Primal
Forest is getting poison everywhere,
and villagers could be in danger. We
wanted to take care of this ourselves,
but at this rate, we'll even have to start
asking Felynes for help. Oh, is there
nobody capable of doing this Quest?

title: Through Thick and Fin
desc:
I heard about some of the life habits
of Zamtrios and thought "Eureka!
This is perfect for the Hunter Art
I'm working on!" And it is! And you'll
see too, because you're going to
hunt it for me in the Frozen Seaway!
Give me the details when you return.

title: Zamite Fright
desc:
So there I was, mining away at the
Frozen Seaway, when suddenly I
felt something sharp stick me from
behind. I tell you, when I saw those
odd spiky beasts, I ran like the wind!
Even now, I walk around covering my
backside... Those Zamites have to go!

title: Fishing's Lure
desc:
Nothin' beats fishing. It's just like being
a kid again! You should take a load off
and catch some Goldenfish. You'll find
a glimmer of the good ol' days in the
glitter of water in the Frozen Seaway!

title: The Next Stage of E-Volvi-lution
desc:
On my way home from the Jurassic
Frontier I was spotted by a Volvidon
and a Great Maccao! Luckily I threw
myself into a series of somersaults and
I think they've accepted me as one of
them. I think they like me! Unfortunately
I'm super dizzy already, so help...?
objective:
Hunt a Volvidon and
a Great Maccao

title: Brute of the Sands
desc:
There's something mighty abnormal
out there in the Dunes. It's so tough
it can't be hurt with normal weapons,
and covers itself in mud. It's all very
fascinating! There's still so much we
don't know about this majestic creature.
Could you catch me one?
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Trade Dispute
desc:
Our usual trade route is being
terrorized by a Nibelsnarf! We'd just
tough it out, but Nibelsnarfs will eat
anything, and I can't afford to lose
another shipment! Please teach the
brute it's not okay to steal! Theft isn't
a victimless crime!

title: A Coil to Arms
desc:
You know, you shouldn't laugh when
a girl tells you embarrassing yet
formative traumas, like getting a
monster wedgie! DON'T LAUGH!
...Um, maybe I just shouldn't have
told you. Oh, and your mark is in
the Verdant Hills.

title: Chilled to the Marrow
desc:
We're hoping to give our footbath a
boost with an extra special, zippy
zappy electric bath! Purrovided we
can come up with the right
meowterials. Want to help? Then we'll
need you to hunt a Khezu at the
Arctic Ridge. Nothing has as much zap!

title: Earn Your Strength
desc:
If you want more power...you have
to prove...prove that you're strong
enough...
Blangonga...in the Arctic Ridge...
If you're not strong enough...
you'll fail.

title: We've Reached Peak Blangonga
desc:
I saw...ulp...a Blangonga on the
mountain. Not so weird, you might think.
But when...urk...I saw the second one
emerge from the ground, I high-tailed it
to a cave. This is altogether too many
Blangongas for one person to deal
with! Please...ulp...deal with it for me!

title: Please Plesioth Me!
desc:
Everyone in Cheeko Sands is in trouble!
A Plesioth has made an appurrance
and is furolicking very destructively!
It's rampaging around the Misty Peaks,
and the people of Cheeko Sands
asked if you'd purrlease hunt it.

title: Jumping at Shadows
desc:
Oh my gosh! I totally just saw a huge
black shadow jump into a tree! I think
it's going to attack the village! Arghhh!
The problem is, no one believes me!
You have to help my village! And then
tell them I was right and they should
take me more seriously in future!!!

title: The Owled Man and the Sea
desc:
Welp, I guess this old-timer's plumb out
of luck. Thought it'd be nice to retire in
the sun on the Deserted Island, but the
place has a Malfestio problem and it's
got its owl dust all over everything. Oh,
don't worry about me, I'm just old and
useless. I'm sure I'll be fine. I'll manage.

title: That's No Rock...
desc:
The rock! It was m-m-moving! It was
alive, I swear! I've never seen anything
so uncanny... I'll never forget it, ever,
but maybe if you get rid of whatever's
behind the mystery, I'll find a way to
live with the trauma...

title: The Shadow in the Cave
desc:
We were doing some research in the
caves when all of a sudden, something
really creepy and gross plopped down
behind us. We managed to escape,
but we can't do any research with that
thing up there!

title: March Melancolico
desc:
The stage: the darkest marshlands,
damp with haunting melancholy! Our
villain: the ultimate Najarala! Our hero:
a hunter of legend! ...That would be
you. Go earn us a standing ovation!
Break a leg!

title: Interruption: Conga Line
desc:
Give me strength! If there's a village
where they sell a cure for idiocy,
please tell me where it is. What kind
of Guild Gal runs off to take on a
couple of Congalalas? Please make
sure you get to them first.

title: Commission: Basarios
desc:
Hey, so I just got a request to hunt
down a Basarios, but I'm incredibly
busy doing an important, uh, other
thing. I'd be very grateful if you could
take it on for me. I'd hurry if I was you,
or you might not make it to the
Volcano in time!

title: Afro Soul Is a Way of Life
desc:
Oh baby! If you want to truly
funk up your soul, there's only
one place to go: the Volcano!
Hot hot HOT, baby! You got this!
You're gonna dip your soul in
some o' that Lavasioth magic,
baby!

title: Feeling Generally Crabby
desc:
AAAARGH! DAMN IT!!!
I was all ready to get back to
questing, but my guts are STILL
acting up. I better pass this one on
to you, Scrawn. Gotta hunt a Shogun
Ceanataur in the Volcano. Even you
can manage that, right? HAHAHA!

title: Great Ore Discovery
desc:
Great news! A new Coal bed
has been discovered in the
Volcano, and as much as I'd
like to get in on that action,
the place is Basarios turf.
Care to go mining for me,
Hunter?

title: Minion's Devotion
desc:
Recently, minion's sense of
duty has been lacka-wacking!
Cha-Cha has prepared Quest
to solidify minion's devotion!
Go bash many monster in aka-arena!
If minion not up to challenge, come
tell Cha-Cha, okay?

title: So Notable: Hyper Hermitaur
desc:
The next page of my notebook
is whispering to me, Squiggle. And do
you know what it's saying? It's saying
HYPER MONSTERS! So, I figure I should
give it what it wants! Could you hunt
down a Daimyo Hermitaur while I
watch from a safe distance?

title: Revenge from the Skies
desc:
Oh, that Yian Kut-Ku had such an aura...
I've never seen the likes of it before!
I'll bet it was some kind of spectral
manifestation of the unquiet spirits of
its hunted brethren! What's certain is
it was totally consumed by rage! Be
careful when you hunt it!

title: Commission: Hyper Kecha Wacha
desc:
There's so much to learn from those
so-called "Hyper" monsters, but there's
nobody I trust to bring back the kind of
data I'm interested in...except you,
hunter. Could you go to the Ancestral
Steppe and hunt down a Hyper Kecha
Wacha for me, please?
subquest: Wound Kecha Wacha's ears and tail

title: Frog's Face, Demon's Heart
desc:
The mug on that Tetsucabra is as
scary as any demon. How can I put the
nature of its fierce, defiant aura into
words...? Anyway, I've got the feeling
that it's going to take a hard-bitten
Hunter like you to have that beast
on the boat to Hades.

title: The Verdant Hills Are Alive
desc:
I'm sort of concerned about this Hyper
Gypceros running wild over the
Verdant Hills... It's pretty inconvenient,
and the monster just seems happy as a
pig in mud. It's really raising my stress
levels, so do you think you could maybe
convince it to behave? Or just hunt it?

title: The Hype is Royal
desc:
I'm researching Hyperosity in monsters,
and my experiments call for a Royal
Ludroth. Aren't you the least bit
interested to know how one would
look all Hypered up? Sure you are!
Go find me one of those babies
and let's find out! For science!
subquest: Wound Royal Ludroth's head and mane

title: Harvest Tour: Volcanic Hollow
desc:
Ah, gathering time again? Then
I've got just the Quest for you,
darling. Gathering up as much as
you can, and deliver a Paw Pass
Ticket when you've had enough.
objective:
Survive until time expires or
deliver a Paw Pass Ticket

title: The Unapproachable Yian Garuga
desc:
Please, Hunter, I need you to hunt
a Yian Garuga! It's been on the most
wanted list for so long now, I've lost
count of how many other hunters it's
taken down! I think its nest is in the
Ruined Pinnacle. Go give that big
chicken a real good basting!

title: Paralyzing Peril
desc:
I came here with my meowster, but
as we were exploring I felt a tingle
in my meowstache. Then we were
attacked by the tingle king himself,
Lagiacrus! We got purralyzed before
we could blink! Purrlease help!

title: Return from the Pinnacle
desc:
We came to survey the Ruined
Pinnacle, but had a run-in with
a very tetchy Zinogre. We tried to
evacuate all the researchers, but
the unfamiliar terrain is really
making that difficult. Could you
remove the Zinogre, please?

title: Pinnacle Pioneering
desc:
Howdy, everybody! The King
requested a thorough cataloging
of the Ruined Pinnacle. Just when I
was thinking how completely normal
and uninteresting it was, POW!
SHAZAM! You're up, Hunter!

title: Problem at the Pinnacle
desc:
The Ruined Pinnacle hides so many
secrets, but my efforts to uncover
them have been met by more than
a little resistance from the resident
Gore Magala. Any chance you could,
you know...make it go away?

title: The Boiling Broiling Desert
desc:
Blazing sun! Earth dry as a bone!
And to top it off, the flaming breath
of a Glavenus! It's too hot to stand!
Unless someone does something about
that beast, I won't make it out of this
desert. How about you, Hunter? Or is
the challenge too hot to handle?

title: Strutting the Royal Runway
desc:
The spotlight beckons! For
my next performance, I am to
dance gracefully upon the
shell of a Neopteron. Our
props team is too stingy to
make one, so fetch me the real
thing instead. Break a leg!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Water Kerfuffle
desc:
My meowster, ever the romeowntic,
said he met the meowst wonderful
lady in a dream. He said something
about her "wondrous bubbles" and
"lustrous pink crest"... Oh my stripes
and whiskers, he's fallen in love with
a Mizutsune, hasn't he? Help!

title: Hunt-a-Thon: Yian Garuga
desc:
A pair of Yian Garuga have reared
their ugly heads, and it seems the
Jungle isn't big enough for both of
them. They're just screaming their
heads off and smashing things up!
Hunter, please put a stop to their
pathetic squabble!

title: Primal Forest Fears
desc:
While traversing the Primal Forest,
I've realized something very
strange. I should have been going
east this whole time, but I've clearly
gone west. I...I can't move my feet!
Oh no...no, it can't be... It's a--
-- Here the record ends --
objective:
Hunt a Nerscylla and
a Malfestio

title: Hunt-a-Thon: Gravios
desc:
An' ole pal o' mine asked if this
here Caravaneer could take a
gander at some Gravios a-nestin'
in the Primal Forest. Normally I'd
be happy to oblige the feller, but
I can't handle 'em on my ownsome.
Can ya handle maybe two of 'em?
objective:
Hunt 2 before time expires
or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
failure:
Reward hits 0, or time expires
before hunting 2 Gravios

title: The Lost Expedition
desc:
I'm worried, Hunter. We haven't
heard a peep from one of our
Frozen Seaway-expedition teams.
Mind investigating? It's a cold,
cruel region, so gird those loins
before you go! Pave the way
for our exploration.

title: Ice Recovery
desc:
Let me tell you about the most amazing
thing the Frozen Seaway has to offer.
Imagine: ice from Gammoth snowballs
that's been trampled down to become
part of the ground. Ugh, so
post-modern! I must have some!
Will you help me?

title: A Certain Gravitas
desc:
Ah, Volcanic Hollow, bereft of life,
where not a blade of grass grows
nor cheerful swallow sings. The only
thing that stirs is the bubbling magma...
and the furiously rampaging Gravios,
of course. Actually, you should
probably do something about that.

title: Hunter Dojo: Tail-do
desc:
You seek the way of the hunter,
do you? Then you must hone your
abilities! Your mind must be as sharp
as the tail of Glavenus-sensei! And
when we are finished, you will have
a smoldering battle instinct to rival
the beast itself!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: It's Gotta Be Coal
desc:
Do they expect me to work my culinary
magic using a wood fire, like some kind
of common COOK? I am a chef! I
require Coal! You! Fetch me some from
the Volcanic Hollow. You should really
know how to make a pickaxe by now --
Mystery Bone and Iron Ore, remember?

title: The Royal Guard
desc:
A Seltas Queen is nesting in
the Jurassic Frontier! Rumor
has it "her majesty" relies
on a soldier-like male of
the species for protection.
I could write a book about
their relationship. Help me!

title: Eclipse at Jurassic Frontier
desc:
Boy, has my luck run out today. I was
fleeing through the Jurassic Frontier
when I tripped and fell. I cried out in
pain, and a disgusting black creature
sidled up to me. This is it, I'm done for.
Heavens help me! I promise I'll change
my ways!

title: PR Disaster
desc:
There's been sightings of a serious
threat to Bherna's tourist industry! And
people, I guess. We've got a Glavenus
on the ground and a Rathian in the sky...
We're basically inaccessible as it
stands! Please, do something! Our
PR hangs in the balance!
objective:
Hunt a Rathian
and a Glavenus

title: Predator in the Hills
desc:
I was herding a flock of Moofahs
in the Verdant Hills, when suddenly
along came a Rathian and a Rathalos!
I hid the moment I saw them, but I
was too scared to move, and so
were my babies! Please, save us
before we end up on their plate!
objective:
Hunt a Rathalos
and a Rathian

title: I Hope It's Not Barioth Flavored
desc:
Discovery of the century! A machine
that CREATES SORBET! I'll call it...
"Sorby McSorbface". Or something.
I can decide on a name after you get
back from Barioth hunting. Oh, did I
forget to mention that? I need you to
go hunt a Barioth. Snap to it!

title: Hunter Dojo: Tusk-fu
desc:
Push, shove, heave, and then some!
To join our dojo, you must first capture
Gammoth-sensei! There are no clever
tricks. You must become one with
the mountain. Firm! Strong! Resolute!
And being really darn stubborn
can't hurt either!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Howl at the Moon
desc:
I'm trying to remember something
I saw in a dream long ago... You
know what might help me recall it,
Hunter? If you could purrchance
go to the Misty Peaks and hunt a
Zinogre. That news is sure to jog
my memory, nya!

title: Hunter Dojo: Bubble-jitsu
desc:
So, you would master the way of the
hunter? Let's journey on the path to
hunterdom together! A true hunter has
total mastery of their techniques,
making each hunt a bewitching dance.
Go and study under Mizutsune-sensei
to learn how to move with grace!

title: "Kiken" Means "Danger"!
desc:
I see it! Up above ship! Biiiig kage!
Kage means "shadow"! In all the blue
sky, a Rathalos flying. Not rumor!
I see it with own eyes! It appear in
single minute, DOKAAAAN! That why
you must hunt! I relying on you!

title: The Sun, Also Wyverns
desc:
Welp, looks like this old-timer's outta
luck again. It's such a nice day, I thought
I'd go for a dip in the sea, but a
Lagiacrus popped up and shocked me.
No, save your concern. I'll just lie here
and not move until I die and stop being
such a hindrance to you young folk.

title: Hunter Dojo: Lightning Wushu
desc:
Hey, bro! Another acolyte on the road
to hunterlightenment? I dig it. A hunter's
gotta be aggressive, know what I'm
sayin'? Strike like lightning, instill fear
like thunder, all that jazz. You wanna
learn how to do that? Go talk to
Astalos-sensei. By which I mean "hunt".

title: Uragaan Grief
desc:
I got sent to the Volcano on a
meownster-hunting expedition but
a big, furrocious Uragaan purrevented
us from going any further! I can see
it even meow, looming befur me...
Purrlease, Hunter, meowst it from
that place!

title: Heavenly Fire, Earthly Flame
desc:
What's happening!? First a monster
comes flying out of the volcano and
then another monster comes bursting
out from the earth! Where can I hide!?
And I'm all out of Cool Drinks! I'm at
the end of my rope here!
objective:
Hunt a Lavasioth
and a Rathalos

title: Giant Dragon Invasion
desc:
An urgent report from the Schrade
region came in. A Lao-Shan Lung has
been attacking settlements there.
I'd like you to help defend a fort on
one of its regular attack paths. Pay
attention to barricade integrity, and of
course, keep an eye on the monster!
objective:
Slay a Lao-Shan Lung
or repel it
failure:
Reward hits 0, or Front or Main
Barricade integrity hits 0.

title: Frontier Fisticuffs
desc:
I feel like the local monsters are
mocking our efforts to settle this land!
A couple more of them have appeared
to do their worst, but we're not giving
up! This is our land and they can't have
it! We'll build our settlement over
their dead bodies!

title: Down With This Sort of Thing
desc:
What on earth is going on!? Monsters
are just going about willy-nilly making
the worst racket on MY Ancestral
Steppe! This kind of noise pollution
has to stop! Somebody contact the
Guild and get this mess fixed!

title: Searing Sands
desc:
Wind's getting hot... Big storm's coming,
like we've not seen for years. Round
about now a whole bunch of monsters'll
gather together. If you like a challenge
I can tell you where to find them. Of
course, if you end up biting the hot
gritty dust that's your own concern.

title: Arena Bakalaka-Battle! Woo!
desc:
Happy day-day! Hunter now
eligibbible for become minion.
But minion of Cha-Cha or Kayamba?
Final-final test at hand. In Quest,
think-alink of all your true-true leader
did for you and make decision.
Shaka-laka!

title: Trial by Fart
desc:
So, not to brag or anything but I'm a
pretty big deal in my hunter class. They
expect great things of me. So I thought
I'd go prove them all right by hunting
something awesome! Uh, I didn't realize
Congalala are so hard to hunt though.
Can you come save my reputation?

title: The Pinnacle of Good Records
desc:
Howdy everybody! Out on the road
I saw huge boulders cracking together
and something came lumbering out!
It gave off a sort of black aura, and
I thought, well darn, this is gonna make
for one heck of a record! You wanna
get over here and help me record it?

title: The Pinnacle of Terror
desc:
I'm spending time in the company of
some Lynians at the Ruined Pinnacle.
See, they took me in when I was
chased by a Hyper Rathian. I'm a live
and let live kind of hunter, but these
Lynians might still be in danger. Can you
take out the Rathian? I'll just chill here.

title: Eat in Pieces
desc:
I have this kind of embarrassing habit
whenever I eat, so I thought what
better place to eat in privacy than
the Desert, right? WRONG. I nearly
turned into dinner when this Nibelsnarf
with a seriously dark aura turned up!
I just want to eat in peace!

title: Diabolical Deluge
desc:
The worst has happened. A Hyper
Plesioth arrived in the Jungle and has
flooded the river. Six villages are
underwater! Communication is cut off
due to the damage. We need an
outstanding hunter to get in there
and sort this mess out!

title: Temnoceranophobia
desc:
My master is an awesome hunter...
most of the time. One day he just
blurted out that he can't deal with
"creepy Nerscylla" -- something about
their eyes? -- and now he's just not the
same to me. Can you wipe this stain
from his honor by taking over the hunt?

title: ...Or Just Wait for It to Poop
desc:
What I'm about to tell you is absolutely
true, I swear. It sounds crazy, but my
armor-crafting friend made a suit of
hermetically sealed armor and...well,
got swallowed whole by a Hyper
Najarala. Please do something, Hunter!

title: Zamtrios, Right Ahead!
desc:
It's unsinkable, they said. Enjoy the
maiden voyage of this decadent ship,
they said. It definitely won't be split
in half by a marauding sharkbeast, they
said. Look, can someone hunt this thing?
The carpets are getting ruined in first
class. I can't even look at steerage.

title: Frozen Seaway Horror Story
desc:
I was crawling around a cave on the
Frozen Seaway, looking for something,
as one does, when I became aware of
a presence. A white face floated in the
dark behind me. A jagged mouth...a
long...long...neck...
-- Here the record ends --

title: Sweets for My Sweets
desc:
I wanna repay everyone who helped
advertise my business by making a
super awesome dessert! All the secret
ingredients I need are in the Jurassic
Frontier, but what is also there is a
Malfestio! Eek! Hunty, pleeease help
get rid of it? I'll give you cake? Please?

title: Nargacuga in the Jurassic Frontier
desc:
The Jurassic Frontier. All is shrouded
in darkness. Suddenly, crimson splits
the gloom on wings of shadow! The
fearsome Nargacuga stands, wrapped
in fog and illuminated by a single
shaft of moonlight... Then you come
out of nowhere and beat it up. Okay?

title: The Mud Must Flow
desc:
Here's a tip: the most amazing thing
from the Dunes is obviously the mud
a Barroth flings off itself, once it's all
dried in the sun! Ugh, just talking about
it makes me want some. Hey, can you
help me snag some?

title: Shhhhut Up
desc:
*psst* We had some heavy snow, now
everyone is terrified there'll be an
avalanche. We have to be super quiet!
Even this writing is in a whisper. We can
hold out, but there's a Hyper Blangonga
nearby who could ruin everything!
Could you maybe shut it up?

title: No Place to Run
desc:
I was walking down the safest road
I know to get back home, nothing bad's
ever happened on this road and you
know where I'm going with this, don't
you? Hyper Shogun Ceanataur. You
gotta get rid of it or I'll never get
back to my village. Please help!

title: It's a Miner's Life
desc:
'Ey up. Been trouble down t'mine.
No sooner did we start work than a
bleedin' great Lavasioth turned up!
We miners're no stranger to danger,
but we're not idiots. If you could duff
it up or summit so we can get back
to work, that'd be grand. Ta!

title: Let the Games Begin
desc:
Ladies, gentlemen, Lynians and
Temnocerans! Welcome to this special
surprise show of mine! We've got a
Kecha Wacha full of beans and a
Nerscylla that's even more aggressive
than usual, and they're both gonna
make a beeline for you! Good luck!
objective:
Hunt a Kecha Wacha
and a Nerscylla

title: Material Old Girl
desc:
Young'uns need to know the fun of
getting materials from monsters to
upgrade their armor! You look like you
know your way around different
armors, so I'm going to ask you to take
down a Hyper Basarios and a Hyper
Shogun Ceanataur in the Volcano!

title: A Pinnacle Just for You
desc:
My acquaintance says hunters love to
pursue their prey as long as they've
got the stamina to do so. Naturally, I
was inclined to discover whether there
was any truth to this. Would you mind
popping up to the Ruined Pinnacle to
demonstrate for me?

title: Reality or Fantasy?
desc:
Ugh... The Jurassic Frontier... Yes, that's
where the horned phantom showed
itself... And unless that white beast's
fury is stopped, the land will be
plunged into disaster! Hunters of the
Oracle, hear me! Defeat the Phantom
Beast and fulfill the prophecy!

title: The Phantom Beast!
desc:
That thing we spotted up on the Arctic
Ridge must have been the Phantom
Beast. It radiated a faint light as it slid
along the ground. Whoever hunts it
down is in for some pretty sweet loot,
that's for sure!

title: Sky Render
desc:
Well, darling, this one will be hairy
with a capital H. Your target? It tears
through the sky, leaving red trails,
and all who see it relay tales of
woe and misfortune. In short, it's
a Valstrax. Don't let your guard
down for a second.
objective: Slay a Valstrax or repel it

title: Hunter Dojo: Valstrax-ryu
desc:
You're looking pretty huntlightened,
we must say. Feel like training? One
of a hunter's most important weapons
is resourcefulness, a quick wit, like the
ability to read Valstrax's attacks in its
wingtips. Think you've got it? Go see
Valstrax-sensei and see what happens!
objective: Slay a Valstrax or repel it

title: Supersonic
desc:
You know what? My ship's a ton faster
than that piece of junk over there. But
we ended up gettin' chased by some
superfast monster, and the shockwave
it left behind dropped us right outta the
air. Nobody hurts my ship like that,
nobody! Can someone take him out?
objective: Slay a Valstrax or repel it

title: Scales of Justice
desc:
So I was on my way to hunt up a
shipment of Popo fur when a Valstrax
passed by me. I hovered around for a
bit just to see if it hadn't dropped a
shiny, shiny scale...when it spotted me.
I don't need to explain what happened
next, do I? Just avenge me, please!
objective: Slay a Valstrax or repel it

title: Battle of 1001 Blades
desc:
Heh heh heh... Did you know the
scales of a Seregios are as sharp
as any blade? I wonder what'd it
be like to cut something with one of
those babies... How'd you like to
hunt a Seregios and test out those
scales for yourself? Heh heh heh...

title: Beware Twin Horns on the Sand
desc:
I've got a good test for you, darling.
A Diablos is lurking around the Desert,
blocking us off from some precious
resources, so it needs to be removed.
If you're who I know you are, you'll be
able to take care of this with style.
Make it one to get my heart fluttering!

title: Deviljho Hunt
desc:
Yeah, I used to be a hunter. I loved the
job, too. But then one day this massive
beast came out of nowhere... Almost
did me in. I quit the biz. I couldn't hack
it. But you -- I bet you could take that
monster on...

title: Paint It Gold
desc:
I simply adore things that are decked
out in glittering gold. I've heard stories
about the Rajang's golden hair. I would
love to acquire some for my collection,
so would you hunt the beast at the
Ancestral Steppe for me, perhaps?

title: Tracing the Family Tree
desc:
*cough* I'm trying to trace the
evolution of *cough* flying wyverns by
examining the primitive *sniff* skeletal
structure of the Tigrex. Would you hunt
one for me? After all, it's not like--
*splutter* not like I could-- *hack*
*wheeze* It's not like I-- *haaark*...

title: Price Freeze
desc:
Navigating the Frozen Seaway isn't
this sailor's idea of fun, but I could have
done without the Tigrex playing hide
and seek around the place. You need
to put a stop to it before my prices
freeze for good!

title: Seregios Scuffle
desc:
I really didn't deserve any of this. I was
just observing some volcanic activity
here, when a Seregios showed up and
started whaling on me. Like, dude, if
the Volcano blows it'll take you with it!
We're on the same side here! Not any
more, though. Wanna hunt it for me?

title: Slam Gunk
desc:
You know about the Brachydios that
live in the Volcanic Hollow? Course
you don't. I'll keep it simple: they can
somehow activate the slime, which
makes it explode. I need to know how
they do this, and you're going to catch
one for me. Think you can manage?
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Diabolical Delight
desc:
Bwahahaha, I can't believe it! I heard
stories long ago about the terrifying
Diablos, and now I'm actually in one!
Can't tell you how happy that makes
me! So, are you gonna be the one to
carve your name into history and
capture one of these bad boys?
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Emergency at the Arctic Ridge!
desc:
Urgent. Signs of Rajang detected
in Arctic Ridge. Civilian travel routes
in danger. People stranded on
mountain also at risk. Proceed
immediately to Arctic Ridge with
all haste.

title: Misty Opportunity?
desc:
There's a lovely little spot in the
Misty Peaks that's nice and warm,
purrfect for a catnap! Or it would be,
except there's a dumb Duramboros
making everything cold and shady
with its massive bulk! You gotta save
my catnap before it's too late!

title: Everything in Moderation
desc:
Dearie me! What a to-do! A Deviljho
in the Marshlands! It'll gobble up
all the lovely Aptonoth if we're not
careful! Then there'll be none left for
me to eat! I will not stand for such a
thing, you hear? Please take care of
that Deviljho and save my Aptonoth!

title: Lavaclad Beast
desc:
Agnaktor surround themselves in
lava that cools and hardens to form
a protective armor, right? I was
wondering why I couldn't use that
principle for my own armor... Could
you take one on while I watch and
make notes? From a safe distance...

title: Brachydios Bypass
desc:
This Brachydios came out of nowhere
so me and my friend had to hide in
a cave. I was hurt so my friend acted
as a decoy so I could get away...but
he hasn't returned! I'm gonna go to
the Volcano to find him. Can you cover
me by hunting the Brachydios?

title: A Very Long Engravement
desc:
An airship's gone missing in the
Volcano region...and my fiancée was
on board. I know lots of Glavenus and
Gravios live in the region... I know it
looks grim, but I can't give up. Can
you hunt the monsters while I lead
the search party?
objective:
Hunt a Glavenus
and a Gravios

title: Ends of the Earth
desc:
I saw it! A monster with golden scales
making its way to the Sanctuary!
I'm getting all kinds of premonitions...
I wish I could say it was nothing, just
the ramblings of an old man, but I fear
destruction will follow, just like in the
legends... We have to do something.

title: A Titanic Clash
desc:
Uh... I may have, uh, done a bad thing.
I let an Agnaktor and a Duramboros
into the Arena at the same time, and
the two of them just went crazy! It's
like hell on earth in there! Please,
somebody do something before
more damage is done!
objective:
Hunt an Agnaktor
and a Duramboros

title: The Ol' Razzle Dazzle
desc:
You ready? You must be ready.
Both monsters are waiting for you
in what I can only assume is
eager anticipation! I want you to
give those beasties all you've got.
Give me a fantastic show!
objective:
Hunt a Deviljho
and a Rajang

title: Jurassic Skulduggery
desc:
Our sources inform us that a close
relative of the king has been abducted
by a faction seeking to overthrow His
Highness. They left by way of the
Jurassic Frontier, which is now brimming
with large monsters. Assist our rescue
party, Hunter, we beseech you!

title: Verdant Hills Missive
desc:
I've had ENOUGH! I've already had it
up to here dodging Yian Garuga beaks
and Najarala tails. Now there's a
Rathian and an Astalos!? This is my last
chance. Entrusted this note to a friendly
Mosswine. Go on without me, my
Mosswine friend. Run free! Find help!

title: Quest of Friendship
desc:
Feh heh heh, if this Quest doesn't make
us best buds I don't know what will!
Time to show the other Guildmasters
what you're made of with the mother
of all Quests! The harder the Quest
the deeper the bond, I always say!

title: Fiery Four-way Fracas
desc:
Hahahah! As soon as I heard how well
my apprentice was doing, I knew I had
to make some new armor to celebrate!
Guess who gets to go to the Volcano
and hunt every big sucker they can
find in the search for materials? YOU!
I'll keep the forge hot for you.

title: Castle on the Run
desc:
Ahtal-Ka, you know, the monster that's
rumored to be a moving fortress?
Well, it seems to have vanished
somewhere round the Forlorn Citadel.
Can something so big just disappear
like that? Now's our chance to find out.
Set course for battle!

title: Pitched Pinnacle Battle
desc:
We're up at the Ruined Pinnacle on
a survey but a Deviljho took us by
surprise. It had some kind of dark
aura and powerful attacks which are
giving us some trouble. If there's a
skilled hunter who can help us out of
this, that would be great.
subquest: Wound Deviljho's head, sever its tail

title: All Creatures Cleaved and Small
desc:
To learn the art of quick-draw, one's
mind must be still as water. And yet,
the Glavenus is seen to cut its prey
skillfully yet in a profound rage. I begin
to question my principles. Can you show
me the beast's combat techniques
to deepen my understanding?
subquest: Wound Glavenus's back and sever its tail

title: Backwater Battle
desc:
A Diablos with a strange, dark aura
has been seen wandering this desolate
place. But we're not going to let a little
thing like that deter us. We didn't come
here just to turn tail and run at the sight
of a terrifying rampaging monster! If it
thinks it can scare us away, it's wrong!

title: Rajang Against The Machine
client: Loc Lac Ruler of Some Renown
desc:
Long ago I banished a man who turned
out to be innocent, and he swore
revenge. Now I fear that time has
come, as he's leading a Hyper Rajang
to my city! I'm eager to make amends
with him and atone for my mistake,
but you must defend the city!

title: Seeking the Sea King
desc:
Hey there, kid! Remember when I
gave you those weapon blueprints?
Well, it just so happens I remembered
another one of 'em, and I think you'd
like it! Go hunt me down a Hyper
Lagiacrus in the Jungle and I'll slap
some of my smithly wisdom on ya!
subquest: Wound Lagiacrus's chest and sever its tail

title: If These Rocks Could Talk
desc:
Very clever of that hunted Hyper
Astalos to slip away in the Jungle like
that. Very clever indeed. But not
clever enough! I've located an outcrop
where the rocks have been deformed
by high electrical currents. Shall we
go and pay our friend a visit?

title: Appeal from Authority
desc:
Hunter, I ask this on behalf of all
the chiefs in this region: Please
hunt the Hyper Duramboros currently
rampaging through our villages.
(Ugh, the stress. Once I've rebuilt
my house and bought a new bed,
I'm going to nap for a week.)

title: Neopteronophobia
desc:
My master is an awesome hunter...most
of the time. He let slip that he can't
stand how Seltas Queens crunch up
Seltas. It would be super embarrassing
to be the apprentice of an
insectophobe, so could you get rid of
the bugs so he can stop shuddering?
subquest: Wound S.Queen's head and sever her tail

title: It Takes Mizutsune to Tango
desc:
I must have more pupils! Through me,
the ancient dance of our ancestors
lives on: the dance of the Hyper
Mizutsune! Is it not dazzling enough? I'll
simply have to go and refresh my skills
from the source. I can use the
experience to solicit more followers!
subquest: Wound Mizutsune's head and sever its tail

title: Something Wicked
desc:
What is with that disgusting freak
of a monster!? They already look
bad to begin with, but this one had
a big, creepy aura around it! That
thing needs to be hunted before
someone gets seriously injured!
Well don't just stand there -- GO!
subquest: Wound G. Magala's wingarms and wings

title: Setting the Barioth High
desc:
I rode out to the Frozen Seaway to
challenge a white knight who is said to
dwell there, but instead I found myself
faced with an odd black-glowing knight
in place of the white. I thought to
challenge him regardless but, alas, was
bested. Go in my place, I beg you!

title: The Big Push
desc:
We undergo rigorous training day
and night to protect our people. So
why can't we beat this one lumbering
Gammoth!? We hate to admit it,
but you're the best for dealing with
Hyper monsters like this guy. Go take
him down and keep our land safe!

title: What's Mine is Mine
desc:
You know how long it took us to
find some high-quality ore? Long
enough for an Uragaan to shuffle
up next to us and then start rolling
around wrecking the place! Get
its Hyper behind outta here before
the entire mine caves in!

title: Agnaktor's Deep
desc:
I was really getting very invested in
my research at the Volcanic Hollow.
If only that Hyper Agnaktor hadn't
shown up and ruined everything! It
even made me drop a rare Wycademy
book on archaeology! I can get it
back, I think, but I'd need your help.

title: Garuga's Comeuppance
desc:
Some jackanapes'd trashed up my
veggies, an' I was of a mind to give 'em
a real earful. 'Course, that was 'til I
heard some overgrown birdfowl gone
Hyper was what done the deed! Don't
look like he's in the mood for a talkin'.
Maybe see if a hunt'll do him good!
subquest: Wound Yian Garuga's head and wingtalon

title: Seregios Exposé
desc:
A Seregios, presumed Hyper, has
been sighted in the Dunes. Any and
all hunters capable of tackling the
creature are being scouted as we
speak. This has been your average
bystander chugging Cool Drinks,
reporting live from the scene.

title: Tigrex Trap
desc:
Some criminal with a grudge against
the Guild managed to lure some
hunters out to the mountain with a false
SOS call. Now they're being menaced
by a Hyper Tigrex! The criminal was
re-apprehended, but the Tigrex is
still at large and causing mayhem!
subquest: Wound Tigrex's head and sever its tail

title: Zinogre-enthusiasm
desc:
Looks like some Moga villagers got
attacked by a Hyper Zinogre on their
way to Yukumo. And I'm the one who
invited them to begin with... Ugh, it's
all my fault! I hate to be asking you,
but could you go out to the Deserted
Island and get them to safety?

title: Even Brachydios Need A Holiday
desc:
A Brachydios has started loiterin'
around the Deserted Island. It's makin'
it very difficult for people to use the
seaways, not to mention makin' us
Moga people mighty nervous. Why
does it even want to be there? There's
nothing to do!
subquest: Wound Brachydios's head and sever its tail

title: Marshland Fandango
desc:
Now there's a Gravios on my tail!
Why does this keep happening to me!?
Why am I not in the lab looking at it
under a microscope!? I'm no hunter.
I could take on all the Mosswine you
want, but this? Nu-uh. YOU do the
hunting, Hunter!

title: Let's Get Igneous
desc:
The Volcano really does have the
most striking rock formations! There's
one in particular I would love to get
my hands on, but it has to be toasted
by a Hyper Rathalos and left to
simmer in magma to get the full effect.
Does that strike you as doable?

title: R.I.P.
desc:
We were finally ready to sign a
peace treaty with the neighboring
military powers, but just as we were
putting pen to paper, along comes
a pair of Hyper wyverns! They're
no symbols of peace! Get them
out of here, pronto!
objective:
Hunt a Rathalos
and a Rathian

title: Death at My Greaves
desc:
The Primal Forest used to be a safe
place...relatively speaking. Now?
Nobody comes out of there alive.
Save for one girl, who was delirious
when we found her. Said she danced
toe-to-toe with Death itself. Turns out
"Death" is a pair of Hyper monsters!
objective:
Hunt a Gravios
and a Nerscylla

title: Pinnacle Problems
desc:
We knew what we were getting into
when we went to survey the Ruined
Pinnacle. We were ready for literally
anything...except THOSE! A Hyper
Basarios, Zinogre, AND Astalos? It's
a sight to behold, let me tell you.
Hunter, trounce that terrible trio!

title: A Bed of Sand
desc:
My son never came back from his
hunt. He knew what he was getting
into...but that doesn't stop me from
wanting something to remember him
by. It's no small errand, but would you
brave a den of Hyper monsters to
bring me closure, Hunter?

title: Jungle Funk
desc:
Stay calm! An airship delivering a large
consignment of Dung Bombs has
crashed, and now the Jungle's covered
in sh...*ahem*...shovel-loads of the stuff.
Hyper Monsters fleeing the stench
are hindering the recovery effort...
What to do...?

title: Arctic Ridge Allegiances
desc:
The Guildmasters have been vying to
see who gets the most attention from
you lately. I don't really care for such
nonsense, myself, so I'll just ask you to
clean out the Hyper Monsters at the
Arctic Ridge. Be careful -- they're all
exceptionally strong!

title: Arena Allegiances
desc:
I hear the Val Habar Master has
been proactive of late in trying to
monopolize your talent. Well, I'm not
going to sit idly by and let him have
his way! I've prepared a Quest for
you. Let your success demonstrate to
whom you really owe your loyalty!

title: Path of the Hunter
desc:
You are approaching true
huntlightenment. But there is still a
ways to go yet, Hunter! You already
have the strength you need -- you just
need to learn to wield it to your
maximum potential. Find your center,
and everything will flow from there!

title: Silver-Tongued Storyteller
desc:
I used to love my granny's tales of
the Silver Rathalos...but I never
imagined it actually existed. The
stories usually ended up with a nearby
village being attacked, so best not to
ignore this one... A skilled hunter, such
as yourself, could take care of it.
subquest: Wound Silver Rathalos's wings and back

title: Gold Digger
desc:
Listen! There's been a Gold Rathian!
You know, the one with the golden
scales! Made of gold! Sweet, precious
gold! Wow! I smell an opportunity to
make some serious dough! I hear you
can handle yourself. Fancy taking her
on for me?
subquest: Wound Gold Rathian's wings and back

title: The Sun and the Moon
desc:
The sun and the moon are opposing
entities, destined never to meet. But
suppose they do? Why, it would spell
the end of the world! And now the
Silver Rathalos and Gold Rathian at the
Ruined Pinnacle have come to bring
ruin upon us all! Gods have mercy!
objective:
Hunt a Silver Rathalos
and a Gold Rathian

title: By the Light of the Silvery Rath
desc:
I gaze here up at the moon in the
Misty Peaks, and oh, how beautiful
it looks! But wait...how strange.
It shines silver, but it's no moon...and
it's not particularly beautiful either.
Or round! 'Tis an evil glow! Please,
Hunter, make it leave!
subquest: Wound S.Rathalos's head and sever its tail

title: A Jurassic Frontier Just for You
desc:
My acquaintance says that hunters'
weapon arms tremble uncontrollably
when up against a powerful enemy.
Naturally, I was inclined to discover
whether there was any truth to this.
So how about you take a quick sojourn
to the Jurassic Frontier and show me?
subquest: Wound G.Rathian's head and sever its tail

title: A Tragedy in Silver and Gold
desc:
My husband protected me from those
fiends, those monsters! But they were
Hyper monsters, and he was just one
man... He never stood a chance. I've
spent all my life searching for them,
and I've tracked them to the Ruined
Pinnacle. Please, put an end to this pain.
objective:
Hunt a Silver Rathalos
and a Gold Rathian

title: Heaven and Hell
desc:
I've seen many a monster in my time,
but I've never seen such a disgusting
one before. Seems like a bad omen
if you ask me... Hey, young 'un, why not
take care of that beast? You know,
before something bad goes down...

title: Primal Screams
desc:
We've just had word from the Primal
Forest. It seems one of our expedition
teams was attacked by an irregular
type of Gore Magala. We'll need you
to hunt it while we evacuate the team.
It won't be easy, I know, but you're the
only one we can turn to, Hunter!

title: The Jungle VIP
desc:
I was in the Jungle pursuing a monster,
but this crazy golden furball came
leaping out at me. It wasn't like your
usual Rajang, either. It was furious,
attacking anything that moved! You
gotta get rid of it for me, please! I'm
gonna get flashbacks...

title: Deranged Desert Deviljho
desc:
I can't believe this. We've clearly
claimed this land and now some
Deviljho's shown up to attack us and
our little town. I'm not gonna let it eat
all our hard work! Now the odds might
be bad, but as long as we look to the
future we'll be fine! Who's with me!?

title: Brachydios Brute Squad
desc:
We were visiting Ingle Isle when we
were attacked by some creepy
monster covered in slime, which
slapped its creepy slime-arms in a
flash of light and sent us all flying!
This isn't how you treat a defense
squad! Go on, teach it some manners!

title: Steel Yourself
desc:
Hey, have you heard anything about
this steel dragon doohickey in the
Jungle? I need it. I need to make a
sword out of a dragon. I've never
needed anything more in my life. I
also need you to take care of it while
I pick up the materials, okay?
objective:
Slay a Kushala Daora
or repel it
subquest: Wound K.Daora's head and sever its tail

title: Blizzard Blower
desc:
Forecasts says it should be clear, yet
the blizzard goes on and on. I suspect
that the appearance of that Kushala
Daora is responsible for the sudden
changes in weather. It'd be quite a
challenge for us to get rid of it...
Do you think you could look into it?
objective:
Slay a Kushala Daora
or repel it
subquest: Wound Kushala Daora's head and wings

title: Out of Thin Air
desc:
While out on a mission, I got that feeling
I was being followed. I spun round but
there was nothing there. Spooked me
for sure, but just as I was thinking it was
all my imagination, the beast suddenly
revealed itself! No time to explain
further, just get out there and slay it!
objective: Slay a Chameleos or repel it

title: Into Thin Air
desc:
The other day, I came across one of
those Elder Dragons you hear about in
the stories. Thought I was about to bite
it, but then it just vanished! Hey! Don't
give me that look! I know what I saw!
Vanished right into nothin'! I hope you,
or someone else, can take care of it...
objective: Slay a Chameleos or repel it
subquest: Break Chameleos's horn and sever its tail

title: Sandblasting
desc:
Big explosions have been spotted
sending huge plumes of sand into the
air. Might be the work of a Teostra. It'll
be a dangerous mission, but if we want
to keep nearby villages safe, we'll
need a skilled hunter like you to help.
We pray you're up to the challenge!
objective:
Slay a Teostra
or repel it
subquest: Wound Teostra's head and sever its tail

title: Explosion Marks the Spot
desc:
I came here looking for lost treasure
at the Volcano, but unfortunately it
seems to be well guarded! The
treasure's just out of reach, and unless
we can avoid the beast's explosions,
we'll never lay hands on it. So...fancy
helping me fulfill my dream of riches?
objective:
Slay a Teostra
or repel it

title: A Bone to Pick
desc:
My whole village vanished in a single
night. All my friends who lived by the
sea, even their newborn child, all gone.
For some reason I was spared, and
since then I have cherished one hope,
and one hope only: that someone'll turn
that bag of bones into literal bones.

title: Trial by Akantor
desc:
The Hunter's Guild has massed its
forces and managed to corner an
Akantor. All that remains is to hunt it
down now. Of course, this is a highly
dangerous task, so we're looking for
experienced hunters to take the job.
Think you've got what it takes?

title: Polar Peril
desc:
I have another confidential job for you.
It's rather private, but important. I'd
appreciate your discretion. The job
entails you putting down a certain
Ukanlos in the Polar Field. It's a
dangerous one for sure, so if you want
we can discuss worst-case scenarios?

title: Who Will Hunt the Rain?
desc:
I can't remember the last day it didn't
rain. We're all out of dry firewood, and
even if we had any, the wind would just
blow out our fires. Please, I can't stand
this storm anymore! Help us, before
we all catch pneumonia!

title: Glory Glory Alatreon
desc:
Disasters befall us, lives are lost.
In the wake of the dragon, only death
remains. Its coming means ruin.
Repent, people! Repent of your sins!
Unless some brave hunter wants to
come and slay this thing for us?

title: Fade to Black
desc:
The black dragon of legend is no
longer just a legend. Make use of
what you find within the ancient castle
and you might stand a chance. The
fate of our nation lies in your hands!
objective: Slay a Fatalis or repel it

title: The End Is Nigh
desc:
It's come! The time has come! Not to
mention the dragon! Its scales are
steeped in blood! It leaves hellfire
in its wake! Hunter, if you think you
can stop it, then now is the time to
give it a whirl!
objective: Slay a Fatalis or repel it

title: Old Fatalis
desc:
Hohoho, the time is ripe! The hour is
come! Now the party begins and we
must all dance, dance, dance! Put on
your best armor, pick up your best
weapon and greet your partner!
Don't forget to bow! Ahahahaha!
objective: Slay a Fatalis or repel it

title: Prowler's First Errand
desc:
My! Why, aren't you a cutie!
Tough as any hunter, you
say? I see... In that case,
could I trouble you to bring
me some Unique Ferns
from the Jurassic Frontier?
Good luck, dear!

title: Jurassic Fungologist
desc:
You like kinoko? Jumbo Village
love kinoko! Villagers ask Neko
to gather Abyssal Mushrooms
from Jurassic Frontier. Saa!
Do me this favor and kinoko
trade get better, too! "Kinoko"
means mushroom!

title: Lucky Frontier Cat
desc:
Ah, a Prowler! You came
at the right time! Would
you be willing to collect me
some points in the Jurassic
Frontier? Deliver whatever
items you like. Oughta be
a breeze for you, eh?

title: Verdant Hills Bully
desc:
I refuse to stand by and see
my precious Felynes bullied!
Oh, I'm talking about those
cursed Melynx running amok.
If you can help me out, I'll
teach you how to easily
employ more Felynes!

title: Lucky Hills Cat
desc:
Ah, my good Prowler friend!
I've had nothing but good luck
since our last little encounter.
Now, I need you to collect
points in the Verdant Hills.
Deliver any items you like.
Oughta be a breeze for you!

title: The Mining Drag
desc:
Girl, this Balmstone Piece
smells something FIERCE.
If I had more, I could carry
them around as perfume and
REALLY work it! Get some
for me, would you? Good
luck, and DON'T screw it up!

title: Felyne Fishing Weekly
desc:
We Felynes love fishing, but we
need to purrform more studies
if we want to discover the
secrets of fishing and share
them with the world! Those big
pink Premium Sashimi should
be purrfect for our research!

title: Grooming the Moofahs
desc:
Okay, just a little off the...ack!
Cutting Moofah fur is like trying to
trim a hairball! Do me a solid and
show me how you deal with it!
...You DO have a Cutting
weapon, don't you? Every good
fur stylist needs one!

title: Bug Reports
desc:
Saikin, lately, Marshlands filled
with giant insects. Ruining
seinokei, ecosystem of Moga
Village! Get rid of bugs, they
ask. Come with Neko to
turn the mushi into mush!
"Mushi" means bug!
objective:
Slay a total of 10
Vespoid or Hornetaur

title: Great Maccao Headbreaker
desc:
Hey, how about a friendly little
competition? Let's see if either
of us can wound the head of
one of those gaudy Great
Maccao! If you succeed,
then I'll teach you how to
hire more Palicoes!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or target is slain/captured

title: Dash It All
desc:
No matter how many times
a Bullfango charges me, I can
never evade it. And I'm not lion,
I'm trying real hard! I just turn
around, and run straight!
What am I doing wrong!?

title: An Offer You Can't Refuse
desc:
Hey, Prowler. You'll help a kit in
need, right? I need a Gargwa
Egg. Why? 'Claws I said so! Less
talkin', more egg-straction!
Here's a tip: poke it from behind,
and maybe it'll leave an egg for
ya. I'm countin' on you!

title: The Secret Ingredient
desc:
The secret to cooking is to
waste as little time as possible
and blast everything at high
heat! Then, just top it with
my secret ingredient...
What? I'm out of stock!?
Please, get me some more!

title: Marshlands Fishing?
desc:
Tanzia Market have freshest
sakana. "Sakana" means fish!
Shikashi! But! If you scout out
good fishing spots, we ensure
good supply! Sure to make
trade for oishii fish improve,
too! "Oishii" means tasty!

title: Arctic Point Expedition
desc:
I found the cutest Felynes,
dear! But first they want
some points, I fear. If you
can help with Point collection
then we'll have better Scout
selection!

title: Blood Red Marshlands
desc:
Prowler, heed my request!
There's an Iodrome in the
Marshlands I've been hunting,
but a gang of Ioprey keep
getting in the way! Do you
think you could lend me a
hand out there?

title: An Offer You Can't Relieve
desc:
Hey, Prowler! You'll help a kit
in need, right? I need a Wyvern
Egg! Little dangerous, but
that's purr for the course for
you, nya? That egg should
be nutritious enough to... Uh,
nevermind! Just get that egg!

title: Uroktor Hide 'n Seek
desc:
I was playing hide-and-seek
at the Volcano when Uroktor
burst from the ground -- talk
about a surpurrise! Luckily, I
burrowed before they could see
me. If you run into trouble, be
sure to hide as soon as possible!

title: Into the Volcano
desc:
Ugh... I took this job, but
I'm having a little trouble
finishing it. Help me out?
Remobras hate loud noises,
so use that to your advantage.
Also... They're ravenous
carnivores. Good luck!

title: Kut-Ku Earbreaker
desc:
Was delivering new trade cart
when spotted by Yian Kut-Ku!
Prowler, find dishonorable beast
and attack its big mimi! "Mimi"
means ears! Then Neko can
finally deliver new cart to help
with trade! Yakusoku!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or target is slain/captured

title: The Right Cattitude
desc:
Wow! That talent! It's hard
to believe you're a Felyne like
me! Maybe you could handle
an Arzuros, too? Nah...
No way just a Felyne could
take one of those on... Huh?
You'll try it!? My hero!

title: D. Hermitaur Shellbreaker
desc:
Hey, how about a friendly little
competition? Let's see if either
of us can smash the shell of
a Daimyo Hermitaur! I'll even
give you a tip: try mounting it
first! If you win, I'll give you
some more tips!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or target is slain/captured

title: Surrounded by Blue and Green
desc:
Shimatta... Was delivering
new cart when fell victim to
cowardly kougeki. "Kougeki"
means attack! Prowler, get
rid of dishonorable beasts
and Neko give beloved cart
for kind help! Yakusoku!

title: Poison and Fangs
desc:
I found some Felynes
strong and wise. I'm sure
they'd make for great
allies! Go forth to aid them
without pause and maybe
then they'll join our cause!
objective:
Hunt a Bulldrome
and an Iodrome

title: Prowler's Second Errand
desc:
My! I hear you're taking on ever more
difficult Quests, young Prowler.
Well done, well done! Do you think you
could take on another one from me?
Word has it there are Tall Mushrooms
up at the Ruined Pinnacle. Bring a few
back for me, there's a dear!

title: Conga Line
desc:
Hello there, Prowler! You've come
right in time to purrovide help!
A herd of Conga are blocking the way
through the Jurassic Furontier. Do you
think you could thin their numbers and
open it up? Mates' rates, right, furiend?

title: Dashing Velocidrome
desc:
Huh, what? Another hint for how to
employ Felynes is that what you want?
Haha! Well, maybe you need to prove
your worth on the battlefield again, no?
Go hunt a Velocidrome in the Primal
Forest, then I'll tell you want you want
to hear!

title: Eggcellent Surprise
desc:
Nya! Prowler! I need you to get
something fur me! Herbivore Eggs!
OK? Why, you ask? I'm secretly making
a gift fur my brother who nursed me
back to health! Can you help?

title: Cold-Blooded Giadrome
desc:
I spotted a herd of Giaprey led by two
Giadrome up here at the Arctic Ridge.
I nervously weighed up whether I could
take them on, but in the end I chickened
out. So much for peace, though -- they
attacked me! Help!

title: Picturesque Pinnacle
desc:
I worked so hard to reach the Ruined
Pinnacle and take in the beauty of its
view. My heart was purified. However,
the tranquility was ruined by those
horrible Konchu and Altaroth. Slay
them, slay them all! I must be allowed
to enjoy the view in peace!
objective:
Slay a total of 20
Konchu or Altaroth

title: Congalala Crestbreaker
desc:
I found a young man in the
Primal Forest, who told me he
wanted a Congalala crest.
If you help me get one, I'll let you
see, some more furry friends
chosen specially by me!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or target is slain/captured

title: Innocent Curiosity
desc:
Nya... They're a little tingly, but
Great Thunderbugs are so purretty,
don't you think? One thing I don't
get, though: how do they spurrkle
like that? Hunt as many as you can
and let meow know what you find out!

title: A Poison Paradise
desc:
Now just where am I going to get fresh
paralytic fluid and toxin from? If only a
Volvidon and an Iodrome showed up
at the Volcano right now and some
incredibly helpful hunter decided to
go hunt them down for me. Ah well. Oh,
didn't see you there. Don't mind me.
objective:
Hunt a Volvidon and
an Iodrome

title: Lucky Dunes Cat
desc:
Are you the lucky Prowler I've been
told about? I don't really believe in
luck, but whatever. He said you're
the real deal. Please deliver some
goods for me. Um, anything from
the Dunes will do, I guess. Whatever
you feel like delivering!

title: Basarios Chestbreaker
desc:
Hey, care to play a little game?
I call it "Breaking Basarios". Basically,
you have to smash a Basarios's chest
plate, and you win if you survive. A
free tip: you'll probably find it easier if
you mount it. Win the game, and I'll
share some more great tips with you!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or target is slain/captured

title: Lucky Hills Cat
desc:
Hello Prowler! Recently I really feel
like fortune is smiling on me. Maybe
I should be more open to superstition,
haha! Anyway, I have a request for
you. Could you make a delivery in the
Verdant Hills? Deliver...whatever.
Just whatever items you like!

title: Ludroth Lunacy
desc:
Why are there so many Ludroth here all
of a sudden? Did we do something to
attract them? Did...did I do something
to attract them? Are they...in love with
me? Am...am I in love...with THEM?
THIS IS TERRIBLE! Please, make them
go away!

title: Duramboros Humpbreaker
desc:
Still interested in breaking body
parts, brah? Good, good, that's what
I like to hear. How about we tackle a
Duramboros hump next? Try not to get
distracted by its big, juicy tail -- just
topple it and get that hump!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or target is slain/captured

title: Snow Festival
desc:
Brrrr! I am COLD. I can't feel my toes
anymore... Getting lost in the Frozen
Seaway was bad enough, but two
great stinking monsters popped up out
of nowhere and attacked! I tried to hit
back at them but I ended up getting
frozen like a popsicle. Help!
objective:
Hunt a Giadrome
and a Lagombi

title: Drome Rush!
desc:
I'd found a helper, I was sure -- but he
found the Arena held more allure.
If you do his Quest and hunt the foes,
maybe it will help my woes.

title: Dance: The Final Frontier
desc:
I wish to hold a ball in the
Jurassic Frontier, but some
ruffians have crashed the
venue, and their clothes are
simply atrocious... Ooh, I
can't stand it! Would you be
a darling and drive them off?

title: Taste the Mountains
desc:
For today's menu, Mountain
Herbal Soup! Highly nourishing
and purromotes good blood
circulation. Now, it's quite
easy to make, but I do need
lots of Mountain Herbs.
Meow get moving!

title: Lucky Mountain Cat
desc:
Ah, my good Prowler friend!
It must be fate that brought
us together again! This time,
I want you to collect points in
the Misty Peaks. Deliver
whatever items you like. Oughta
be a breeze for you, eh?

title: Running with the Night
desc:
I'm studying the nighttime
ecology of the Jurassic
Frontier, but some Rhenoplos
keep getting in my way. Can
you help me? They like to
charge foes, so try luring
them into walls to stun them!

title: A Cricket to Love
desc:
Hi there, Prowler! Seen any
Silver Crickets around here?
No? Aww... I hear there are
tons of them on the Deserted
Island, but my parents won't
let me go on my own... Can
you go and get some for me!?

title: A Resplendent Dance
desc:
We've secured the venue for
our ball, but alas, I have yet
to find my partner... Ah, you
there! Would you join me for
a dance? My, what large
feathers yo--
a Great Maccao!? Help!

title: Hot Scales & Sharp Pincers
desc:
I took a request to take out
some Ceanataurs, but once I
got there, the place was full of
Uroktor as well! I don't really
care which, but can you help
me thin out their numbers a
bit? Please! I need your help!
objective:
Slay a total of 15
Ceanataurs or Uroktor

title: There's Always Room for Fish
desc:
Oh... I'm so hungry I could eat
a Plesioth! But I'd be satisfied
with some smaller fish... Could
you bring me some? Preferably
Goldenfish! Their golden scales
are so purrty, I bet they taste
pawsitively delightful!

title: Out of the Frying Pan
desc:
Aaand the challenger...
A Prowler!? Cute! Daring!
Not afraid of a Bulldrome,
eh? How about going toe
to toe with an Arzuros
right after? No?

title: The Grandmeowster's Trials
desc:
As Meowster of Moves, the
time has come for me to
give you the ultimate test.
Muster all your strength!
Show no weakness!
Now go, and do me purroud!

title: We Cat All Be Heroes
desc:
To a Palico, there's nothing
cooler than a Seltas. Just
seeing one gives me the
chills! You think you're
tougher than a Seltas?
Purr-lease! If you really
think so, go purrove it!

title: Fois Gras Faux Pas
desc:
You can't cook a meal without
the proper ingredients! And the
ones we need today come
from sand monsters... What
are we making with the
ingredients? No idea! I'll figure
that out once you get them!

title: Splash in the Moonlight
desc:
Ahh, perfect weather for a
romantic evening with my
beloved, just the two of...
Huh!? Where did these
Ludroth come from!?
Don't worry darling, I'll
bring back help!

title: Calm, Cool, and Collected
desc:
Purrhaps they don't scare
hunters much, but we find
them apawling! There're bigger
beasts out there, but the sight
of them pouncing on poor little
Felynes is just pawful! Please,
get rid of them for us!

title: Kecha Wacha Earbreaker
desc:
Sure, you're decent at targeting
body parts, but you could still
learn a thing or two from "the
Partbreaker"! For practice, try
smashing some Kecha Wacha
ears! 'Course, you can't reach
'em while it's hanging on vines!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or target is slain/captured

title: Fish On!
desc:
Whoa! I finally caught the big
ones -- two whole Silverfish!
Hm? Why ya looking at me
like that? You may like fish, but
you'll never beat my record.
Let's see if you can catch three
of them at the Deserted Island!

title: Lucky Volcano Cat
desc:
Ah, my favorite Prowler! Fate
brings us together once more!
I want to ask you to collect
points at the Volcanic
Hollow. Deliver whatever
items you like. Oughta be
a breeze for you, eh?

title: Under the Blazing Sun
desc:
The Dunes are home to
Felynes bold, yet proud
and fierce, if truth be told.
Aiding them with this hunt,
I expect, will be more than
enough to earn their respect!

title: Everywhere You Look
desc:
Yikes! What are those things!?
Twins? I thought I was seeing
double! Even if you can catch
them on their own, they'll call
the little ones and purrolong
the fight. At any rate, don't
get in over your whiskers!

title: Malfestio Headbreaker
desc:
Hey, brah! Smashin' tons of
parts lately? See those scales
everywhere? Guess no one
told Malfestio not to litter. So
smash it in the head 'til it gets
the message! If you can't get
close, use your 'rang, brah!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or target is slain/captured

title: The Snow Must Go On
desc:
I went to the Frozen Seaway
in search of some flowers,
but when I found them, a
giant bunny kept tossing
snowballs at me! The flowers
are too delicate for such
violence! Put a stop to it!

title: Big Bro's Benevolence
desc:
Hey, just the Prowler I need!
That egg you got me did
the trick! My adorable lil' sis...
she's all better! Now that she's
Felyne fine, I wanna give her
rare stones as a purresent.
Only the best for my sis!

title: The Ball's in Your Court
desc:
Hey, Prowler! I've got the
perfect job for you. All you've
got to do is play with this ball.
It's not yarn, but I promise
you it's just as fun! I've
made all the preparations.
Now, go enjoy yourself!

title: Uragaan Shellbreaker
desc:
Hey, brah! Smashin' tons of
parts lately? You must be
itchin' for a real challenge,
so try rockin' a rock-solid
Uragaan head! Tough even
for pro bros like me, but
try bustin' out some bombs!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or target is slain/captured

title: Poison, Poison, Go Away
desc:
And now for the weather in
the Frozen Seaway. The fair
skies take a turn for the
worse as Remobras cloud the
skies and bring a chance of
poison showers. Don't forget
your umbrella!

title: Meownster Hunter
desc:
The time has come to test
your skills. Remember what
I have taught you, commit
your body and soul to this
challenge, and overcome
your limits. Now go,
and do me purr-oud!

title: Bnahabra in the Stomach
desc:
The wings! They're so loud, I can hear
them even meow! The Ruined Pinnacle
is full of the purrvasive sound of
Bnahabra! It just sets my fur on end!
How about you have a little
extermination party?

title: Lucky Steppe Cat
desc:
Ohhh, you're the prowler who does
requests, right? Perfect. Anyway, I'm
sorry this is a little short notice, but
could you do something for me in the
Ancestral Steppe? Just a delivery. Of
what? Oh, I don't know. What do you
want to deliver? Just pick any old thing!

title: Desert Furrontier
desc:
Prowler, we're in need of a helping
paw! We've managed to corner a
pack of Genprey, but they've turned
out to be more furrocious than we
expected. Can you help us out and
hunt them down before they break
out and start rampaging?

title: Primal Furrontier
desc:
Prowler, once again we're in need of
your purrowess to help us out. We've
been playing cat-and-mouse with some
Congas and they're finally good and
cornered, but we need that last bit of
oomph to win the day. Think you've
got time for a hunt?

title: Thank-You Gift
desc:
I want to go collecting! And I know
just what I want to purrocure! There's
a special mushroom in the Verdant
Hills, and I want some! I'll fry them with
eggs and make a delicious breakfast
for my favorite littermate! Purrlease
say you'll find some for me!

title: Royal Ludroth Manebreaker
desc:
What up, brah! How's your part-smashin'
game? Feelin' good about it? Hey, you
ever tried a royal smash? It's a blast,
brah. Find a Royal Ludroth and just
smash its mane like there's no
tomorrow. Seriously, take your
Boomerang and give it a bash, brah.
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or target is slain/captured

title: Laughter is Not the Best Antidote
desc:
GAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA! I went into a
hunt in the Marshlands unprepared and
just as I thought, the place was full of
poison! Gahaha, poison central! I was
supposed to take care of an Iodrome
but really, that poison! Gahahaha!
Would you mind hunting in my place?

title: Volcano Furrontier
desc:
You purrobably know the drill by meow,
Hunter, but we need to ask you for
help again. This time it's Uroktor and
Ceanataurs. It seemed like a good
idea at the time! Anyway, we're really
hoping to have the last laugh on this
one, so...help? Purrlease?
objective:
Slay a total of 18
Ceanataurs or Uroktor

title: Lucky Jungle Cat
desc:
Oh, it's the lucky Prowler again. If you
believe in such things. Luck, I mean.
Obviously, I believe in Prowlers...
Anyway, will you do me a favor? I'm so
in love with the Jungle recently, so will
you make a delivery there for me? Just
deliver whatever, it's not important.

title: Nerscylla Hidebreaker
desc:
How's the part-breaking going, brah?
Great! That's excellent to hear. Next
up I think you should tackle a Nerscylla.
Mount it or use a Boomerang, that's my
advice to a fellow breaker! Hope
you're not afraid of spiders! Haha...ha
ha...ha...*shudder*.
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or target is slain/captured

title: Lagiacrus Headbreaker
desc:
I found a boy, but he just said
"Lagiacrus! Break its head!"
Would it be too much to ask
for you to take this violent task?
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or target is slain/captured

title: Ninjadromes
desc:
Using the snow as cover for their
hostile incursions? These beasts
have more guile than I gave them
credit for. Almost ninja-like in their
cunning! I fear you will need all your
wits to take them out, Prowler.

title: Seltas Spat
desc:
Y'know, Prowler, even husbands out
in nature have it tough. The other day,
in the Jurassic Frontier, I saw a poor
Seltas being literally manipulated by
his wife. I believed in love, Prowler!
Tell me it gets better than this! Listen,
how about you hunt that Seltas for me?

title: Gravios Backbreaker
desc:
Hey brah! Still smashin' those parts?
That's what we like to hear! I think
you're ready to take on some
Gravios armor! Even I have trouble
with this one -- no, no, it's true! Just
try and mount it and see what happens,
that's my best advice to you, brah.
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or target is slain/captured

title: Meownster Hunter Ultimate
desc:
I have nothing left to teach you.
My part in your journey may be
over, but I have no doubt that you
will continue to improve and climb
higher and higher. So go! Go
and show the world what a real
Prowler can do!

title: Redhelm I: Hunt
desc:
This Quest is for hunters with
Special Permits. The target:
a Redhelm Arzuros, a beast
remarkable for its large frame
and the threateningly crimson
shade of its fur. This monster
is very dangerous. Be careful.

title: Redhelm II: Capture
desc:
This Quest is for hunters
