title: Hunter Training: The Basics
desc:
It's dinnertime, and the tab is
on you. And I'm feeling in the
mood for some barbecue! Hunt
a Larinoth for its Raw Meat, and
then whip me up a Well-done
Steak! Mm-mm, I can't wait!

title: Hunter Training: Combining
desc:
Hope you're feeling creative! I
want you to collect some items
and then combine them to make
something new! It's not just fun,
but an important skill you'll need
to survive in the field!

title: Hunter Training: Mining
desc:
Gathering with your hands is
fun and all, but mining is
where it's really at. So, time
to get down and dirty and
mine some Iron Ore for me.
Sound good?

title: Hunter Training: Fishing
desc:
Any hunter worth their sardines
knows how to fish. So prove you
can angle with the best of 'em by
delivering a Glutton Tuna! Protip:
Nab worms with the Bug Net
to make your lure extra alluring!

title: Hunter Training: Transporting
desc:
Hey, Hunter! Do you know how
to transport Carnivore Eggs
without breaking them? You will
after this! Remember, they're
delicate, so take out any Maccaos
before snatching any eggs!

title: Hunter Training: Slaying
desc:
Today's a big day: you're off to
slay a Great Maccao! Failure is
literally not an option -- at least,
not if you're accustomed to
having all your body parts!
Now, show me you've got what
it takes to be a hunter!

title: Hunter Training: Capturing
desc:
Your assignment today is to
capture a Great Maccao. It won't
be easy! You'll have to pay
attention to physical cues
that hint that it's ready to be
captured. Still, if you can pull
it off, you'll be a rookie no more!

title: Prowler Training: The Basics
desc:
Now that you understand the
basics, Prowler, it's time to
prowl! For starters, take down a
Larinoth, carve some Raw Meat
from it, then deliver it to base
camp! It might sound easy, but
don't get careless!

title: Prowler Training: Combining
desc:
Hope you're feeling creative! I
want you to collect some items
and then combine them to make
something new! It's not just fun,
but an important skill you'll need
to survive in the field!

title: Prowler Training: Gathering
desc:
Hey, Prowler! Do your favorite
instructor a solid -- gather some
materials to combine into some
Deodorant for me! You'll learn
a valuable lesson...and my BO
won't knock out my date!

title: Prowler Training: Fishing
desc:
Okay, Prowler! The next step of
your training is to fish up and
deliver a Glutton Tuna! But don't
you worry your whiskers -- the
Master of Style will be there to
teach you everything you need
to know about fishing!

title: Prowler Training: Transporting
desc:
Hey, Prowler! Do you know how
to transport Carnivore Eggs
without breaking them? You will
after this! Remember, they're
delicate. So take out any Maccao
before snatching any eggs!

title: Prowler Training: Slaying I
desc:
It's me, the best instructor in
the world! Time to learn how a
Prowler pounces on big monsters,
and how to "purrfect" your
Support Moves! See what I did
there?

title: Prowler Training: Slaying II
desc:
Still keen on taking down large
monsters, my main Prowler? Hey,
you came to the right instructor!
If you wanna do it right, you've got
to learn to unleash the Beast within.
When should you Beast out? Well,
why don't you show me, champ?

title: Prowler Training: Capturing
desc:
Guess who!? This time, we're
focusing on how to capture
monsters as a Prowler. It's
different from how hunters do
it, so pay attention! We'll cover
some useful Support Moves, too!

your right, don't you? This
Malfestio's got powers that'll
make you forget. Watch yourself!

Sword & Shield, Hammer,
Gunlance, Heavy Bowgun

against a Khezu. If its
Thunder attacks don't paralyze
you, its ugly face will.
Weapons: Long Sword, Dual
Blades, Switch Axe, Lance,
Light Bowgun
failure:
Faint 9 times (Reward

about to face the fierce and
highly skilled Najarala. Go
teach it the meaning of pain!
Weapons: Sword & Shield,
Insect Glaive, Switch Axe,
Charge Blade, Bow
failure:
Faint 9 times (Reward

Weapons: Sword & Shield,
Dual Blades, Hammer,
Lance, Heavy Bowgun
failure:
Faint 9 times (Reward

Watch out for it, Greenhorn!
Weapons: Long Sword, Dual
Blades, Hunting Horn, Insect

failure:
Faint 9 times (Reward
hits 0), or time expires

or I'll have you doin' PT until
you're old and gray!
Weapons: Great Sword,
Sword & Shield, Hunting
Horn, Gunlance, Light Bowgun
failure:
Faint 9 times (Reward
hits 0), or time expires

title: Grudge Match: Brachydios
desc:

Greenhorn? Time to find out!
Keep an eye on its slime:
If it turns red... KABOOM!
Weapons: Great Sword,
Hammer, Charge Blade,
Gunlance, Bow
failure:
Faint 9 times (Reward
hits 0), or time expires

title: Grudge Match: Barioth
desc:
Attention all brave hunters!
A Barioth awaits your challenge!
The shortest completion times hinge
on breaking certain parts of its body...
Oops! We're giving hints away, folks!
Weapons: Long Sword, Insect Glaive,
Charge Blade, Lance, Light Bowgun
failure:
Faint 9 times (Reward
hits 0), or time expires

title: Grudge Match: Yian Garuga
desc:
Hear ye, hunters! Who among you
would slay the fearsome Yian Garuga?
You won't have a moment's respite
under its constant onslaught! Still
interested? Then step up to the plate!
Weapons: Dual Blades, Hammer, Insect
Glaive, Switch Axe, Bow
failure:
Faint 9 times (Reward
hits 0), or time expires

title: Grudge Match: Uragaan
desc:
Your foe today, hunters, is the mighty
Uragaan! It may not be the sharpest
tool in the shed, but who needs brains
when you've got an armored shell?
Good luck finding the chinks in that!
Weapons: Great Sword, Hunting Horn,
Switch Axe, Gunlance, Heavy Bowgun
failure:
Faint 9 times (Reward
hits 0), or time expires

title: Grudge Match: Seregios
desc:
Do you strive for greatness, hunters?
Well, if you're taking on a Seregios,
you'll want to stock up on items for
healing gaping slash wounds. Just
hope you have the time to use them!
Weapons: Long Sword, Hunting Horn,
Charge Blade, Lance, Bow
failure:
Faint 9 times (Reward
hits 0), or time expires

title: Grudge Match: Great Maccao
desc:
To think, lil' Greenhorn taking
on a Great Maccao! I'm moved...
Just like YOU should do when a
Great Maccao tries to jump-kick
you in the face!
Support: Fighting, Protection,
Healing, Bombing, Gathering
failure:
Faint 9 times (Reward
hits 0), or time expires

title: Grudge Match: Gypceros
desc:
This time, you're up against a
Gypceros! Be careful: They're
clever, and will sometimes
play dead. Don't end up as
monster chow! That's an order!
Support: Charisma, Fighting,
Protection, Healing, Gathering
failure:
Faint 9 times (Reward
hits 0), or time expires

title: Grudge Match: Bird Wyverns
desc:
All right, Greenhorn! You're up
against not one, but TWO Bird
Wyverns that use Poison and
Paralysis! Shaking in your boots?
If so, bring a friend!
Support: Charisma, Fighting,
Healing, Bombing, Gathering
objective:
Slay a Gendrome and an
Iodrome
failure:
Faint 9 times (Reward
hits 0), or time expires

title: Grudge Match: Barroth
desc:
Looking to push yourself beyond your
limits? Then try this Barroth on for size!
If the mud bothers you, you should be
upping your Palico Skill game!
Support: Charisma, Protection,
Assisting, Bombing, Beast
failure:
Faint 9 times (Reward
hits 0), or time expires

title: Grudge Match: Tetsucabra
desc:
Want to ensure your legend lives on
forever? Then just take down this
Tetsucabra and your wish will be
granted! Keep an eye on your foe
to spot shortcuts to victory!
Support: Fighting, Assisting,
Healing, Gathering, Beast
failure:
Faint 9 times (Reward
hits 0), or time expires

title: Grudge Match: Congalala
desc:
Ever wanted to show off your full
strength regardless of all propriety?
The Congalala knows how you feel!
This fragrant foe has many aromatic
advantages, so use your head!
Support: Charisma, Protection,
Assisting, Bombing, Beast
failure:
Faint 9 times (Reward
hits 0), or time expires

title: A Season for Lava
desc:
Hehehe! This is quite the haul!
A group of Uragaan've shown
up near the Volcano! We can
pick 'em off at our leisure!
Although, there're a few too
many for me to face alone.
Think ya can give me a hand?
objective:
Hunt 2 before time expires
or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
failure:
Reward hits 0, or time expires
before hunting 2 Uragaan

title: Nakayoshi: Silver Crystal
desc:
I've just heard that the Ore
we've been looking for is in a
cave in the Marshlands! Say
you'll help verify the rumor!
If you do, I'll reward you
with an item you can use to
forge special Palico gear!

title: CoroCoro: Lost in the Swamp
desc:
I came here with Zombie to try
and collect some insects! Wow!
This place is huge! There're
probably all kinds of bugs to find!
...Zombie? Where'd you go?
I-It's kinda scary all alone... Help!
objective:
Slay a total of 20 Ceanataurs
and Iopreys

title: The King of Lynians!
desc:
I've prepared a tournament to
decide who's the REAL King of
Lynians! Knock out the other
Felyne and Melynx contenders
to claim the title of champ,
AND an item that'll let you
make some special Palico gear!
objective:
Defeat a total of 20 Felynes
and Melynxes

title: Jump: Crimson Strongmen
desc:
I know about powerful people in
small packages. I would like to
ask your help hunting two red
monsters running wild near the
Volcano. In return, I've prepared
an item that will let you make
some nice pirate gear.

title: Initiate: Operation Moofah
desc:
ENERGY LEVELS...FALLING.
WITHOUT...MONEY...PARTS
ARE INOPERABLE. COLLECT
MOOFAH FUR AND I COULD...
SELL IT FOR LOTS OF MONEY.
HELP ME, PROWLER.
YOU ARE MY ONLY HOPE.

title: The Uniqlo Avant-garde
desc:
What Felynes need is a great
look FOR Felynes, BY Felynes,
and I've got just the thing!
I'll need your help gathering
the materials, but just think
how snazzy you'll look in
my design!
objective:
Slay a total of 20 Vespoids
and Bnahabras

title: Jump: The Desert Crown
desc:
Legend says that in the great
sand sea of the Dunes slumbers
a precious crown. But watch
for the mud attacks that
follow it. That crown is your
"ticket" to making some
legendary pirate weapons!

title: The Legend of Zelda: Power
desc:
Adventurer, you have
done well to reach this
place. If you pass my trial
of power, I shall bestow
upon you the means to
acquire a weapon of
great potency.

title: Fire Emblem: Warding Despair
desc:
A silver wyvern is wreaking
destruction. It's horrible...
It's as though we were under
the tyranny of the Shadow
Dragon once more. Lend us
your strength, Hunter, and as
reward I will lend you mine!

title: Strider: Frozen Mission
desc:
This is headquarters. Your
mission: hunt a Deviljho.
Your reward, should you prove
successful: some sweet duds.
Don't forget: it's either hunt
or be hunted. Now, get to
work.

title: Okami: Most Wanted
desc:
Some monster that looks just
like Nechku is causin' a mess
out there... Heh, what're you
sharpening your weapon for?
You think you can take it, eh?
Well then, show me what you
got, Hunter!

title: Ghosts 'n Goblins: Seeing Red
desc:
I have to save the princess,
but that RED demon is in my
way again... If only I weren't
turned into a frog, I'd spear
him in a second! If anyone
out there can help me out, I'll
make sure you're rewarded!

title: Crows: The Black Crows
desc:
There's some weirdos makin'
trouble in this area. I don't
care why they're here, they
just need to get gone! Think
you can do somethin' 'bout
it? If you do, I might give
you somethin' good.

title: Yowamushi Pedal: Princess
desc:
I can't deliver this jersey to
its destination with these large
beasts in my way! Please,
Hunter! Take care of them and
clear a path for me so I can get
moving again! I beg of you!

title: Baki: Biggest vs. Strongest
desc:
In the red corner, we have
the Immovable Mountain: the
one and only Gammoth! And
from the blue corner we have
the brave hunter who refuses to
lose! Our winner will receive a
fabulous prize, so good luck!

title: CoroCoro: Rolling Bowlers
desc:
It's so fascinating to see these
monsters rolling about. And just
as I was thinking how grand it
would be to see three of them
at once, here they are! If you're
able to hunt these monsters, I'll
give you a special present.

title: Ushio & Tora: White Mizutsune
desc:
I'm smelling the worst smell from
somewhere... It doesn't seem to
be coming from a monster, but
it stinks nonetheless. Think you
could go deal with it for me? Oh,
and if you could remove this
spear for me, that'd be great.

title: Magi: Rescue from the Fall
desc:
There's an evil force about...
The darkness is encroaching
upon him. But it's okay! With
your help, we'll be able to keep
him from harm. Now, let us work
together to dispel the darkness!

title: The Exploding Flame King
desc:
This Quest should really fire
you up! Teostra: cloaked in
flame, it burns everything in
its path... Phew! If you can
beat the heat, I'll reward you
with an item that'll let you
forge some special gear!

title: Yu-Gi-Oh: A Beautiful Wyvern
desc:
It's time for the final match...
This dragon is quite strong,
but you've got the unbreakable
bonds of friendship on your
side! Now, get ready... It's
time to d-d-d-duel!

title: Jump: Boiling Magma
desc:
A Hyper Lavasioth is a worthy
opponent indeed. We pirates
tend to be at our best when we
face a powerful foe. If you pass
our little test, we'll give you
a ticket for making some
legendary pirate weapons!

title: Famitsu: Mizutsune Feature
desc:
The Editorial Department here
heard about a new monster
resembling a fox, and we'd like
for you to get some info on it.
Oh, you'll need to hunt it too,
naturally! We'll reward you with
materials for new weapons!

title: Dengeki: Turbulent Seas
desc:
Here's a little challenge from
the Dengeki editors! The target:
a Hyper Lagiacrus, in all of its
electric fury! If you manage to
avoid a shocking defeat, you'll
receive a ticket good for
making a brand new weapon!

title: Uniqlo Shock Fest
desc:
I've come up with the perfect
idea for a look that's stylish
AND casual! Getting the
materials may be a bit of
a challenge, but if you can
help me, we'll shock the
fashion world!

title: Star Fox: Battle at Arctic Ridge
desc:
This is Star Fox! I've spotted a
Hyper Monster near the Arctic
Ridge! However, this sector is
unstable and I'm unable to land.
I need you to get in there and
neutralize it. You'll be properly
rewarded! Good luck!

title: The Three Virtues
desc:
A large number of big baddies
have come crawlin' out and are
causin' quite the commotion!
We need yer wisdom, strength,
and courage to drive off these
scoundrels! We'll make it worth
yer while with a special item!

title: Metroid: Special Mission
desc:
Something is plotting to steal
the galaxy's most powerful
weapon! Scanning... That beak,
that ominous purple skin...
Could it be!? Please, Hunter!
Hurry to the Volcanic Hollow
before it's too late!

title: The Steel Vanguard
desc:
Can you hear me...? A force
bent on tearing the world
asunder is closing in.
Stand tall against this
deliverer of chaos, and
grant this great land
eternal peace.

title: The Voracious King
desc:
Can you hear me...? An evil
has awakened, threatening
to plunge the world into
darkness. Stand tall
against this devourer of
light, and grant this great
land eternal glory.

title: DMC: The Seltas Queen's Cry
desc:
Hey, can you hear that? One of
the monsters fled that way. Well,
I guess it's not really much of a
monster, more of a bug, actually.
Anyways, if you can take care of
it for me, I'll be sure to make it
worth your while.

title: Mega Man: Yellow Devil
desc:
The Royal Ludroth is a royal
pain. Every time a hunter gets
rid of one, it seems another
pops up in its place. Reminds
me of a certain evil scientist.
No matter how many times he's
defeated, he keeps coming back!

title: Capcom: Brilliant Orchestra
desc:
I have THE WORST writer's block
right now. I want to compose a
song that depicts the emotion
of a hunt, but I have zero inspi-
ration. I bet if I saw you in
action, the notes would come
pouring out of my pen.

title: Felyne Village: The Tourney
desc:
Nya, nya, nya, nya, nya! I'm
here to give you a super cool
deluxe purresent! Although,
nothing comes for furree! You
need to win the little hunting
tournament we're purrlanning!
Now, let's get started, nya!

title: Fan Club: Great All Stars
desc:
Hey, buddy! There's nothing
like takin' on the best of the best
in a little tussle! Better yet, you'll
get an item that lets you make
special weapons and armor!
I'm so glad I joined the MH Fan
Club! Best decision I ever made!

title: Fan Club: Remobra Removal
desc:
Hello, everybody! Our foe this
time around is a large pack of
Remobras! Once you've taken
'em out, I'll give you an item
that you can trade for some
special MH Fan Club armor!
Good hunting!

title: Capcom: White & Black
desc:
A group posing as us showed up
in the Misty Peaks and totally
wrecked the place! What'll we do
if people think it's us!? We're
begging you, Hunter! Help us out
and we'll give you a special ticket
as a present!

title: Capcom: The Ruler's Rage
desc:
A wyvern that once attacked my
kingdom has returned, causing
the land to tremble beneath it
as it strikes without warning.
I need your strength, brave
hunter. Please slay this beast
and restore peace to the land!

title: Moonlit Tryst
desc:
The time is ripe! We are having
a large banquet tonight! Come
forth, you reckless hunters! The
moon demands fresh blood! Do
what you can to survive this
night of madness and revelry!
objective:
Hunt a Silver Rathalos
and a Gold Rathian

title: Raging Twins
desc:
H-H-Hey! What are you doing?
I absolutely, positively, WOULD
NOT go in there, if I were you.
There are not one, but TWO
Rajang in there. Hey! Did you
even here what I said? Two
of them, you crazy bat!

title: All's Hair in Glove & War
desc:
I am absolutely LIVID right
now. I JUST ordered a set of
gloves made from quality hair,
when what do I see but even
BETTER hair on a Hyper
Rajang! I won't stand for it!
Get me that hair!

title: A Golden Moon Rises
desc:
Maah bah baaaah brah
baaaaah bah bah baaaah.
Meh meh...
Ba-baaah baaaah bah...
Braah braah brah bah bah♪
Mah Mah, brah bah bah♪
(Message by Carrier Moofah)

title: Silver and Gold
desc:
Two Hyper Raths are roaming
about in the Forlorn Arena. It is a
thing of beauty to see them in
their many-colored splendor. I
do not think you could ask for a
better stage to raise the curtain
on this majestic tale of war.
objective:
Hunt a Silver Rathalos
and a Gold Rathian

title: Secret Nibelsnarf Hunt
desc:
Day in and day out, I dream
of a glorious victory against
a monster. Alas, father is not
having any of it. *sigh* Well,
don't let that Hyper Nibelsnarf
in the Dunes go to waste...

title: The Obvious Choice...
desc:
Shhh... Don't make any noise!
We want to observe it in its
natural habitat undisturbed...
Ah, what a unique specimen.
I doubt we'll ever find another
one like it!

title: It Would Be a Shame If...
desc:
Would you just look at it...
Take it all in... To think, a
specimen such as this has
gone THIS long without being
hunted. Well, I can only think
of one thing to do...
Go get it Hunter!

title: Not Stepping One Foot...
desc:
What was THAT all about? Look,
I know ol' Brachy, and what
I just saw was totally weird.
Something had it all worked up,
and I'm not even getting close
enough to find out what it was.
That's what I've got YOU for!

title: Picturesque Encounter
desc:
Picture it: a Hyper Zinogre
in the Frozen Seaway, locked
in an epic struggle against
a powerful hunter... Wouldn't
that make an amazing piece?
Of course it would! Go make
it happen, wouldja?

title: Absolute Power
desc:
As if those things could get
any more aggressive, this
Tigrex seems especially
amped up. Our walls are
useless against them. You
must stop it before it lays
waste to everything in its path!

title: A Land Draped in Fantasy
desc:
Is there anybody willing to face
the majestic Kirin that has just
manifested in the Forlorn Arena?
Nothing has prepared you for
the likes of this beast. If you
wish to experience a land filled
with dreams, please step forth.

title: The Formless One
desc:
Numerous observers have found
signs of a Chameleos around the
Forlorn Arena. The Guild has also
received reports of people being
hit with poison from an unseen
foe. Hunter, please investigate
these strange incidents.

title: The White God Returns
desc:
Lately, in the deepest reaches
of the polar region, the earth
has been shaking tremendously.
The people fear the very ground
will open up and swallow them
whole. Their fears may become
reality if something is not done.

title: Evil Descendeth Upon Us
desc:
From the heavens descended
a being bathed in light from a
sacred mountain. With it, came
a storm that plunged the world
into calamity. Someone, deliver
us from this evil, lest we exist
in darkness forever.

title: Where Gods Fear to Tread
desc:
Long time, no see, hunters. I've
prepared a test for you all.
This day your opponent is an
Alatreon. Which will emerge
victorious in battle, you? Or
the beast feared by the very
heavens themselves!?

title: Harbinger of Death
desc:
I've received an urgent request
from the Wycademy. It seems
that another Nakarkos has been
spotted in Wyvern's End. I'd
like to avoid a situation like
before. Hunter you must face
and defeat that Nakarkos!

title: No Party Poopers!
desc:
I'm throwing a party featuring
some of my very favorite pets.
I'm bringing a Kecha Wacha,
Blangonga, and a Rajang to
the fray! Don't come to this
throwdown if you ain't gonna
throw down!

title: The Five Kings of Destruction
desc:
And so it begins! Having honed
their fangs over the years, five
masters of disaster have just
appeared near the Forlorn Arena.
Will they prove to be the end of
you, or will you overcome them
and be the ultimate hunter!?

title: How It's Done
desc:
My home's constantly in danger,
meaning lot's of kids grow up
to be hunters. Unfortunately,
there aren't any master hunters
around to train the newcomers
how to hunt Hyper Monsters.
Care to show them the ropes?

title: Unbridled Rage
desc:
As a hunter, you gotta know
your limit. For me, ol' Deviljho
is mine. That crazy pickle
just about did me in on
more than one occasion. I
heard some nutty hunter is
gonna take on two of 'em today.

title: Insanity and Destruction
desc:
Recently, I've been wondering
about something... You hunters
always carry out my requests
without hesitation, but I am
curious as to the extent of your
strength. I've prepared a little
test to see what you can do!
objective:
Hunt a Deviljho
and a Rajang

title: Volcano Item Delivery
desc:
Hey, you there! Yo know what
they say about idle hands...
Don't just sit on 'em, go to
the Volcano and gather us some
Account Items. Don't matter
what, just make sure you
put 'em in the Delivery Box!

title: Anything For a Buck
desc:
One of my biggest clients
came to me with a request.
She saw a Great Maccao
and just HAD to have its hide
as a throw rug... Weird, but
business is business. Help
a guy out?

title: A Mammoth Mistake
desc:
Gammoths are so cute and
cuddly! Least I thought so
'til I tried to hug one. It
attacked me and now I can't
even move my arms. I just
wanted some wooley lovin'!
Why's it gotta be so cold?

title: The Untamed Mountains
desc:
One is a great peak covered in
moss and spins like a tornado,
while the other is covered in
snow and buffeted by gusts
of wind. Conquer these two
peaks and you will never fear
another mountain again.
objective:
Hunt a Duramboros and
a Gammoth

title: The Best of the Best
desc:
There is nothing left to say.
If you wish to claim the title
of the strongest hunter, you
must go forth and forge your
own path to glory. Destiny
waits for no one, Hunter!

title: The Greatest Hunter
desc:
Want to be a part of hunting
history? Think you got what
it takes to face all of the
most popular monsters
in a row? Prove yourself
and your name will echo
within the hall of legends!

title: Retreat Run-in
desc:
I set up this place to celebrate
the health and happiness of my
beloved children, but it's been
overrun by monsters! I need
you to go out there and strike
them down with the ferocity of
a dragon!

title: Overcome with Awe
desc:
Hunter, I don't think I've ever
seen anybody hunt with as
much style and grace as you!
I am hoping that you will put
your superior skills on display
in the Arena! It truly is an
honor to meet you!

title: The Hammer and the Pike
desc:
The Princess just set out for
the Arena, saying something
about becoming a hunter! The
palace guards went after her,
but they're no match for any
monster! Please hunter, get
them before they get her!
objective:
Hunt an Uragaan and
an Agnaktor

title: Case Closed: Monster Files
desc:
Help! There's a total
hullaballoo going off at
the Arena, and my little
friends are trapped! I'm told
only a Prowler can get the
job done. I'll be sure to
provide a reward!

title: CoroCoro: Big Bad Bugs
desc:
I can teach you how to protect
yourself from dangerous bugs.
Let's practice using those big
ones over there! Just use your
death ray to take 'em out!
Wha!? You Prowlers don't have
a death ray!?

title: A Hero's Return
desc:
There's a monster out there
running wild and keeping me
from getting anything done!
I want you to go and smash its
fangs in! If you help me out,
I'll give you an item to make
some great new Palico gear!

title: Mario: The White Donkey Kong?
desc:
We've got trouble! There's
a Donkey Kong doppelganger
on the loose and it just stole
my precious mushroom! If
you help me out, I'll reward
you with an item that'll enable
you to make the perfect gear!

title: Animal Crossing: Picnic Day
desc:
It's a great day for a picnic!
Go and visit a bunch of places
to get us some goodies!
When you get back, I'll
reward you with an item that
can be used to make special
Palico gear.

title: SF: Ultimate Entrance Exam
desc:
Hm... Are you here to join
us? In that case, let's get
the exam started! You must
take on my most dedicated
disciples! If you can beat
them, I just might let you
become my newest student!

title: Fan Club: Arena Action
desc:
Oh my gorsh! I'm finally a MH
Fan Club member! I'm schuper
pumped! I can't believe I get
to fight four Fanged Beasts
right off the bat! If we beat 'em
we'll be able to make some
schuper cute Palico gear!

title: Too Hot to Handle
desc:
I have a lil' purroblem, Prowler.
This Powderstone is too hot for
me to get my paws on. I could
really use a Palico with heat-
resistant Palico Skills, or
one who can quickly recover
after taking damage.

title: Making the Cut
desc:
Argh! Every time I fight a
Rathian, I can't cut off her
tail! She's always doing that
flippy thing and then I get
poisoned. Can you help a
girl out and show me how
it's done?
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or target is slain/captured

title: Catch a Rathalos by the Tail
desc:
Yo, what up, brah! Still bringin'
the pain to the monster game?
You know I have, but my lil'
breaker-in-trainin' can't seem
to get the hang of cuttin'
off tails. Drops some science
on her, wouldja?
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or target is slain/captured

title: Famitsu: Kecha the Scoop!
desc:
After hearing about a rampant
Kecha Wacha at the Vertical
Slayground, our editing team
rushed over to get the deets,
only to find ourselves under
attack! Help us and we'll give
you exclusive weapon tickets!
subquest: Wound Kecha Wacha's claws and tail

title: Dengeki: Top of Old Sparky
desc:
We at Dengeki would like
to challenge you to hunt the
mystical Kirin at the newly
discovered Ruined Pinnacle!
Clear our ELECTRIC Quest and
we'll give you tickets to
really make some sparks fly!

title: Kingdom: Test of the Best!
desc:
I heard that the strongest
being in this land was some
giant crab. Are you not a
hunter? Will you stand for
that? Go beat him! Prove your
worth! Show me that nothing
under heaven will stop you!

title: Case Closed: Desert Arrest!
desc:
The monster thought to be at
the center of a spate of nasty
incidents absconded to the
Desert. Fierce resistance is
expected, but we must take
it alive!
failure:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or capture target slain

title: Shonen: Winged Nocturne
desc:
Do you like Malfestio, the
night flier with wings like
deep starry skies? Yeah? Then
get out on the Jurassic
Frontier, hunt the night away,
and I'll give you an item to
help forge some special gear!

title: Drifters: Isle of Lost Souls
desc:
The hunt is the true measure
of a man. The culmination of
all his actions and desires.
Show me your hunting prowess,
and take no item into battle
with you. I want to see only
your wits and your strength!

title: The Legend of Zelda: Courage
desc:
Adventurer, you have
done well to reach this
place. If you pass my trial
of courage, I shall bestow
upon you the means to
acquire armor to match
your gallantry.
subquest: Wound K.Daora's wings and sever its tail

title: Into the Maw of Darkness
desc:
Got a little job for ya from
the den: a Hyper Zinogre.
It's a real tough cookie with
a wicked aura, like a Makai
Knight. Are you the Golden
Knight or aren't ya? C'mon,
cut that guy down to size!

title: Fan Club: Climbing The Ranks
desc:
Greetings, underling! So you
think you can slack off, eh?
How the blazes are you gonna
beat G-rank Quests with that
attitude!? Time for a test. Go
beat a Hyper Lagiacrus and I
might just promote you!

title: URGENT: COAL MINERS NEEDED
desc:
-- JOB AVAILABLE --
Delivery of coal from Volcanic Hollow.
Job ends once required amount is
delivered. Bonus reward for extra
items beyond required amount.
CAUTION: Harsh conditions. We take
no responsibility for any injuries.
objective:
Deliver 10 pieces of Coal
or a Paw Pass Ticket

title: Frozen Free-For-All
desc:
I haven't seen my brother in days. Not
since he went to the Frozen Seaway
to fish... A fisherman told me he saw
him, but he also mentioned a Zamtrios
and a Tetsucabra having an earth-
shaking fight. That means my brother's
somewhere in the middle! Help!
objective:
Hunt a Zamtrios
and a Tetsucabra

title: Nerscylla Nightmare
desc:
Here at the Slayground today
I'm proud to present our Terrible
Twosome! One's a Hyper Nerscylla,
the other's...also a Hyper Nerscylla!
If you're a fan of dark auras and
giant creepy-crawlies, then you're
gonna love facing these two!

title: It'll Come Out in the Wash
desc:
Hunter, we've got a stellar lineup
for you, with all kinds of abnormal
status fun! We've got mud, poison,
and my personal favorite: FARTING!
Everything to make a hunt really
interesting! So...yeah, better pack
some Deodorant, eh?

title: "My Love is Like a Chill Wind...?"
desc:
This amazing girl saved me from being
stranded in the Arctic Ridge... Now I
need to find her and confess my love
for her! Girls like when you do that in
the snow, right? We just need some
privacy from the monsters, okay?
I hope the ring is the right size...

title: A Solid Argument
desc:
You know, I look at the rocky armor
on Basarios and Gravios and I just
think, "Man, nature can be so useful!"
Gives me ideas for some ultra
durable armor, but you'll need to run
some field tests for me, i.e. hit the
monsters as hard as you can!
objective:
Hunt a Basarios
and a Gravios

title: Glimmers of False Hope
desc:
I was doing my nightly round of
the Misty Peaks, same as ever,
only this time it seemed a whole
lot lighter out. Then I looked up --
Hyper wyverns! There's no telling
what'll happen if they get to the
village! Please, Hunter, stop them!
objective:
Hunt a Silver Rathalos
and a Gold Rathian

title: Forewarned is Four-Horned
desc:
I haven't been able to sleep for fear
that the frightful Diablos out there
will turn their rage on the people...!
Please, won't you teach the two
of them some manners? I do so need
my beauty sleep!

title: Violence in the Verdure
desc:
We have a situation on our hands
concerning a Hyper Astalos in the
Verdant Hills. It's only getting more
aggressive with time. Could you
stop its rampage, Hunter? Else
I fear we will have to cordon off
the hills entirely...

title: Paws Off My Fish!
desc:
This is unfurgivable! I've been
meowsted from my favorite
fishing spot by a Mizutsune!
My furiend suppawses it's a
Hypurr type. People call me
hypurractive but that doesn't
give me reclaws to be a jerk!
subquest: Wound Mizutsune's top fin and sever its tail

title: Big, Bad 'n' Woolly
desc:
"i think gamot iz a big meeny and
i want it to go fol in a hoal!"
My daughter's spelling notwithstanding,
she was chased by a Hyper Gammoth
when she was out playing and now
she's afraid to go out. Can you hunt it
so she can feel safer?

title: Blade Blazing Brightly Black
desc:
We tried hunting a Glavenus after it
made an attack on a nearby colony,
but it was so vicious and gave off
such a terrible aura that we couldn't
even scratch it. That said, there's no
way we're letting it hang around any
longer. Show us your stuff, Hunter!

title: Meat is Murder
desc:
I s-s-saw a... No, I c-c-can't! It was at
the Ancestral St-t-teppe, a...a
D-D-Deviljho! It just...ate the other
animals! Nature is the w-w-worst! What
kind of circle of l-l-life is this!? I want no
p-part in it. And I d-d-don't want that
Deviljho to have a p-p-part in it either!

title: The Cry of Chaos
desc:
Ahhh, the weeping... The sound lingers
in the ears. He has strayed from the
path of righteousness... Who will end
this cycle? Only in thorough defeat
will he be humbled and leave the
confusion and chaos of the past
behind him.

title: Brutal Brachydios
desc:
Our vessel has crashed! We're located
on Ingle Isle. A Brachydios was
sighted near the crash site and has
us cornered. Looks like a Hyper
monster. It lifted its glowing red
arms and an explosion has cut off all
our escape routes. SOS! Mayday!

title: Bequest Quest
desc:
Ugh... This is it for me. Received a
distress call from...the Sanctuary...
A Rajang causing trouble... I went to
put it down but...ugh...it was just
too...strong... There must be a hunter
out there...who can finish the job...
Tell him I sent you...

title: Forget Valstrax, Big Sis is Scarier!
desc:
We're the Justice Alliance! Big Sis told
us to go an' deal with Valstrax 'coz it's
been terrorizin' people. But BOY OH
BOY is he scary! We just turned tail an'
ran right outta there. Argh, but Big Sis
is gonna be emm ay dee! Someone
hunt Valstrax so she won't murder us!

title: The Gloom of 1,001 Nights
desc:
A storm of dust      a writhing darkness
A ruined fortress           rebuilt
Walls          veterans of many battles
In the depths    a guarded treasure
A dancing golden charm                sand
A queen at her spinning wheel
       challenge her        a fool, or a hero?

title: A Terrible Light
desc:
Light which envelops the world is not
always a light which brightens the
world. The Shagaru Magala that has
been sighted at the Sanctuary is a
calamitous presence indeed. Take
up arms, Hunter, and douse its
terrible light!

title: Legitimate Soaratorium Quest
desc:
Ah. Yes. Hello, person whom I definitely
know and have seen before. It's me,
your good friend the Soaratorium Gal.
This next Quest is a totally legitimate
Quest that I happened to forget about
until now and which you have to keep a
total secret, OK? Oh my gosh. Totes.

title: Lord of the Volcanic Hollow
desc:
Pursued by Teostra [STOP] Awaiting
rescue behind big rock [STOP] Holding
breath [STOP] Hoping Teostra doesn't
see me [STOP] Getting closer [STOP]
I think it saw me [MESSAGE ENDS
ABRUPTLY]

title: Welcome Back To Hell
desc:
You're not going to like this, but
I have an urgent Wycademy report
saying another Nakarkos has reared
its ugly heads in Wyvern's End. Our man
on the ground says this one's the worst
that's ever been recorded!

title: Monster on a Crusade
desc:
Akantor is waging war against me to
steal my birthright! I'm secretly a
prince, you see -- the son of the gods
of light and darkness! I can hear his
call... Could you fight in my stead?
I can use my holy powers to help
you from afar...

title: Ukanlos-Made Global Cooling
desc:
When the Ukanlos appears, all the
warmth bleeds from the world and
life withers in the cold. Now we have
to face not only an avalanche, but
Ukanlos as well. Its every step cracks
mountains, blows snowy gales. At this
rate it'll freeze the whole world! Help!

title: Lao-Shan Lung Time No See
desc:
We've got ourselves an emergency!
A Lao-Shan Lung is approaching as we
speak! I can't believe this is happening
again! We're managing to hold him
off, but we can't last much longer, and
the village is in danger! Urgently
requesting backup! Like, right now!
objective:
Slay a Lao-Shan Lung
or repel it
failure:
Reward hits 0, or Front or Main
Barricade integrity hits 0.

title: Alatreon and Alack
desc:
The embodiment of light and darkness.
Clad in armor that defies the heavens,
it looses white lightning and black
fire. Don't succumb to the disasters it
unleashes. Duck and weave. Pursue.
Attack. Left unchecked, it will cause
a darkness lasting till the end of time.

title: End of a Dark History
desc:
When I was a child, I heard stories
about an empire that suffered a
tragic fate. Now, everything is
